note: Full catalog dump. Each term also at api URL and .md twin. llms.txt / llms-full.txt for humans-to-LLM navigation.

description.zh: 给图片写一句文本替代：信息图传达同样的信息，装饰图写空 alt 让读屏跳过，功能图描述动作而非画面。读屏用户、图片加载失败的用户和搜索引擎都靠这句话理解图在说什么。
description.en: A text alternative for every image: informative images convey the same information, decorative images get empty alt so readers skip them, functional images describe the action rather than the pixels. Screen-reader users, users on failed image loads and search engines all lean on this one line.

use_when.zh: 承载信息的图片、图表、插画、二维码
use_when.en: Images that carry information — charts, illustrations, QR codes

use_when.zh: 头像、商品图、文章配图等语义内容
use_when.en: Semantic content — avatars, product shots, article figures

use_when.zh: 图片是链接或按钮的唯一内容时
use_when.en: When an image is the sole content of a link or button

avoid_when.zh: 给装饰性纹理、分隔线写「图片」「image」占位
avoid_when.en: Writing "image" / "图片" for decorative texture or dividers

avoid_when.zh: 把长篇说明塞进 alt（应配 visible caption 或 aria-describedby）
avoid_when.en: Stuffing essays into alt — use a visible caption or aria-describedby

avoid_when.zh: 相邻文字已完整描述时再把同一句念一遍
avoid_when.en: Re-reading text that the adjacent copy already states

disambiguation.zh: alt 文本是图片的文本替代，tooltip 是指针悬停的补充说明——前者服务读屏与图片失效场景，后者只服务看得见的指针用户。
disambiguation.en: Alt text is the image's text alternative; a tooltip is a pointer-hover add-on — the former serves screen readers and failed loads, the latter only sighted pointer users.

note.zh: tooltip 是悬停才出现的补充说明，替代文本是图片本身无障碍必需的文本替身。
note.en: tooltip is hover-only supplementary text; alt text is the image's required accessible stand-in.

note.zh: 传达图片信息本身，如「3 月销量环比上涨 18%」
note.en: Conveys the image's information — e.g. "March sales up 18% month over month"

note.zh: alt="" 让读屏直接跳过，不留噪音
note.en: alt="" so readers skip it without noise

note.zh: 描述动作：「关闭」而不是「灰色叉号图标」
note.en: Describes the action — "Close", not "grey X icon"

notes.zh: 永远给 写 alt 属性；纯装饰用 alt=""（或 role="presentation" + aria-hidden），不要省略属性——省略会让读屏念出文件名。图标按钮用 aria-label 或可见文字，不要依赖图标字体的伪元素文本。图内文字尽量搬到 HTML；复杂图表配 aria-describedby 指向长描述。
notes.en: Always set alt on . Purely decorative images take alt="" (or role="presentation" + aria-hidden) — omitting the attribute makes readers speak the filename. Icon-only buttons get aria-label or visible text, never icon-font pseudo-element text. Keep text in images out of the bitmap when possible; complex charts point aria-describedby at a long description.

basic.zh: 检查并补齐全站图片的替代文本，装饰图标记为可跳过。
basic.en: Audit and fill in alt text for every image, marking decorative ones as skippable.

design.zh: 信息图的 alt 写「信息结论」而不是「画面描述」；装饰图 alt 置空；图标按钮文案说动作；商品图与头像 alt 含关键辨识信息（名称、颜色）。
design.en: Informative alt states the takeaway, not the paint; decorative alt is empty; icon buttons name the action; product and avatar alt carries identifying facts — name, colour.

implementation.zh: 所有 显式写 alt；装饰图 alt=""；
implementation.en: Set alt explicitly on every ; decorative images get alt=""; decorative

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现图片替代文本规范。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 所有信息图有表达信息结论的 alt
- 装饰图 alt=""，读屏可跳过
- 图标按钮与链接用 aria-label 描述动作
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。

Implement an alt-text convention in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse current components.
Requirements:
- Every informative image has alt that states the takeaway
- Decorative images use alt="" so readers skip them
- Icon buttons and links describe the action via aria-label
Keep the existing visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 在页面上预留一块播报区，内容动态更新时把消息念给屏幕阅读器，而不移动焦点。保存成功、筛选结果数、异步校验这类「看得见变了但焦点没动」的信息，读屏用户不靠它就会漏掉。
description.en: A reserved region on the page that speaks dynamic updates to screen readers without moving focus. Saved states, result counts, async validation — the "it changed on screen but focus didn't move" class of news that blind users simply miss without it.

use_when.zh: 操作结果反馈（已保存、已复制、已提交）
use_when.en: Operation outcomes — saved, copied, submitted

use_when.zh: 异步结果与筛选计数等无焦点移动的更新
use_when.en: Async results and filter counts with no focus change

use_when.zh: 表单校验错误需要在字段之外被朗读
use_when.en: Form errors that must be announced outside the field

avoid_when.zh: 用播报区代替把焦点移到错误字段（字段级错误仍要 focus）
avoid_when.en: Announcing field errors instead of focusing the field

avoid_when.zh: 高频连续插入导致读屏被消息刷屏
avoid_when.en: High-frequency inserts that flood the screen reader queue

avoid_when.zh: 必须被立即处理的阻断性错误只用 polite
avoid_when.en: Blocking errors that must interrupt, sent polite only

disambiguation.zh: aria-live 是不打断焦点的后台播报，modal 是抢走焦点的强制阅读——都在传达更新，一个插话，一个拦路。
disambiguation.en: aria-live is non-interrupting background speech; a modal is focus-stealing forced reading — both deliver news, one whispers it, one blocks the door.

note.zh: modal 抢占焦点强制阅读，aria-live 在不夺走焦点的前提下朗读更新。
note.en: modal seizes focus to force reading; aria-live voices updates without taking focus away.

note.zh: aria-live="polite"，等用户停顿再念，适合一般结果
note.en: aria-live="polite" — waits for a pause, right for ordinary results

note.zh: aria-live="assertive" / role="alert"，立刻打断，仅限关键警告
note.en: aria-live="assertive" / role="alert" — interrupts at once, critical warnings only

note.zh: role="status"，隐含 polite，适合加载与完成状态
note.en: role="status" — implicit polite, suits loading and done states

notes.zh: 实时区域必须预先存在于 DOM（空容器即可），再更新文本内容——动态创建的 live region 常常不会被朗读。role="status" 与 role="alert" 自带隐含 aria-live，不必重复声明。aria-atomic="true" 保证整块重读；同一区域连续更新时先清空再写入，避免被合并。视觉隐藏用 sr-only 但保持可朗读。
notes.en: The live region must already be in the DOM (an empty container is fine) before its text changes — freshly created regions are often not announced. role="status" and role="alert" imply their own aria-live, so do not stack both. aria-atomic="true" re-reads the whole region; clear then write on rapid updates so messages do not merge. Use sr-only when hiding visually while staying readable.

basic.zh: 给动态更新加上读屏播报：状态变化时屏幕阅读器能读出来。
basic.en: Announce dynamic updates so screen readers speak them as state changes.

design.zh: 每个 toast 与异步结果同时写入页面内的播报区；普通结果礼貌排队，阻断性错误立即打断；播报文案与视觉消息一致、简短、含结果动词。
design.en: Every toast and async result also writes into a page live region; ordinary news queues politely, blocking errors interrupt; announcement copy matches the visual message, short and outcome-first.

implementation.zh: 预置 <div aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" class="sr-only"> 与 role="alert" 区域；状态变化 setState 写入文本。toast 组件挂载到已存在容器；避免 300ms 内多次写入同一区域。
implementation.en: Pre-place `<div aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" class="sr-only">` plus a role="alert" region; state changes write text in. Mount toasts into an existing container; avoid multiple writes into one region within 300ms.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现实时区域播报。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 预置 live region，动态更新写入文本
- polite / assertive / status 三档按消息重要性选择
- toast 与表单校验结果同步播报
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement live-region announcements in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse current components.
Requirements:
- Pre-place live regions and write updates as text
- Choose polite / assertive / status by message urgency
- Toasts and form-validation results are announced too
Keep the existing visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 用可见轮廓标记当前键盘焦点位置，让用户知道下一个按键会落在哪里。鼠标点击往往不需要它，但键盘与辅助技术用户必须始终看见焦点在哪，否则只能盲操作。通常用 :focus-visible 控制——键盘聚焦才显示，鼠标点击不打扰。
description.en: A visible outline marking the currently focused element, so users know where the next keystroke will land. Pointer users rarely need it, but keyboard and assistive-tech users must always see focus or they are operating blind. Usually driven by :focus-visible — shown for keyboard focus, silent for mouse clicks.

use_when.zh: 任何可聚焦元素（按钮、链接、输入框、自定义控件）
use_when.en: Any focusable element — buttons, links, inputs, custom widgets

use_when.zh: 用 :focus-visible 而非 :focus，避免鼠标点击也弹框
use_when.en: Targeting :focus-visible rather than :focus so clicks stay clean

use_when.zh: 自定义控件覆盖了浏览器默认轮廓之后
use_when.en: After custom styles have overridden the browser default outline

avoid_when.zh: outline: none 之后不给任何替代指示（键盘用户直接失联）
avoid_when.en: Removing outline: none without a replacement indicator

avoid_when.zh: 把焦点环做成 hover 高亮的复制品，只在鼠标下可见
avoid_when.en: Cloning the hover highlight so focus is only visible to the pointer

avoid_when.zh: 焦点环对比度不足 3:1，或被邻近元素裁切遮挡
avoid_when.en: Rings below 3:1 contrast, or clipped by neighbouring elements

disambiguation.zh: 焦点环不等于 hover 高亮——焦点环服务键盘用户，hover 服务指针用户。
disambiguation.en: A focus ring is not a hover highlight — focus serves keyboard users, hover serves pointer users.

note.zh: hover-glow 是鼠标悬停的装饰反馈，焦点环是键盘可达性的必需指示。
note.en: hover-glow is decorative pointer feedback; a focus ring is required keyboard affordance.

note.zh: outline + outline-offset，最通用、可被 forced-colors 保留
note.en: outline plus outline-offset — universal, survives forced-colors

note.zh: box-shadow 双层描边，圆角跟随元素形状
note.en: Layered box-shadow ring that hugs custom border-radius

note.zh: 只变边框色，视觉最弱，需配合加粗才够用
note.en: Border-color only — weakest, needs a weight bump to pass

notes.zh: 基础写法：:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px }。需要跟随圆角时改用 box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px 两层环。覆盖浏览器默认轮廓后必须提供替代；forced-colors 模式下保留 outline。可用 :focus:not(:focus-visible) 精确去掉鼠标点击的环。
notes.en: Base recipe: `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px }`. Switch to a two-layer `box-shadow` ring when you need it to hug custom radii. Never drop the default outline without a replacement; keep outline under forced-colors. Use `:focus:not(:focus-visible)` to strip click-only rings precisely.

basic.zh: 给项目里的按钮和链接加上清晰的键盘焦点环，Tab 切换时能看见当前位置。
basic.en: Add a clear keyboard focus ring to buttons and links so Tab navigation is always visible.

design.zh: 所有可聚焦元素显示 2px 强调色外轮廓，offset 3px，与圆角一致；鼠标点击不显示，键盘聚焦才显示；深浅色主题下对比度均不低于 3:1。
design.en: Every focusable shows a 2px accent outline at 3px offset matching its radius; visible on keyboard focus only; at least 3:1 contrast in both light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 全局：:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px }；禁止裸写 outline:none；自定义圆角组件用 box-shadow 环替代；:focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none } 去掉点击环。
implementation.en: Global: `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px }`; never ship bare outline:none; use a box-shadow ring for custom radii; `:focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none }` strips click rings.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现可见键盘焦点环。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- :focus-visible 显示 2px 强调色轮廓，offset 3px，鼠标点击不显示
- 全项目禁止无替代的 outline: none
- 自定义圆角组件用 box-shadow 环跟随形状
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a visible keyboard focus ring in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse current components.
Requirements:
- :focus-visible shows a 2px accent outline at 3px offset; mouse clicks do not
- No bare outline: none anywhere without a replacement
- Custom-radius components use a shape-hugging box-shadow ring
Keep the existing visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 让所有功能都能只用键盘完成：Tab/Shift+Tab 按合理顺序移动焦点，复合组件内用方向键漫游并配 roving tabindex，Escape 关闭浮层并归还焦点。这是焦点环之外的一整套焦点秩序，规则写在 ARIA APG 里。
description.en: Make every feature operable by keyboard alone: Tab/Shift+Tab move focus in a sane order, composite widgets roam with arrow keys over a roving tabindex, Escape dismisses overlays and returns focus. The full focus discipline beyond the focus ring, codified in the ARIA APG.

use_when.zh: 工具栏、菜单、标签页等复合组件的组内焦点管理
use_when.en: Focus management inside composites — toolbars, menus, tab lists

use_when.zh: 弹层、抽屉、对话框需要打开与关闭的焦点闭环
use_when.en: Overlays that need an open/close focus loop

use_when.zh: 任何必须「无鼠标可完成」的核心流程
use_when.en: Any core flow that must be completable without a mouse

avoid_when.zh: 用 tabindex="0" 把非交互元素强行拉进 Tab 序
avoid_when.en: Dragging non-interactive nodes into the tab order with tabindex="0"

avoid_when.zh: 组内每个项都 tabindex="0"，方向键又不能漫游
avoid_when.en: Making every item tabbable while arrows do not roam

avoid_when.zh: Escape 关掉浮层后焦点掉回 body 顶
avoid_when.en: Escape closing an overlay and dropping focus at the top of body

disambiguation.zh: 「Tab 键」是移动焦点的按键，「标签页（Tabs）」是一个组件——英文同形，中文口语都可能说成 Tab，一个是输入按键，一个是界面元素。
disambiguation.en: The Tab key moves focus; Tabs is a component. Same English word, two completely different things — one is an input key, one is a UI element.

note.zh: tabs 是标签页组件；keyboard-navigation 里的 Tab 键是焦点移动按键——同名不同物。
note.en: tabs is the tab component; the Tab key in keyboard-navigation is the focus-mover — same word, different things.

note.zh: DOM 顺序即焦点顺序，页面级默认
note.en: DOM order is focus order — the page-level default

note.zh: 组内仅一项 tabindex="0"，方向键切换
note.en: One tabindex="0" inside the group, arrows move it

note.zh: 关闭浮层后焦点回到触发元素
note.en: Closing an overlay returns focus to its trigger

notes.zh: 页面级用自然 DOM 顺序 + 原生可交互元素，别用正数 tabindex 重排。复合组件按 APG：组内一项 tabindex="0" 其余 -1，keydown 处理方向键/Home/End 并 .focus() 目标项；浮层打开时焦点移入，Escape 关闭并归还触发元素。keydown 里 preventDefault 前先确认按键属于该组件。
notes.en: Page level: natural DOM order with native interactive elements — never positive tabindex. Composites per APG: one tabindex="0" in the group, -1 elsewhere; keydown handles arrows/Home/End and focuses the target item. On open, move focus into the overlay; Escape closes and restores the trigger. Only preventDefault a key once you know the widget owns it.

basic.zh: 让页面和组件完整支持键盘操作：Tab 移动、方向键选择、Escape 关闭。
basic.en: Make the page and components fully keyboard operable — Tab to move, arrows to pick, Escape to dismiss.

design.zh: 焦点顺序与视觉顺序一致；工具栏与菜单组内只占一个 Tab 站点、方向键漫游；弹层打开焦点移入、Escape 关闭并回到触发按钮；每个焦点位置都有可见焦点环。
design.en: Focus order matches visual order; toolbars and menus occupy one tab stop and roam with arrows; overlays take focus on open and return it to the trigger on Escape; every stop shows a visible focus ring.

implementation.zh: 组合式组件：container role + 项目 refs，state 记录 activeIndex；tabIndex={i === active ? 0 : -1}；onKeyDown 分发 Arrow/Home/End 后 focus(next)。浮层用 dialog/role="menu"，打开 focus 首项、Escape 关闭并 trigger.focus()。
implementation.en: Composite: container role plus item refs, state tracks activeIndex; `tabIndex={i === active ? 0 : -1}`; onKeyDown maps Arrow/Home/End then focus(next). Overlays use dialog or role="menu", focus the first item on open, Escape closes and calls trigger.focus().

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现完整键盘导航。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- Tab 顺序与视觉顺序一致，不使用正数 tabindex
- 复合组件方向键漫游 + roving tabindex
- 浮层 Escape 关闭并把焦点还给触发元素
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement complete keyboard navigation in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse current components.
Requirements:
- Focus order matches visual order; no positive tabindex
- Composites roam with arrow keys over a roving tabindex
- Escape closes overlays and returns focus to the trigger
Keep the existing visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 尊重系统「减弱动态效果」偏好，把大幅位移、缩放、视差动画降级为淡入甚至直接呈现。前庭敏感的用户会被大幅动效诱发眩晕恶心，这不是审美偏好而是健康风险；WCAG 2.3.3 要求非必要动画可被关闭。
description.en: Honour the OS "reduce motion" preference by demoting large translations, zooms and parallax to a plain fade or no motion at all. Large motion can trigger nausea and vertigo in vestibular-sensitive users — a health risk, not a taste question. WCAG 2.3.3 requires non-essential animation to be disable-able.

use_when.zh: 落地页、转场、视差等大幅位移或缩放动画
use_when.en: Landing pages, transitions and parallax with large movement

use_when.zh: 自动播放的装饰动效（跑马灯、弹性弹跳、数字滚动）
use_when.en: Auto-playing decorative motion — marquee, bounce, number rolls

use_when.zh: 用 JS 驱动的动画库补上 CSS 之外的降级分支
use_when.en: JS-driven animation libraries that need a non-CSS fallback path

avoid_when.zh: 把按下态、加载态这些功能反馈也一刀切砍光
avoid_when.en: Slashing functional feedback too — press and loading states still need motion cues

avoid_when.zh: 用减弱动效代替真正的无障碍修复（比如补焦点环）
avoid_when.en: Substituting it for real fixes such as a missing focus ring

avoid_when.zh: 只降级 CSS 动画，JS 弹跳/视差仍强制播放
avoid_when.en: Demoting CSS only while JS bounce and parallax keep running

disambiguation.zh: prefers-reduced-motion 是操作系统里的健康偏好，不是应用内的「关闭动画」开关——前者由用户在系统设置里声明，后者只是产品自己的设置项。
disambiguation.en: prefers-reduced-motion is an OS-level health preference, not an in-app "kill animations" switch — the former is declared in system settings, the latter is just a product toggle.

note.zh: page-transition 是转场动效本身，reduced-motion 是决定它要不要减弱的系统策略——一个造动效，一个裁动效。
note.en: page-transition is the transition motion itself; reduced-motion is the system policy deciding whether to soften it — one builds motion, the other trims it.

note.zh: 去掉位移与缩放，只留 opacity 过渡，最常用降级
note.en: Drop translation and scale, keep opacity — the default demotion

note.zh: animation: none / transition: none，状态瞬间到位
note.en: animation: none / transition: none — state lands instantly

note.zh: 用静态图或即时结果替换整段动效叙事
note.en: Swap the whole motion story for a static image or instant result

notes.zh: CSS 侧统一门控：@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, ::before, ::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; } }，再按需为状态反馈保留 opacity 通道。JS 动画用 matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches 读取并在 change 事件时重配；滚动驱动与视差必须同步禁用。
notes.en: CSS-wide gate: `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, ::before, ::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; } }`, then re-enable opacity for functional feedback as needed. JS animation reads matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches and reconfigures on change; scroll-driven motion and parallax must switch off together.

basic.zh: 让网站尊重系统的「减弱动态效果」设置，开启时动画自动降级。
basic.en: Make the site honour the OS "reduce motion" setting, demoting animation when it is on.

design.zh: 系统开启减弱动效时，入场动画去掉位移与缩放只留 200ms 淡入，转场改为即时或交叉淡化，跑马灯与视差完全停用；按下与加载反馈保留。
design.en: When reduce motion is on, entrances lose translation and scale and become a 200ms fade, transitions go instant or crossfade, marquee and parallax stop entirely; press and loading feedback stay.

implementation.zh: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) 全局压缩 animation/transition 时长；JS 用 matchMedia 读取并监听 change；滚动监听、视差、数字滚动在 reduce 分支直接呈现终值。产品内设置项也映射到同一降级函数。
implementation.en: Compress animation/transition durations under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce); JS reads matchMedia and listens for change; scroll-scrub, parallax and counters render their end state in the reduce branch. Map any in-product toggle onto the same demotion function.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现减弱动效支持。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 全局尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，位移/缩放类动画降级为淡入或取消
- JS 驱动动画用 matchMedia 读取并响应 change
- 功能性反馈（按下、加载）保留
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement reduced-motion support in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse current components.
Requirements:
- Honour prefers-reduced-motion globally; demote translation/scale motion to fade or nothing
- JS-driven animation reads matchMedia and reacts to change
- Keep functional feedback (press, loading) intact
Keep the existing visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 页面第一个可聚焦元素，通常是视觉上隐藏的链接；键盘用户按下第一个 Tab 就能看见它，激活后直接跳到主内容区，不必逐个穿过顶部导航链接。长导航站点的必备逃生口，WCAG 称之为「跳过区块」。
description.en: The first focusable element on the page — usually a visually hidden link. Keyboard users meet it on the first Tab, activate it, and land straight in the main content without walking every nav link. The mandatory escape hatch on nav-heavy sites; WCAG calls it "bypass blocks".

use_when.zh: 顶部导航链接超过 5 个，且每页重复出现
use_when.en: Repeated page chrome with more than a handful of nav links

use_when.zh: 单页应用路由切换后焦点需要有处可去
use_when.en: SPAs where focus needs a resting place after route changes

use_when.zh: 页头含搜索、登录、语言切换等大量可聚焦项
use_when.en: Headers crowded with search, login and locale switchers

avoid_when.zh: 导航只有两三个链接，跳过收益小于复杂度
avoid_when.en: Navs with two or three links — bypassing costs more than it saves

avoid_when.zh: 把「跳过」做成页头第一个常驻菜单项而不是隐藏链接
avoid_when.en: Shipping it as a permanent first nav item instead of a hidden link

avoid_when.zh: 跳过目标没有 tabindex="-1"，锚点落点不可聚焦
avoid_when.en: Targets without tabindex="-1" so the jump lands on an unfocusable node

disambiguation.zh: 跳过链接不是「返回顶部」——跳过链接在文档流最前、服务键盘用户跳过导航；返回顶部出现在长页底部，服务滚动浏览者。
disambiguation.en: A skip link is not "back to top" — the skip link sits first in the document for keyboard users escaping nav; back-to-top sits at the bottom of long pages for scrollers.

note.zh: navbar 是被跳过的长导航本身，不是跳过机制；把「跳过导航」塞成 navbar 第一项就失去了意义。
note.en: navbar is the long nav being skipped, not the skipping mechanism — making "skip nav" its first item defeats the point.

note.zh: 聚焦时浮现在左上角，最常见
note.en: Appears top-left on focus — the common default

note.zh: 聚焦时横贯页头，更难错过
note.en: Spans the header on focus — harder to miss

note.zh: 始终可见的小字链接，代价是占一条视觉行
note.en: Always-visible small link — costs a line of visual space

notes.zh: 隐藏用 position:absolute + clip-path:inset(50%)（或 left:-9999px），:focus 时恢复到视口内并给足对比度；目标区 main 加 tabindex="-1" 并 scroll-margin-top 抵消吸顶页头。放在 <body> 最前、页头之前。SPA 可在路由切换后用它归还焦点。
notes.en: Hide with `position:absolute` + `clip-path:inset(50%)` (or left:-9999px) and restore inside the viewport on :focus with solid contrast. Give the target main `tabindex="-1"` and scroll-margin-top to clear sticky headers. Place it first in <body>, before the header. SPAs can reuse it to park focus after route changes.

basic.zh: 给站点加一个跳过链接：第一个 Tab 就能跳过顶部导航直达主内容。
basic.en: Add a skip link so the first Tab jumps over the top nav straight to the main content.

design.zh: 页头之前放一个默认隐藏的链接「跳到主内容」，聚焦时出现在左上角、强调色底、对比度达标；激活后焦点落到主内容区，页面不再逐个经过导航项。
design.en: Place a hidden "Skip to main content" link before the header; on focus it surfaces top-left on the accent surface with passing contrast; activating it moves focus into main and spares the user every nav item.

implementation.zh:
跳到主内容 置于 body 首位；CSS 隐藏 clip-path:inset(50%)，:focus 时 clip-path:none + position:fixed 左上角。
。激活后可选 main.focus() 让读屏继续朗读。
implementation.en:
First in body: `Skip to main`. CSS hides it with clip-path:inset(50%), on :focus resets clip-path and pins it top-left. Target `
`; optionally call main.focus() on activation so reading continues there.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现跳过链接。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 链接位于文档流最前，视觉隐藏、聚焦可见
- 激活后焦点与滚动位置落到主内容地标
- 与现有页头/导航结构集成，不改变视觉稿
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a skip link in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse current components.
Requirements:
- Link first in the document, visually hidden until focused
- Activation moves focus and scroll position to the main landmark
- Integrate with the existing header/nav without altering the visual design
Keep the existing visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.

aliases: 点标题展开的那种列表

description.zh: 由多个可折叠区块组成的垂直列表：点击标题展开内容、再点收起，可互斥（同时只开一项） 也可多开。用于在有限空间里收纳成组内容，让用户按需展开。
description.en: A vertical list of collapsible sections: clicking a header expands its content and clicking again collapses it, either exclusively (one open at a time) or independently. Packs grouped content into limited space for on-demand expansion.

use_when.zh: FAQ、帮助中心的分组问题
use_when.en: FAQ and help-centre question groups

use_when.zh: 设置页分组长表单（高级选项默认收起）
use_when.en: Long settings forms with advanced sections collapsed

use_when.zh: 移动端长内容分期呈现
use_when.en: Progressive disclosure of long content on mobile

avoid_when.zh: 用户需要同时对照多块内容
avoid_when.en: Users must compare sections side by side

avoid_when.zh: 核心内容应默认可见（收起会藏关键信息）
avoid_when.en: Essential content should be visible by default

avoid_when.zh: 打印或 SEO 需要全量文本（需处理展开态）
avoid_when.en: Print or SEO needs full text — handle the expanded state

note.zh: 同时只展开一项，最常见
note.en: One open at a time, the common default

note.zh: 各项独立展开收起
note.en: Sections expand independently

note.zh: 每项带边框或分隔线，区块感更强
note.en: Per-item borders or dividers for stronger grouping

notes.zh: 展开动画：grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr 过渡（或测量 scrollHeight 设 max-height）， 箭头 rotate 180° 同步旋转。标题用 button，Enter/Space 触发；aria-expanded + aria-controls 关联面板。互斥逻辑放在受控 state 里处理；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 时可去掉高度动画。
notes.en: Expand animation: transition grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr (or measure scrollHeight into max-height); rotate the chevron 180° in sync. Headers are buttons triggered by Enter/Space; link panels with aria-expanded + aria-controls. Keep the exclusive logic in controlled state; drop the height animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个手风琴（Accordion）组件：多个折叠区块，点击标题展开收起，支持单开与多开两种模式。
basic.en: Create an Accordion component: collapsible sections with click-to-toggle headers, supporting single-open and multiple-open modes.

design.zh: 创建 Accordion 组件。要求：每项标题行左侧标题、右侧箭头（展开时旋转 180°）； 展开收起用高度过渡动画（200ms 左右）；分隔线或卡片式两种外观； 当前项标题可加强调色；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create an Accordion. Requirements: header rows with the title on the left and a chevron on the right (rotating 180° when open); smooth height transition (~200ms); divider or card looks; optional accent tint on the open header; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Accordion：items + openIds 受控 state，单开模式 setOpenId(id)； 面板用 grid grid-rows-[0fr]/[1fr] + transition-[grid-template-rows] 实现高度动画 （时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)），内层 overflow-hidden；箭头 -rotate-90/rotate-0 过渡； 标题 button + aria-expanded + aria-controls；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Accordion: items + openIds controlled state, single-open maps to setOpenId(id); panels animate height via grid grid-rows-[0fr]/[1fr] + transition-[grid-template-rows] (duration scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1)) with an inner overflow-hidden; chevron transitions -rotate-90/rotate-0; headers are buttons with aria-expanded + aria-controls; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现手风琴（Accordion）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色与圆角变量。
用途：FAQ 与设置页分组。
要求：
- 支持单开（互斥）与多开两种模式
- 高度展开动画，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 键盘可用：button 标题 + aria-expanded/aria-controls
- 深浅色主题一致，不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement an Accordion component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface and radius variables.
Usage: FAQs and grouped settings.
Requirements:
- Single-open (exclusive) and multiple-open modes
- Height expand animation, respecting prefers-reduced-motion
- Keyboard accessible: button headers + aria-expanded/aria-controls
- Consistent light/dark themes, no new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 展开与收起不同分组，比较单项和多项展开的阅读节奏。
task.en: Expand different sections and compare the reading flow.

checks.zh: 标题应始终可见，折叠不能让用户失去位置。
checks.en: Keep headings visible when details collapse.

checks.zh: 展开状态通过 aria-expanded 表达，按钮保留焦点。
checks.en: Expose expansion with aria-expanded and retain button focus.

aliases: 表单提交后的错误提示

description.zh: 嵌在页面流内、带状态色底色的横条，用于必须被看见的消息：错误、警告、重要通知。 它占据文档流而不是覆盖内容，通常常驻直到问题被处理或用户手动关闭。
description.en: An inline, status-coloured banner inside the page flow for messages that must be seen: errors, warnings, important notices. It takes layout space instead of overlaying, and stays until the issue is resolved or the user dismisses it.

use_when.zh: 表单提交后的整体错误汇总
use_when.en: A form-level error summary after submit

use_when.zh: 系统级通知（维护、额度将满）
use_when.en: System notices (maintenance, quota nearly full)

use_when.zh: 破坏性操作前的页面内警告
use_when.en: An in-page warning before a destructive action

avoid_when.zh: 轻量的成功反馈（改用 toast）
avoid_when.en: Lightweight success feedback — use a toast

avoid_when.zh: 只与单个字段相关（改用字段内联错误）
avoid_when.en: Field-specific issues — use inline field errors

avoid_when.zh: 多处滥用会稀释注意力，保持克制
avoid_when.en: Overuse dilutes attention — keep alerts rare

disambiguation.zh: Alert 是页内持续显示的状态消息；Toast 是短暂浮层反馈；Modal 是必须处理的打断浮层。
disambiguation.en: An alert is persistent in-page status messaging. A toast is a brief floating confirmation. A modal is a blocking overlay that demands action.

note.zh: Toast 短暂自动消失，Alert 常驻直到状态消除。
note.en: A toast auto-dismisses; an alert stays until the condition clears.

note.zh: Modal 阻断并要求操作，Alert 只告知不打断。
note.en: A modal blocks and demands action; an alert only informs.

note.zh: 中性色，一般通知
note.en: Neutral tone, general notice

note.zh: 确认操作已完成
note.en: Confirms a completed operation

note.zh: 有风险但可以继续
note.en: Risky but continuable

note.zh: 失败或危险，需要处理
note.en: Failed or dangerous, needs handling

打断程度.zh: 中，占据版面可见但不阻断
打断程度.en: Medium — visible in the flow, not blocking

持续性.zh: 高，常驻直到处理或关闭
持续性.en: High — persists until resolved or dismissed

错误定位能力.zh: 中，能说明原因与影响范围

notes.zh: 状态色映射：info/success/warning/error 各配低饱和底色、同色系图标与左侧强调边。 结构：图标 + 标题 + 描述 + 可选操作与关闭。放在出错内容上方或附近，而不是一律堆在页面顶部。 颜色之外必须配图标与文字，避免只靠颜色传达状态。
notes.en: Map status colours: info/success/warning/error each get a low-saturation surface, a matching icon and a left accent border. Structure: icon, title, description, optional actions and close. Place it above or near the offending content rather than always stacking at the top. Never rely on colour alone — pair it with icons and text.

basic.zh: 创建一个警告提示（Alert）组件：带状态色底色的横条，包含图标、标题、说明文本和关闭按钮， 支持 info/success/warning/error 四种状态。
basic.en: Create an Alert component: a status-coloured banner with icon, title, description and a close button, supporting info/success/warning/error.

design.zh: 创建 Alert 组件。要求：低饱和状态色底 + 左侧同色强调边；图标 + 标题 + 描述行 + 右上关闭按钮； 圆角适中，文字对比度达标；常驻显示直到手动关闭；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create an Alert. Requirements: low-saturation status surface with a matching left accent border; icon, title, description line and a top-right close button; moderate radius with accessible text contrast; persistent until dismissed; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Alert：variant 映射到配色对象（surface/border/icon 文本色）； 结构 flex：图标、内容区（标题 + 描述）、可选操作按钮、关闭按钮（aria-label）； 组件受控 visible 或由父层条件渲染；入场可用淡入 keyframes（时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）； role 视状态用 alert（error）或 status。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Alert: variants map to a palette object (surface, border, icon and text colours); flex structure with icon, content (title + description), optional actions and a close button (aria-label); controlled visible state or parent conditional rendering; optional fade-in keyframes scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1); role="alert" for errors, role="status" otherwise.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现警告提示（Alert）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的状态色与语义色变量。
用途：表单错误汇总与系统级通知。
要求：
- 支持 info/success/warning/error 四种状态
- 图标 + 标题 + 描述 + 可选操作与关闭
- 不只靠颜色传达状态（图标 + 文字）
- 常驻显示，不自动消失
- 深浅色主题一致，不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement an Alert component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
status and semantic colour variables.
Usage: form error summaries and system-level notices.
Requirements:
- info/success/warning/error variants
- Icon + title + description + optional actions and close
- Never colour-only: icons and text accompany status
- Persistent, no auto-dismiss
- Consistent light/dark themes, no new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 观察信息、成功、警告与错误提示的层级，尝试关闭可关闭的提示。
task.en: Compare information, success, warning and error messages; try dismissing a dismissible alert.

checks.zh: 关键信息同时用文字表达，不只依赖颜色。
checks.en: Communicate importance with text as well as color.

checks.zh: 阻断任务的错误应说明恢复路径。
checks.en: Blocking errors should explain how to recover.

description.zh: 以圆形或圆角方形小图代表用户或组织：照片、姓名首字母或图标占位。 常与姓名一起出现在导航、评论与成员列表，可附在线状态点或多人叠加。
description.en: A small round or rounded-square image representing a user or organisation: photo, initials or an icon placeholder. Appears with names in navs, comments and member lists; can carry a status dot or stack several people together.

use_when.zh: 用户身份的稳定视觉锚点（导航、评论、成员）
use_when.en: A stable identity anchor (nav, comments, members)

use_when.zh: 无图时用姓名首字母 + 品牌底色兜底
use_when.en: Fall back to initials on brand colours when no image exists

use_when.zh: 群组、多负责人场景做叠加展示
use_when.en: Stacked avatars for teams or multiple owners

avoid_when.zh: 非人格化的系统对象（改用图标）
avoid_when.en: Non-personal system objects — use an icon

avoid_when.zh: 图片本身是内容主体（用完整图片展示）
avoid_when.en: The image is the content — use a full image

avoid_when.zh: 需要展示丰富个人信息（用 profile 页或卡片）
avoid_when.en: Rich personal info needed — use a profile page or card

note.zh: 用户上传的照片，裁切填充
note.en: An uploaded photo, cropped to fill

note.zh: 无图兜底，底色由名字散列固定
note.en: No-photo fallback; colour derived from the name

note.zh: 多人重叠 + 余量计数
note.en: Overlapping members plus an overflow count

notes.zh: 图片用 object-fit: cover 裁切防变形；首字母头像底色由名字散列映射到固定色板， 保证同一个人颜色稳定；状态点 absolute 右下并加描边。尺寸阶梯常用 24/32/40/48px。 图片必须有 alt 文本，纯装饰时用 aria-hidden 或空 alt。
notes.en: Crop photos with object-fit: cover to avoid distortion; hash the name into a fixed palette so a person's initials colour stays stable; status dot absolute at bottom-right with a ring. Common size steps: 24/32/40/48px. Images need alt text; use aria-hidden or empty alt when purely decorative.

basic.zh: 创建一个头像（Avatar）组件：支持图片与首字母两种内容，三档尺寸，可附在线状态点。
basic.en: Create an Avatar component: image and initials content, three size steps, with an optional presence dot.

design.zh: 创建 Avatar 组件。要求：圆形（或圆角方形）裁切；首字母兜底用低饱和底色 + 深色文字， 颜色由名字散列固定；在线状态点右下角带描边；尺寸 24/32/40 三档； 叠加形态 -ml-2 重叠 + 描边分隔；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create an Avatar. Requirements: circular (or rounded-square) crop; initials fallback on a low-saturation surface with dark text, colour hashed from the name; presence dot at bottom-right with a ring; sizes 24/32/40; stacked form overlaps with -ml-2 and ring separation; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Avatar：img + object-cover + rounded-full； 无 src 时渲染 initials（取名字前一字/首字母），底色从调色板数组按 name.charCodeAt 散列取色； 状态点 span absolute bottom-0 right-0 + ring-2 ring-[surface]； sizes 映射到 w/h；叠加组 flex -space-x-2，最后一项显示 +N； 图片 onError 时降级为首字母。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Avatar: img with object-cover rounded-full; without src render initials (first grapheme) on a palette colour picked by name.charCodeAt hash; presence dot as an absolute span bottom-0 right-0 with ring-2 ring-[surface]; sizes map to w/h; stack with flex -space-x-2 and a final +N item; fall back to initials on img error.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现头像（Avatar）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色变量。
用途：导航用户区、评论列表与成员叠加。
要求：
- 图片 / 首字母两种内容，加载失败自动降级
- 首字母颜色按名字散列且稳定
- 尺寸档位 + 可选在线状态点 + 叠加形态
- 可访问性：有意义的 alt，装饰时 aria-hidden
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement an Avatar component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface colour variables.
Usage: nav user area, comment lists, member stacks.
Requirements:
- Image / initials content with automatic fallback on load error
- Stable name-hashed initials colours
- Size steps + optional presence dot + stacked form
- Accessibility: meaningful alt, aria-hidden when decorative
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 比较单人头像、默认头像与叠放头像组。
task.en: Compare individual, fallback and grouped avatars.

checks.zh: 图片缺失时仍能识别姓名或身份。
checks.en: Keep identity recognizable when an image is unavailable.

checks.zh: 头像组超出可见数量时，用计数说明剩余成员。
checks.en: Indicate additional group members with an overflow count.

description.zh: 附着在元素角落或行内的小型状态标记：圆点、数字计数或短文字标签。用于表达未读数量、 状态（新、已废弃）或分类；不参与交互，视觉上从属于宿主元素。
description.en: A small status marker attached to an element's corner or inline: a dot, a count or a short label. It signals unread counts, status (new, deprecated) or category; non-interactive and visually subordinate to its host element.

use_when.zh: 未读消息数、购物车数量
use_when.en: Unread counts, cart quantity

use_when.zh: 行内状态标注（成功、过期、Beta）
use_when.en: Inline status labels (success, expired, beta)

use_when.zh: 图标右上角的小红点提醒
use_when.en: An attention dot on an icon corner

avoid_when.zh: 需要点击响应（那是按钮或标签 chip）
avoid_when.en: It needs to be clickable — use a button or chip

avoid_when.zh: 数值超过上限要截断（99+）并避免频繁跳动
avoid_when.en: Cap large counts (99+) and avoid jitter

avoid_when.zh: 大段文字说明（改用 alert 或正文）
avoid_when.en: Long explanatory text — use an alert or body copy

note.zh: 数字气泡，可 99+ 截断
note.en: Numeric bubble, caps at 99+

note.zh: 无文字纯提醒
note.en: A bare dot for pure attention

note.zh: 有底色的短文字状态
note.en: A short text status on a tinted surface

notes.zh: 宿主 relative，徽标 absolute 定位在 -top/-right 并加与底色一致的描边（ring 或 shadow） 避免融入背景图。数字用 tabular-nums 防宽度抖动，超过 99 显示 99+。 状态色语义固定：红 = 错误或紧急、绿 = 成功、灰 = 中性；颜色之外给 aria-label 说明含义。
notes.en: Host is relative; the badge sits absolute at -top/-right with a ring or shadow matching the surface so it does not bleed into images. Use tabular-nums to stop width jitter and cap at 99+. Keep status colour semantics stable: red = error or urgent, green = success, grey = neutral; convey meaning beyond colour with aria-label.

basic.zh: 创建一个徽标（Badge）组件：支持数字计数、小红点和文字标签三种形态，可附着在图标或按钮角上。
basic.en: Create a Badge component: count, dot and label forms, attachable to icon or button corners.

design.zh: 创建 Badge 组件。要求：计数形态为强调色圆形气泡（白描边、tabular-nums、99+ 截断）； 圆点形态 8px；标签形态低饱和底色 + 同色系文字（success/warning/error/info）； 附着在宿主右上角并与底面留出 2px 描边间隙；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a Badge. Requirements: count form as an accent bubble (white ring, tabular-nums, 99+ cap); dot form at 8px; label form on a low-saturation surface with matching text (success/warning/error/info); anchored to the host's top-right with a 2px ring gap against the surface; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Badge：宿主 relative，徽标 absolute -top-1 -right-1  rounded-full min-w 配 px 撑开两位数，shadow 或 ring-2 ring-[surface] 做描边； 计数 value > 99 显示 "99+"；标签形态用配色映射对象；宿主加 aria-label 描述计数含义； 数值动画用 scale 过渡（时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Badge: relative host, absolute -top-1 -right-1 badge, rounded-full min-w with px to fit two digits, ring-2 ring-[surface] or shadow for the gap; counts over 99 render "99+"; label form uses a palette mapping object; host carries an aria-label describing the count; scale transition on value change (duration scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1)).

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现徽标（Badge）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的状态色变量。
用途：未读计数与状态标注。
要求：
- 计数 / 圆点 / 文字标签三种形态
- 计数 99+ 截断，数字不抖动
- 描边与宿主底色衔接自然，深浅色主题一致
- 不只靠颜色传达（aria-label 或文字）
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Badge component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
status colour variables.
Usage: unread counts and status marking.
Requirements:
- Count / dot / text-label forms
- 99+ cap and jitter-free numbers
- Ring blends with the host surface; consistent light/dark themes
- Never colour-only (aria-label or text)
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 比较状态标记与数字角标，注意它们和主内容的关系。
task.en: Compare status labels and count badges in relation to primary content.

checks.zh: 状态名称短而准确，不能只显示一个色点。
checks.en: Use a concise status label instead of only a colored dot.

checks.zh: 较大计数应保持角标尺寸稳定。
checks.en: Large counts should not destabilize badge dimensions.

aliases: 手机底部弹出来的面板

description.zh: 从屏幕底边升起、覆盖在当前页面之上的面板，顶部有抓手可供拖动或下滑关闭。打断程度介于模态框与 气泡卡片之间：有遮罩但拇指可及、可下滑快速收起。是移动端承接筛选、分享、短表单的默认容器， 桌面端应改用侧边抽屉或居中对话框。
description.en: A panel that rises from the bottom edge over the current page, with a grabber for dragging or swipe-to-dismiss. Its interruption level sits between a modal and a popover: there is a backdrop, yet it is thumb-reachable and collapses on a downward swipe. The default mobile container for filters, sharing and short forms; on desktop prefer a side drawer or centered dialog.

disambiguation.zh: 「抽屉」有歧义：底部抽屉（Bottom Sheet）指从底边升起的面板；侧边抽屉（Drawer）从左右边缘滑入； 系统对话框的 sheet 是居中弹出的文档式窗口；表格软件的 sheet 则指工作表，与浮层无关。
disambiguation.en: "Sheet" is overloaded: a bottom sheet rises from the bottom edge; a drawer slides from a side edge; a macOS window sheet drops down inside a window; a spreadsheet sheet is a worksheet and has nothing to do with overlays.

use_when.zh: 移动端筛选、排序、分享等短任务，需覆盖在当前页上
use_when.en: Short mobile tasks — filter, sort, share — layered over the current page

use_when.zh: 操作列表或选项数量有限，单手拇指可达
use_when.en: A short action or option list that one thumb can reach

use_when.zh: 内容比一行 tooltip 多、比整页流程短
use_when.en: More content than a one-line tooltip, less than a full-page flow

avoid_when.zh: 桌面端为主的界面（改用 drawer 或 modal）
avoid_when.en: Desktop-first interfaces — use a drawer or modal

avoid_when.zh: 需要强制决策、不可轻易关闭（改用 modal）
avoid_when.en: A forced decision that must not be dismissed casually — use a modal

avoid_when.zh: 长表单或长篇阅读（改为全屏页面更稳）
avoid_when.en: Long forms or long reads — a full page holds up better

note.zh: 内容量可预期，一次到位不拖拽
note.en: Predictable content size — lands in one shot, no dragging

note.zh: 抓手拖到半开 / 全开档位，iOS Sheet 风格
note.en: Grabber drags between half and full detents, iOS-sheet style

note.zh: 上拉占满屏幕，适合长内容或键盘弹出
note.en: Pulls up to full screen for long content or on-screen keyboards

note.zh: 侧边抽屉从左右边缘滑入，底部抽屉只从底边升起。
note.en: A drawer slides from a side edge; a bottom sheet only rises from the bottom.

note.zh: 模态框居中且强调强制决策；底部抽屉贴底、可下滑关闭。
note.en: A modal sits centered and demands a decision; a bottom sheet hugs the bottom and swipes away.

task.zh: 打开底部抽屉，拖动抓手在档位间切换，再下滑关闭，感受它与侧边抽屉的差别。
task.en: Open the sheet, drag the grabber between detents and swipe down to dismiss; feel how it differs from a side drawer.

checks.zh: 下滑或点遮罩可关闭，Esc 同样有效
checks.en: A downward swipe or backdrop tap dismisses; Esc works too

checks.zh: 面板贴底升起，操作按钮落在拇指热区
checks.en: The panel rises from the bottom edge with actions in the thumb zone

打断程度.zh: 中高，有遮罩但可下滑快速关闭
打断程度.en: Medium-high — backdrop blocks, but a swipe dismisses fast

内容容量.zh: 中高，适合操作列表与短表单
内容容量.en: Medium-high — action lists and short forms fit

移动端友好.zh: 优，拇指热区在屏幕底部
移动端友好.en: Excellent — the thumb zone is the bottom of the screen

notes.zh: 面板 fixed 贴底，用 transform: translateY(100%) ↔ 0 收放（不要动 height，GPU 友好）； 顶部抓手为 36×4 圆角条。拖拽档位用 pointer 事件跟踪 dy，松手按阈值吸附到最近档位； 下滑超过阈值关闭。遮罩淡入、body 滚动锁定、焦点移入面板，Esc 关闭；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Pin the panel with fixed positioning and animate transform: translateY(100%) ↔ 0 to show and hide (never animate height — GPU-friendly); the grabber is a 36×4 rounded bar. Detents track dy via pointer events and snap to the nearest stop on release; a swipe past the threshold dismisses. Fade the backdrop in, lock body scroll, move focus into the panel, close on Esc; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个底部抽屉（Bottom Sheet）组件：点击按钮从屏幕底部升起面板，带抓手和遮罩，可下滑关闭。
basic.en: Create a Bottom Sheet: a button raises a panel from the bottom of the screen with a grabber and backdrop; a downward swipe closes it.

design.zh: 创建底部抽屉：圆角顶边 + 顶部居中抓手，半透明遮罩；标题行 + 可滚动内容 + 吸底操作按钮； 上滑 / 下滑关闭动画 240ms；抓手可拖到半开与全开两档；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a bottom sheet: rounded top corners with a centered grabber over a translucent backdrop; a title row, scrollable body and pinned footer action; 240ms rise and dismiss animation; the grabber drags between half and full detents; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Bottom Sheet：open 受控；面板 fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0， transform translateY 过渡（时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）；抓手 pointerdown 起拖， 松手按阈值吸附档位或关闭；role="dialog" aria-modal="true"，焦点移入、Esc 与点遮罩关闭； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。无新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind bottom sheet: controlled open state; a fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 panel transitioning transform translateY (duration scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1)); the grabber starts a pointer drag and snaps to a detent or dismisses past a threshold; role="dialog" aria-modal="true", focus moves in, Esc and backdrop click close; respect prefers-reduced-motion. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现一个 Bottom Sheet 底部抽屉组件。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
与侧边 Drawer、居中 Modal 明确区分，只从底边升起。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，支持键盘与拖拽操作。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Bottom Sheet component in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Keep it distinct from side drawers and centered modals — it only rises from the bottom edge.
Keep the project's visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; support keyboard and drag interaction.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.

aliases: 首页大于分类那种路径

description.zh: 用"首页 / 分类 / 子类 / 当前页"的层级路径表示用户在信息架构中所处的位置： 每个上级都可点击跳回，末项为当前页不可点。这是防止用户迷路成本最低的手段， 命名源自童话中沿途撒下用来标记归路的面包屑。常置于页面标题上方。
description.en: A hierarchical path like "Home / Library / Page" that states where the user sits in the information architecture: every ancestor is a link back, and the last item marks the current page. The cheapest way to keep users oriented — the name comes from the breadcrumbs Hansel dropped to find his way home. Usually placed above the page title.

use_when.zh: 层级深于两层的内容型站点（文档、电商类目）
use_when.en: Content sites deeper than two levels — docs, category trees

use_when.zh: 用户可能从搜索或外链直达深层页面
use_when.en: Users land on deep pages from search or external links

use_when.zh: 需要低成本的逐级回退路径
use_when.en: A cheap path to walk back level by level

avoid_when.zh: 扁平单层的应用，面包屑只是噪音
avoid_when.en: Flat single-level apps — it is pure noise

avoid_when.zh: 无稳定层级的个性化信息流
avoid_when.en: Personalized feeds without a stable hierarchy

avoid_when.zh: 移动端空间极紧且层级浅（可省略）
avoid_when.en: Tight mobile screens with shallow levels — can be omitted

note.zh: 纯文本链接 + 分隔符，最常见
note.en: Plain links + separator, the default

note.zh: 根节点用房子图标、项前加小图标
note.en: Home icon at the root, small icons per item

note.zh: 中间层级折叠为省略号，可展开
note.en: Middle levels collapse into an expandable ellipsis

notes.zh: 用 nav[aria-label="面包屑"] + 有序列表实现，层级用 ol/li 表达；分隔符用 CSS ::before 或独立 span，勿放进链接的可点击区域。当前页加 aria-current="page" 且渲染为纯文本。过长时中间层级折叠为可展开的省略号， 容器单行省略。
notes.en: Build with nav[aria-label="Breadcrumb"] and an ordered list; render separators via CSS ::before or a dedicated span — never inside the link target. The last item is plain text with aria-current="page". For deep paths collapse middle levels into an expandable ellipsis and keep the container single-line with ellipsis overflow.

basic.zh: 创建一个面包屑导航组件：显示"首页 / 分类 / 当前页"层级路径，上级可点击返回，末项为当前页。
basic.en: Create a breadcrumb that shows a "Home / Category / Current" path where ancestors link back and the last item is the current page.

design.zh: 创建面包屑：小号文字（12～13px），层级间用 "/" 或 ">" 分隔符；根节点带小房子 图标；上级为次级色链接、hover 变强调色；当前页为纯文本主色并加 aria-current。 层级很多时中间折叠为省略号。深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a breadcrumb: small text (12–13px), "/" or ">" separators; a home icon at the root; ancestors in secondary color that accent on hover; the current page as plain primary text with aria-current. Collapse middle levels into an ellipsis for deep paths. Consistent in light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React 实现 Breadcrumb：nav + ol/li 语义结构；items 数据驱动，末项自动渲染 为纯文本并加 aria-current="page"；分隔符独立于链接；提供 maxItems 属性实现 中间省略折叠（点击展开）。单行溢出省略。无新增依赖。
implementation.en: React breadcrumb: nav + ol/li semantics; data-driven items whose last entry renders as plain text with aria-current="page"; separators outside the link targets; a maxItems prop folds middle levels into an expandable ellipsis. Single-line overflow with ellipsis. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现面包屑导航。

先检查现有路由结构，确认能否从路由元数据推导层级。
要求：
- nav + ol 语义结构，aria-label="面包屑"
- 上级可点击返回，当前页 aria-current="page" 且不可点
- 层级超过 5 层时中间折叠为可展开省略号
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion（展开无动画突变即可）
- 不新增不必要的依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement breadcrumbs in the current project.

Check the existing routing structure first; derive hierarchy from route metadata if possible.
Requirements:
- nav + ol semantics with aria-label="Breadcrumb"
- Ancestors link back; current page is non-clickable with aria-current="page"
- Beyond 5 levels fold the middle into an expandable ellipsis
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion (an instant expand is fine)
- No unnecessary dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 点击上级层级，比较短路径与多层路径的定位能力。
task.en: Inspect ancestor navigation and compare short and deep paths.

checks.zh: 最后一项表示当前位置，通常不需要再次导航。
checks.en: The last item indicates the current location and usually needs no link.

checks.zh: 窄屏不能让路径挤出页面。
checks.en: Keep long paths within the narrow viewport.

description.zh: 用可点击的色块触发一个明确的动作，是界面中最基础的操作入口。 通过填充、描边、幽灵等视觉层级区分主次操作，按压时有即时的下沉反馈， 繁忙时进入加载态并禁用点击，防止重复提交。
description.en: A clickable block that triggers one clear action — the most basic interactive element of any interface. Fill, outline and ghost styles rank primary against secondary actions; presses give instant sink-in feedback, and a busy state disables further clicks to prevent double submission.

use_when.zh: 需要用户主动触发一个明确动作（提交、创建、确认）
use_when.en: A user-initiated action such as submit, create or confirm

use_when.zh: 同一区域存在主次多个操作，需要视觉分层
use_when.en: Multiple actions coexist and need visual hierarchy

use_when.zh: 操作会改变数据或状态，需要防止误触与重复提交
use_when.en: The action mutates data and must guard against double submits

avoid_when.zh: 动作只是导航到另一页，用链接更符合预期
avoid_when.en: Pure navigation — a link matches expectations better

avoid_when.zh: 操作可逆且频繁切换，用开关或复选框更合适
avoid_when.en: Frequently toggled reversible state — use a switch or checkbox

avoid_when.zh: 一屏内大量重复的次要操作，弱化为文字按钮避免视觉噪音
avoid_when.en: Many repeated secondary actions — demote to text buttons to cut noise

note.zh: 实心填充，一屏内主操作唯一
note.en: Solid fill — the single primary action per view

note.zh: 描边样式，与主操作并列
note.en: Outlined style, paired with the primary

note.zh: 无边框纯文字，弱化视觉重量
note.en: Borderless text-only, minimal visual weight

note.zh: 不可逆操作的警示色
note.en: Warning color for irreversible actions

强度.en: Low to medium — a subtle sink is enough

适合元素.zh: 按钮 / 小尺寸可点块

notes.zh: 用 transition 让颜色与阴影平滑变化，按压瞬间加 scale(0.97) 下沉； focus-visible 描边保证键盘可达；加载态将文字替换为 spinner 并 disabled， 保留按钮宽度避免布局跳动。触控目标高度不小于 44px。
notes.en: Transition colors and shadows smoothly; add scale(0.97) on the press frame. Keep a focus-visible ring for keyboard access. In the busy state swap the label for a spinner while disabled, preserving width to avoid layout shift. Touch targets should be at least 44px tall.

basic.zh: 创建一个按钮组件，支持主要、次要、幽灵、危险四种样式和加载状态。
basic.en: Create a button component with primary, secondary, ghost and danger styles plus a loading state.

design.zh: 创建按钮组件。要求：四种层级（实心主按钮、描边次按钮、幽灵文字按钮、危险按钮）， 按压有轻微下沉反馈，加载时显示 spinner 并禁用点击且保持宽度不变， 支持 icon 前置位，深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a button component. Requirements: four levels (solid primary, outlined secondary, ghost text, danger), a subtle press-down feedback, a loading state with spinner that disables clicks and preserves width, optional leading icon, consistent in light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Button：variant 与 size 走映射表；disabled 与 loading 合并控制 pointer-events；点击反馈用 active:scale-[0.97] + transition；加载态渲染 spinner 并保留 min-width；支持 asChild 或 as="a" 复用到链接场景。 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion（去掉位移类动画）。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Button: variant and size via lookup maps; disabled and loading merged into pointer control; press feedback with active:scale-[0.97] and transition; busy state renders a spinner and keeps min-width; support an anchor variant for link use. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现按钮组件。

先检查现有的 Design Token 与按钮类样式，优先复用现有颜色与圆角变量。
要求：
- 主要 / 次要 / 幽灵 / 危险四种样式
- 按压反馈与 focus-visible 键盘焦点样式
- 加载态：spinner + disabled + 宽度不变
- 深浅色主题一致，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a button component in the current project.

Inspect the existing design tokens and button-like styles first; reuse existing color and radius variables.
Requirements:
- Primary / secondary / ghost / danger variants
- Press feedback and a focus-visible keyboard focus style
- Loading state: spinner + disabled + unchanged width
- Consistent light/dark themes, respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 在本地模拟中点击保存，处理中取消，再用键盘重试；比较六种风格和四种按钮层级。
task.en: Save in the local simulation, cancel while pending, then retry with the keyboard. Compare six styles and four button levels.

checks.zh: 同一区域通常只有一个最突出的主操作。
checks.en: Usually give one action the strongest emphasis in a region.

checks.zh: 处理中的操作应防止重复触发并保留结果反馈。
checks.en: Prevent duplicate activation while processing and show the result.

checks.zh: 取消处理中操作后，旧完成回调不能再显示成功；仍可重新尝试。
checks.en: Cancelling a pending action must suppress late success callbacks and allow retry.

checks.zh: Enter / Space 与点击触发相同的行为，焦点可见，触控目标不小于 44px。
checks.en: Enter / Space and pointer activation trigger the same behavior, with visible focus and touch targets at least 44px tall.

description.zh: 用圆角边框或底色围出一块自包含内容的矩形容器，一块卡片聚合一组相关信息： 封面图、标题、摘要与操作。是内容流、仪表盘与电商列表的通用显示单元。
description.en: A self-contained rectangular container outlined by rounded borders or a surface colour, aggregating related content: cover, title, excerpt and actions. The universal display unit of content feeds, dashboards and commerce lists.

use_when.zh: 封面图 + 标题 + 摘要的流式内容展示
use_when.en: Feed items with cover, title and excerpt

use_when.zh: 仪表盘中并列的多块摘要指标
use_when.en: Side-by-side metric summaries on a dashboard

use_when.zh: 可点击跳转的聚合入口（商品、文章、项目）
use_when.en: Clickable aggregate entries (product, article, project)

avoid_when.zh: 需要逐行精确对齐比较（改用 table）
avoid_when.en: Row-aligned comparison matters — use a table

avoid_when.zh: 密度极高的数据展示（改用 table）
avoid_when.en: Very high-density data — use a table

avoid_when.zh: 纯装饰性包裹会稀释信息，宁可用留白分隔
avoid_when.en: Purely decorative wrapping dilutes content — prefer whitespace

note.zh: 边框或浅底 + 内容，最通用
note.en: Border or surface plus content, the general case

note.zh: 顶部图片 + 内容区
note.en: Top image above a content area

note.zh: 整卡可点，hover 抬升或边框强调
note.en: Whole card clickable with hover lift or border emphasis

可扫描性.zh: 中，视觉引导好但占空间

notes.zh: 卡片 = 容器（圆角、边框或阴影）+ 内边距 + 可选分区（媒体区、内容区、操作区）。 整卡可点时用 a 或 button 包裹，hover 给边框变色或轻微上浮反馈； 图片区固定宽高比（aspect-ratio）防止加载后布局跳动。
notes.en: Card = container (radius, border or shadow) + padding + optional sections (media, content, actions). For a clickable card wrap it in an a or button and give hover feedback (border colour or slight lift); fix the media area's aspect-ratio to prevent layout shift after images load.

basic.zh: 创建一个卡片（Card）组件：圆角边框容器，包含封面图、标题、描述和操作按钮。
basic.en: Create a Card component: a rounded bordered container with a cover image, title, description and action buttons.

design.zh: 创建 Card 组件。要求：圆角 + 细边框（或浅底），内边距一致；可选媒体区固定 16:9； 标题加粗、描述两行截断；hover 时边框变强调色或轻微上浮（120ms）；支持整卡可点与底部操作区两种形态。
design.en: Create a Card. Requirements: rounded corners with a hairline border (or soft surface), consistent padding; optional 16:9 media area; bold title, two-line clamped description; hover shifts the border to accent or lifts slightly (120ms); both whole-card-click and footer-action forms.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Card：article/容器 rounded-xl border bg-raised； 媒体区 aspect-video overflow-hidden；描述 line-clamp-2；整卡可点时外层 a/button + transition hover:border-accent hover:shadow，注意嵌套可点元素的语义冲突； 支持 as prop 定制元素；时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Card: rounded-xl border bg-raised container; media area with aspect-video overflow-hidden; description with line-clamp-2; for whole-card click wrap in an a/button with transition hover:border-accent hover:shadow and mind nested interactive semantics; support an as prop; durations scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1).

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现卡片（Card）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色、圆角与阴影变量。
用途：内容流与仪表盘摘要。
要求：
- 容器 + 可选媒体区 + 标题/描述 + 操作区
- 支持整卡可点（注意语义与嵌套交互）
- hover 反馈克制，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 深浅色主题一致，不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Card component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface, radius and shadow variables.
Usage: content feeds and dashboard summaries.
Requirements:
- Container + optional media + title/description + action row
- Optional whole-card click (mind semantics and nested interactives)
- Restrained hover feedback, respecting prefers-reduced-motion
- Consistent light/dark themes, no new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 查看卡片中的标题、内容与操作，比较不同布局。
task.en: Explore the title, content and actions across card layouts.

checks.zh: 整个卡片可点时，内部操作应避免嵌套链接。
checks.en: Avoid nested links when the entire card is clickable.

checks.zh: 标题、辅助信息与操作需要清楚的层级。
checks.en: Separate title, supporting information and actions clearly.

description.zh: 用水平滑动的轨道展示一组内容，同一时刻只突出一项，其余滑出视野或露出边缘作暗示。通过分页点、 箭头或自动播放切换，常用于首屏 Banner、图片画廊与推荐位。适合「一组同类内容、逐个浏览」的场景， 不适合需要并排对照的信息。
description.en: A horizontally scrolling track of items where one slide takes focus at a time and the rest slide out or peek at the edge as a hint. Switching uses dots, arrows or autoplay — common in hero banners, image galleries and recommendation rails. Fits "browse one item after another" content, not information that must be compared side by side.

use_when.zh: 一组同类内容需要逐个浏览（Banner、图集、推荐位）
use_when.en: A set of similar items browsed one at a time (banner, gallery, rails)

use_when.zh: 横向空间有限，又想保留「还有更多」的暗示
use_when.en: Horizontal space is tight but you still want a "more exists" cue

use_when.zh: 图片或卡片为主、文字说明简短
use_when.en: Image- or card-led slides with brief captions

avoid_when.zh: 用户需要并排对照多个项目（用卡片网格或表格）
avoid_when.en: Users must compare items side by side — use a card grid or table

avoid_when.zh: 内容只有三五条且全部重要（直接平铺，别藏起来）
avoid_when.en: Only three to five equally important items — lay them out flat

avoid_when.zh: 关键操作或表单藏在某一页里（切换会打断任务）
avoid_when.en: Critical actions or forms hidden on one slide — switching breaks the task

note.zh: 底部小圆点指示位置，点按直达，最省空间
note.en: Small dots mark position and jump directly — the most compact

note.zh: 左右箭头逐步切换，桌面端最常见
note.en: Prev/next arrows step through slides — the desktop default

note.zh: 定时前进，悬停或聚焦暂停；必须提供暂停入口
note.en: Timed advance with pause on hover or focus — a pause control is required

task.zh: 用键盘或箭头浏览完所有项目，观察焦点是否被正确管理。
task.en: Browse every item with arrows or keyboard; check focus is managed.

checks.zh: 切换后当前项有可见指示
checks.en: Current item is visibly indicated after switching

checks.zh: 键盘左右键可切换
checks.en: Left/Right keys switch slides

notes.zh: 轨道用 overflow-x: auto + scroll-snap-type: x mandatory，项目 scroll-snap-align: center， 纯 CSS 即可滑动；控件切换则用 transform: translateX(-index * 100%)。当前项用 aria-hidden 或 inert 降低朗读噪音，容器标 aria-roledescription="carousel"，切换时 aria-live="polite" 播报「第 n / N 项」。自动播放必须提供暂停按钮，并在 prefers-reduced-motion 下关闭。
notes.en: The track uses overflow-x: auto with scroll-snap-type: x mandatory and items set scroll-snap-align: center so pure CSS scrolling works; control-driven switching animates transform: translateX(-index * 100%). Mark off-screen items aria-hidden or inert to cut screen-reader noise, label the region aria-roledescription="carousel", and announce "n of N" via aria-live="polite" on change. Autoplay needs a pause control and must shut off under prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个轮播组件：水平滑动的轨道展示多个项目，用分页点和左右箭头切换。
basic.en: Create a carousel: a horizontally scrolling track of items switched by dots and left/right arrows.

design.zh: 创建轮播：轨道露出下一张边缘作暗示，当前项完整可见；底部分页点（当前项用主色加宽）， 左右箭头半透明悬浮在两侧，悬停显形；切换有 300ms 滑动过渡；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a carousel: the track peeks the next slide as a hint while the current slide sits fully in view; dot pagination below (active dot stretches in the accent color); translucent arrows float at the sides and sharpen on hover; 300ms slide transition; consistent in light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Carousel：activeIndex 受控；轨道 flex + overflow-hidden， 内层 translateX 过渡（时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）；分页点与箭头同步 activeIndex； 键盘左右键切换，容器 role="group" + aria-roledescription="carousel"；自动播放用 setInterval，悬停/聚焦/暂停按钮停止；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。无新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind carousel: controlled activeIndex; a flex track with overflow-hidden and an inner translateX transition (duration scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1)); dots and arrows stay in sync with activeIndex; Left/Right keys switch, the container uses role="group" plus aria-roledescription="carousel"; autoplay via setInterval, stopped on hover, focus or the pause button; respect prefers-reduced-motion. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现一个 Carousel 轮播组件。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，支持键盘操作。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Carousel component in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Keep the project's visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and support keyboard operation.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 用方形勾选框表示一组可多选的独立开关项，点击在选中与未选中间切换。 父级项可呈现半选态（部分子项选中），常用于批量选择、筛选与同意条款。
description.en: Square toggles for a set of independently selectable items, flipping between checked and unchecked on click. A parent can show an indeterminate state when only some children are checked — used for bulk selection, filters and consent.

use_when.zh: 多个选项可以同时选中、互不影响
use_when.en: Multiple options can be selected independently

use_when.zh: 批量操作前勾选列表项
use_when.en: Checking list items before a bulk action

use_when.zh: 「同意条款」等单条独立确认
use_when.en: Single standalone confirmations like agreeing to terms

avoid_when.zh: 选项互斥只能选一个，用 radio
avoid_when.en: Mutually exclusive choice — use radios

avoid_when.zh: 即时生效的开关型设置，用 switch 更直观
avoid_when.en: Immediate-effect on/off settings — a switch is clearer

avoid_when.zh: 选项超过约 15 个且需检索，改用可搜索的多选下拉
avoid_when.en: More than ~15 options needing search — use a searchable multi-select

note.zh: 一条独立确认项
note.en: One standalone item

note.zh: 多项并列可全选
note.en: Parallel items, bulk-checkable

note.zh: 父级横线态表示部分选中
note.en: Parent dash state for partial selection

notes.zh: 自定义样式时隐藏原生 appearance，用伪元素或内联 SVG 绘制对勾， 选中态用 accent 底 + 白色勾，过渡 scale 弹入；半选态画横线。 原生快速方案直接用 accent-color。整行 label 可点击，热区不小于 24px。 半选由 JS 控制父级 ref 的 indeterminate 属性。
notes.en: For custom styling hide the native appearance and draw the check with a pseudo-element or inline SVG — accent fill with a white check scaling in; the indeterminate state draws a dash. The quick native route is accent-color. Make the whole label row clickable with a ≥ 24px hit area; drive the parent's indeterminate property from JS.

basic.zh: 创建一个复选框组件，支持单项、分组全选与半选状态。
basic.en: Create a checkbox component supporting single items, group select-all and an indeterminate state.

design.zh: 创建复选框组件。要求：圆角方框，选中 accent 底 + 白色对勾弹入动画； 父级「全选」在子项部分选中时显示半选横线；整行可点击；深浅色一致。
design.en: Create a checkbox component. Requirements: rounded square box, accent fill with a white check scaling in on select; a parent "select all" showing a dash when children are partially checked; full-row clickable; consistent in light/dark.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Checkbox：受控 checked 与 onChange；自定义框用 peer + 伪元素或内联 SVG 对勾（scale 过渡，时长乘 --demo-speed）；父级 ref 上 通过 effect 设置 indeterminate；键盘空格可切换，label 用 htmlFor 关联。 分组数据驱动（{label, children}）。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Checkbox: controlled checked and onChange; custom box with peer + pseudo-element or inline SVG check (scale transition multiplied by --demo-speed); set the parent's indeterminate via effect on its ref; space-bar toggling and htmlFor label association. Groups are data-driven ({label, children}).

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现复选框组件。

先检查现有表单组件与颜色变量，保持一致。
要求：
- 受控 checked，支持单项 / 分组 / 半选
- 对勾选中动画尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 键盘可达（空格切换，label 关联）
- 深浅色主题一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a checkbox component in the current project.

Inspect existing form components and color variables first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Controlled checked; single / group / indeterminate support
- Check animation respecting prefers-reduced-motion
- Keyboard accessible (space to toggle, label association)
- Consistent light/dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 勾选与取消多个选项，观察选择结果。
task.en: Select and clear several independent options.

checks.zh: 多项可同时选择，不要用它表达互斥值。
checks.en: Allow independent choices; do not use checkboxes for exclusive values.

checks.zh: 文字标签与方框应共享点击目标。
checks.en: Make the label and box share a click target.

description.zh: 用于选定颜色值的控件，形式包括色板网格、渐变取色区加色相滑杆，或直接调用系统取色器。输出十六进制、RGB 或 OKLCH 等颜色值，常与文本输入、透明度滑杆组合；设计工具与主题配置中最常见。
description.en: A control for choosing a colour, taking the form of a swatch grid, a gradient canvas with hue sliders, or the OS picker. It outputs hex, RGB or OKLCH values and often pairs with a text field and an opacity slider. Most at home in design tools and theme settings.

use_when.zh: 用户需要指定品牌色、主题色或标注色
use_when.en: People must specify a brand, theme or annotation colour

use_when.zh: 预设色板足够覆盖需求
use_when.en: A preset palette already covers the need

use_when.zh: 需要精确微调色相、饱和度与透明度
use_when.en: Hue, saturation and opacity need precise tuning

avoid_when.zh: 只在几个固定色中选择，用 segmented-control 或 radio
avoid_when.en: Only a few fixed colours are allowed — segmented control or radios

avoid_when.zh: 颜色是结果展示而非输入，用 badge 或色块展示
avoid_when.en: Colour is output to display, not input — use a badge or swatch

avoid_when.zh: 亮度或数值调节，用 slider 更直接
avoid_when.en: Adjusting brightness or a numeric level — a slider is more direct

note.zh: 预设色块平铺，点击即选，决策最快
note.en: Preset swatches laid out flat — the fastest decision

note.zh: 渐变面加色相与透明滑杆，可自由取色
note.en: Gradient canvas plus hue and alpha sliders for freeform picking

note.zh: input[type=color] 调用系统取色器，零维护
note.en: input[type=color] defers to the OS picker with zero maintenance

task.zh: 从色板取一色，再到取色区微调色相，并复制颜色值。
task.en: Take a colour from the swatches, refine its hue on the canvas and copy the value.

checks.zh: 颜色值可编辑且与预览保持同步
checks.en: The colour value is editable and stays in sync with the preview

checks.zh: 透明度或对比度不足时有可见反馈
checks.en: Low opacity or contrast issues surface visible feedback

note.zh: slider 调节单一数值维度，color-picker 在颜色空间中定位一点
note.en: Slider tunes one numeric axis; color-picker locates a point in colour space

note.zh: input 接受任意文本，color-picker 保证输出合法颜色值
note.en: Input accepts any text; color-picker guarantees a valid colour value

disambiguation.zh: 「取色」有时指吸管工具从屏幕拾取颜色；本词条专指供用户选定颜色值的表单控件，吸管只是其中一个来源。
disambiguation.en: Picking colour sometimes means an eyedropper sampling the screen; this entry covers the form control that outputs a colour value, with the eyedropper as just one source.

notes.zh: 取色区用两层 linear-gradient（白到透明、透明到黑）叠在纯色背景上模拟 HSV 面；滑杆用原生 range 配渐变轨道。颜色值输出建议同时提供十六进制与 OKLCH 文本框，切换时保持同一颜色。预览块与文字对比不足时给出提示。
notes.en: Build the canvas from two linear-gradient layers (white-to-transparent over transparent-to-black) on a solid hue field to fake HSV; style native range inputs with gradient tracks. Offer both hex and OKLCH text fields that stay on the same colour when switching. Warn when the preview swatch and its label lack contrast.

basic.zh: 创建一个色彩选择器，可从色板或取色区选定颜色，并输出十六进制值。
basic.en: Create a color picker that chooses a colour from swatches or a canvas and outputs a hex value.

design.zh: 设计色彩选择器。要求：取色区与滑杆分区清楚；当前色大块预览并显示色值；色板提供常用预设；可直接键入色值并即时预览；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Design a color picker. Requirements: separate the canvas from the sliders clearly; show a large current-colour preview with its value; offer common presets as swatches; accept typed values with live preview; consistent light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现色彩选择器：内部统一存为 HSLA，向外输出 hex 与 OKLCH；取色区用叠加 linear-gradient 与指针事件换算饱和度/明度；色相与透明度用 range input，accent-color 跟随当前色；文本框受控并容错解析。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind color picker: hold state as HSLA internally and emit hex plus OKLCH; overlay linear-gradients on the canvas and map pointer events to saturation and lightness; drive hue and alpha with range inputs whose accent-color follows the current colour; keep the text field controlled and parse leniently.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现色彩选择器（Color Picker）组件。
先检查现有表单控件与 Design Token，优先复用滑杆、输入框与色板样式。
用途：品牌色、主题色与标注色的选定。
要求：
- 提供色板与取色区两种取色方式
- 颜色值可键入且与预览同步
- 输出合法颜色值（hex / OKLCH）
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，支持键盘操作
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Color Picker component in the current project.
Inspect existing form controls and design tokens first and reuse slider, input and swatch styles.
Usage: choosing brand, theme and annotation colours.
Requirements:
- Offer both swatch and canvas ways to pick
- Typed colour values stay in sync with the preview
- Emit valid colour values (hex / OKLCH)
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion and support keyboard operation
- No new dependencies
Run the existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 把文本输入和候选选项组合在一起的选择组件。用户可以输入关键词缩小范围，再通过鼠标或键盘确定一个值。输入文本、当前高亮项和最终选中值是不同状态；当没有匹配项时，应解释结果并允许清空重选。它适合选项较多、用户又可能记得部分名称的场景。
description.en: A text field paired with a list of suggestions. People type to narrow a set, then commit a value with pointer or keyboard. Typed text, the active suggestion and the committed selection are separate states. Provide a clear empty result and a way to clear the field when nothing matches.

use_when.zh: 从较多城市、成员或风格中选择已知选项。
use_when.en: Choose a city, team member or style from a sizable known set.

use_when.zh: 需要在输入中快速筛选并保留明确选中值。
use_when.en: Filter while typing while preserving a clear committed value.

avoid_when.zh: 只有两三个选项，使用 radio 更直接。
avoid_when.en: Use radios for only two or three choices.

avoid_when.zh: 允许任意输入且没有候选数据，使用普通输入框。
avoid_when.en: Use a plain input when there is no suggestion set.

note.zh: 键入关键词过滤候选项。
note.en: Type to filter suggestions.

note.zh: 选项固定，通过菜单选择。
note.en: Choose a fixed value without free-form input.

notes.zh: 焦点留在输入框，用 aria-activedescendant 指向当前选项。配合 aria-expanded、aria-controls、listbox 和 option 表达结构。支持方向键、Enter、Escape，输入变化时重置高亮索引。
notes.en: Keep focus in the input and point aria-activedescendant at the active option. Connect aria-expanded, aria-controls, listbox and option semantics. Support arrows, Enter and Escape, and reset the active index when filtering changes.

task.zh: 输入一个关键词筛选风格，用方向键与 Enter 选择，再尝试无结果和清空。
task.en: Type a keyword, choose with arrows and Enter, then try no results and clear the selection.

checks.zh: 键盘高亮必须指向仍存在的候选项。
checks.en: The active descendant must reference an existing option.

checks.zh: 清空后恢复全部选项，Esc 只关闭列表。
checks.en: Clearing restores options; Escape closes the list.

basic.zh: 创建可搜索选择框组件。从较多城市、成员或风格中选择已知选项。
basic.en: Create a Combobox component. Choose a city, team member or style from a sizable known set.

design.zh: 设计可搜索选择框，以清楚的层级、可见的状态和明确的反馈为优先。键入关键词过滤候选项。选项固定，通过菜单选择。键盘高亮必须指向仍存在的候选项。清空后恢复全部选项，Esc 只关闭列表。
design.en: Design a Combobox with clear hierarchy and state feedback. Type to filter suggestions. Choose a fixed value without free-form input. The active descendant must reference an existing option. Clearing restores options; Escape closes the list.

implementation.zh: 焦点留在输入框，用 aria-activedescendant 指向当前选项。配合 aria-expanded、aria-controls、listbox 和 option 表达结构。支持方向键、Enter、Escape，输入变化时重置高亮索引。
implementation.en: Keep focus in the input and point aria-activedescendant at the active option. Connect aria-expanded, aria-controls, listbox and option semantics. Support arrows, Enter and Escape, and reset the active index when filtering changes.

agent.zh:
先检查当前项目的组件与样式体系，复用已有能力实现可搜索选择框。
要求：
- 焦点留在输入框，用 aria-activedescendant 指向当前选项。配合 aria-expanded、aria-controls、listbox 和 option 表达结构。支持方向键、Enter、Escape，输入变化时重置高亮索引。
- 键盘高亮必须指向仍存在的候选项。
- 清空后恢复全部选项，Esc 只关闭列表。
- 窄屏可用，深浅色一致，尊重 reduced-motion。
- 不新增依赖。
运行项目现有检查，并列出修改文件及验证结果。
agent.en:
Inspect existing components and tokens before implementing Combobox.
Requirements:
- Keep focus in the input and point aria-activedescendant at the active option. Connect aria-expanded, aria-controls, listbox and option semantics. Support arrows, Enter and Escape, and reset the active index when filtering changes.
- The active descendant must reference an existing option.
- Clearing restores options; Escape closes the list.
- Support narrow screens, both themes and reduced motion.
- Add no dependencies.
Run existing checks and list changed files and validation results.

description.zh: 用快捷键（⌘K / Ctrl+K）唤出的浮动搜索面板：输入即筛选命令、页面或内容， 键盘上下选择、回车执行。macOS Spotlight 把它带入大众视野， 现在是效率工具和开发者产品的标配。
description.en: A floating search panel summoned with ⌘K / Ctrl+K: type to filter commands, pages or content, navigate with arrow keys, execute with Enter. Popularized by macOS Spotlight; now standard in power-user products.

use_when.zh: 功能多、层级深的产品（后台、开发工具、笔记软件）
use_when.en: Products with many features and deep hierarchies — admin panels, dev tools, note apps

use_when.zh: 目标用户是高频操作的高阶用户
use_when.en: Power users performing frequent actions

use_when.zh: 想减少导航层级、直达任何地方
use_when.en: When you want flat navigation — reach anything in one stroke

avoid_when.zh: 面向大众的浅层应用，用户不知道快捷键文化
avoid_when.en: Mass-market shallow apps — users don't know the shortcut culture

avoid_when.zh: 移动端为主要场景（虚拟键盘体验差），改用底部搜索
avoid_when.en: Mobile-primary contexts — use a bottom search instead

avoid_when.zh: 命令总数极少（< 10 个），普通菜单就够了
avoid_when.en: Very few commands (< 10) — a plain menu suffices

note.zh: 只列操作命令，VS Code 风格
note.en: Commands only — VS Code style

note.zh: 命令 + 页面 + 内容 + 最近使用
note.en: Commands, pages, content and recents

note.zh: 自然语言查询 + 建议操作
note.en: Natural language queries with suggested actions

打断程度.en: Medium — covers screen but closes fast

notes.zh: 本质是受控弹层：fixed 居中 + 遮罩模糊；输入过滤用 useMemo 计算分组列表， 焦点锁定在输入框；键盘导航管理 activeIndex。开源实现可参考 cmdk（React）。 注意 aria-role="dialog" 与 focus trap。
notes.en: A controlled overlay: fixed centered + blurred backdrop; filter with useMemo into grouped lists; keep focus locked in the input; manage activeIndex for keyboard nav. The cmdk library is a solid React reference. Use role="dialog" and a focus trap.

basic.zh: 创建一个命令面板组件：⌘K 唤出，输入即筛选命令列表，键盘上下选择、回车执行。
basic.en: "Create a command palette: summon with ⌘K", type to filter commands, arrow keys to navigate, Enter to run.

design.zh: 创建命令面板。要求：屏幕居中浮层 + 半透明遮罩模糊；顶部输入框，下方分组结果列表（命令 / 页面 / 最近使用）；选中项高亮；每项右侧显示快捷键提示；弹出有轻微 scale + fade 动画。视觉参考 macOS Spotlight / Linear。
design.en: Create a command palette: centered overlay with translucent blurred backdrop; top input; grouped results below (commands / pages / recents); highlighted selection; key hints on the right; subtle scale + fade entrance. Visual reference: macOS Spotlight / Linear.

implementation.zh: 用 React 实现受控命令面板：全局 keydown 监听 ⌘K/Ctrl+K 开关；role="dialog" + focus trap；输入 useMemo 过滤 + 分组；activeIndex 键盘导航（↑↓ Enter）；点击遮罩关闭。可参考 cmdk 的 API 设计但自行实现，不引入依赖。
implementation.en: "Implement a controlled palette in React: global ⌘K/Ctrl+K listener; role="dialog" + focus trap; useMemo filtering + grouping; activeIndex keyboard nav (↑↓ Enter); close on backdrop click. Model the API on cmdk but implement yourself", no new deps.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现命令面板（Command Palette）。

先检查现有弹层 / Dialog 组件与 Design Token，优先复用。
要求：
- ⌘K / Ctrl+K 全局唤出，Esc 关闭
- 输入即筛，结果按「命令 / 页面」分组
- 完整键盘导航与 aria 属性（dialog、listbox、option）
- 弹出动画轻微，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 支持注册自定义命令（提供 useCommands 或类似 API）
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Command Palette in the current project.

Inspect existing dialog primitives and design tokens first; reuse them.
Requirements:
- Global ⌘K / Ctrl+K toggle, Esc to close
- Filter-as-you-type, grouped results (commands / pages)
- Full keyboard nav + aria attributes (dialog, listbox, option)
- Subtle entrance animation, respects prefers-reduced-motion
- Custom command registration (a useCommands-like API)
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 打开面板，输入关键词，再尝试选择命令与退出。
task.en: Open the palette, type a query, select a command and dismiss it.

checks.zh: 搜索应覆盖命令别名，并给出无结果反馈。
checks.en: Search command aliases and explain empty results.

checks.zh: 关闭后焦点应回到触发入口。
checks.en: Return focus to the trigger after closing.

description.zh: 用日历网格选择日期的复合控件，通常由输入框触发弹出，也常内嵌展示。 头部提供年月切换，网格按周排列日期并高亮今天与选中日； 范围形态用两个日期夹出区间。避免手输日期的格式错误。
description.en: A composite control picking dates on a calendar grid, usually popped from a trigger input but often shown inline. The header navigates months, the grid lays days out by week highlighting today and the selection; the range form bounds an interval with two dates. It avoids manual date-entry mistakes.

use_when.zh: 表单需要选择日期且格式易错（预订、报表）
use_when.en: Forms need dates where formats cause errors like booking or reports

use_when.zh: 需要直观查看日期所在星期与月份结构
use_when.en: Weekday and month context must be visible while choosing

use_when.zh: 选择区间（入住退房、活动起止）
use_when.en: Interval selection like check-in/checkout or event spans

avoid_when.zh: 只选年份或月份，用更轻的年月选择器
avoid_when.en: Year or month only — a lighter picker fits better

avoid_when.zh: 移动端简单日期，原生日期输入体验更好
avoid_when.en: Simple mobile dates — the native date input feels better

avoid_when.zh: 高频输入日期的录入场景，快捷键 + 手输更快
avoid_when.en: High-volume data entry — typing with shortcuts is faster

note.zh: 常驻展示，适合面板侧栏
note.en: Always visible — panel and sidebar friendly

note.zh: 输入框 + 弹层，表单标准形态
note.en: Input + popup — the standard form shape

note.zh: 两次点击夹出区间
note.en: Two clicks bound the interval

anatomy: 星期与日期网格（Weekday & day grid）
选中 / 今日标识（Selected & today marks）

notes.zh: 网格用 grid-cols-7，首日偏移由当月 1 号的星期决定；日期计算交给 Intl / Date API 处理时区与月末。弹出形态面板绝对定位在触发框下， 点击外部与 Escape 关闭。今日用描边、选中日用 accent 填充； 范围态记录起点终点，中间日期铺浅 accent 背景。键盘方向键移动焦点。
notes.en: Grid with grid-cols-7; the leading offset comes from the weekday of the 1st. Delegate date math to Date / Intl APIs for timezones and month ends. The popup panel sits below the trigger, closing on outside click and Escape. Today gets an outline, selection an accent fill; in range mode the start and end record bounds and in-between days take a soft accent background. Arrow keys move focus.

basic.zh: 创建一个日期选择器组件，点击输入框弹出日历面板选择日期。
basic.en: Create a date picker that pops a calendar panel from a trigger input to pick a date.

design.zh: 创建日期选择器组件。要求：触发输入框显示所选日期（占位「请选择日期」）， 弹出日历面板：头部年月 + 前后切换按钮，7 列网格高亮今天（描边）与选中日 （accent 填充）；点击外部关闭；提供内嵌日历与范围选择两种变体；深浅色一致。
design.en: Create a date picker. Requirements: trigger input showing the chosen date (placeholder "Pick a date"); popup calendar with a month header and prev/next buttons, 7-column grid highlighting today (outline) and the selection (accent fill); closes on outside click; inline and range variants; consistent in light/dark.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 DatePicker：受控 value；由 Date 计算当月天数与首日 偏移，Intl 获取星期标题；面板绝对定位 + 点击外部关闭（document 监听）； prev/next 切换年月；范围态维护 [start, end] 与 picking 阶段，中间日着色。 键盘方向键移动日期焦点，aria-label 标注每个日期。
