implementation.en: React + Tailwind DatePicker: controlled value; compute days in month and leading offset from Date, weekday titles via Intl; panel absolutely positioned closing on outside document click; prev/next month paging; range keeps [start, end] with a picking phase and tints in-between days. Arrow keys move the date focus; each day gets an aria-label.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现日期选择器组件。

先检查现有表单与弹出层组件，保持风格与 z-index 层级一致。
要求：
- 触发输入框 + 弹出日历，受控 value
- 高亮今日与选中日，支持前后翻月
- 范围选择形态（可选）
- 点击外部 / Escape 关闭，键盘可达
- 深浅色主题一致，不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a date picker component in the current project.

Inspect existing form and overlay components first; keep styles and z-index consistent.
Requirements:
- Trigger input + popup calendar, controlled value
- Highlight today and the selection; navigate months
- Range selection form (optional)
- Close on outside click / Escape, keyboard accessible
- Consistent light/dark themes, no new dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 切换月份并选择日期，观察当前日期与选中日期的区别。
task.en: Move between months and compare today with the selected date.

checks.zh: 今天和所选日期是两种不同状态。
checks.en: Today and the selected day are separate states.

checks.zh: 不可选日期需要可见说明，不能仅隐藏交互。
checks.en: Explain unavailable dates instead of only disabling interaction.

description.zh: 从屏幕边缘（多为右侧或左侧）滑入、通常带遮罩的面板。比模态框轻：能承载较长内容又不离开当前页面， 关闭后原样回到上下文；移动端常以左滑导航或底部抽屉的形式出现。
description.en: A panel that slides in from a screen edge (usually right or left), usually with a backdrop. Lighter than a modal: it carries longer content without leaving the page, and closing restores the original context. On mobile it appears as a nav drawer or a bottom sheet.

use_when.zh: 查看详情但不想离开列表（邮件、订单）
use_when.en: Inspect details without leaving the list (mail, orders)

use_when.zh: 移动端承载侧边导航
use_when.en: Host side navigation on mobile

use_when.zh: 快速编辑或筛选，且需要保留底层上下文
use_when.en: Quick edit or filter while keeping page context

avoid_when.zh: 需要用户强制决策（改用模态框）
avoid_when.en: A forced decision is required — use a modal

avoid_when.zh: 内容只有一两行（改用 popover 或 tooltip）
avoid_when.en: One or two lines of content — use a popover or tooltip

avoid_when.zh: 桌面端常驻导航（改用 sidebar）
avoid_when.en: Persistent desktop navigation — use a sidebar

note.zh: 详情面板最常见方向
note.en: The common direction for detail panels

note.zh: 移动端导航抽屉常用
note.en: Common for mobile navigation drawers

note.zh: 移动端操作与筛选面板
note.en: Mobile action and filter panels

打断程度.zh: 高，打开时遮罩挡住页面
打断程度.en: High — backdrop covers the page while open

内容容量.zh: 高，可承载长列表与表单
内容容量.en: High — long lists and forms fit

notes.zh: 面板 fixed 定位在边缘，用 transform translateX 收起与展开（GPU 友好，避免动 width）； 遮罩同步淡入淡出。内部 overflow-y-auto 承载长内容，底部操作区吸底。 焦点管理与滚动锁定同模态框；Esc 关闭，移动端可加边缘滑动手势。
notes.en: Fix the panel at the edge and animate transform translateX to hide/show (GPU-friendly, do not animate width); fade the backdrop in sync. Scroll long content inside with overflow-y-auto and pin footer actions. Focus management and scroll lock match the modal; close on Esc, add edge-swipe gestures on mobile.

basic.zh: 创建一个抽屉（Drawer）组件：点击按钮从右侧滑出面板，带遮罩，包含标题、内容和关闭按钮。
basic.en: Create a Drawer component: a button slides a panel in from the right with a backdrop, containing a header, content and a close button.

design.zh: 创建抽屉组件。要求：面板从右侧滑入（宽约 360px），遮罩半透明；头部标题 + 关闭按钮，内容区可滚动， 底部吸底操作区；滑入动画 240ms 缓出；Esc 与点击遮罩关闭；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a drawer. Requirements: panel slides in from the right (~360px wide) over a translucent backdrop; header with title and close button, scrollable body, pinned footer actions; 240ms ease-out slide; closes on Esc and backdrop click; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Drawer：open 受控；面板 fixed inset-y-0 right-0， 用 transform translate-x-full ↔ translate-x-0 过渡（时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）； 遮罩 opacity 过渡；打开时锁定 body 滚动、焦点移入；Esc 关闭； role="dialog" aria-modal="true"，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Drawer: controlled open state; fixed inset-y-0 right-0 panel transitioning transform translate-x-full ↔ translate-x-0 (duration scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1)); backdrop opacity transition; lock body scroll and move focus in when open; close on Esc; role="dialog" aria-modal="true"; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现抽屉（Drawer）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色、层级与阴影变量。
用途：列表详情查看与移动端导航。
要求：
- 右侧滑入 + 遮罩，Esc 与点击遮罩关闭
- 打开时锁定滚动、焦点移入面板
- 滑动动画用 transform，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 支持左侧滑入与底部抽屉两种变体
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Drawer component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface, elevation and shadow variables.
Usage: list detail viewing and mobile navigation.
Requirements:
- Right-edge slide-in with backdrop; close on Esc and backdrop click
- Lock scroll and move focus into the panel while open
- Transform-based slide animation, respecting prefers-reduced-motion
- Support left-edge and bottom-sheet variants
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 打开侧边面板，完成查看后关闭，再比较不同展开方向。
task.en: Open the side panel, inspect it and dismiss it; compare placement variants.

checks.zh: 关闭入口应可见，模态抽屉还应支持 Esc。
checks.en: Keep dismissal visible; modal drawers should support Escape.

checks.zh: 长内容在面板内部滚动，背景状态应保留。
checks.en: Scroll long content inside the panel and preserve the background state.

description.zh: 由触发按钮就近弹出的一组操作菜单，用于收纳次要操作，保持界面整洁。 典型形态是「···」更多按钮；面板带阴影浮于内容之上，点击菜单项即执行并关闭， 危险操作以红色项与分隔线隔离。
description.en: A menu of actions popping near its trigger to tuck away secondary operations and keep the interface tidy — the classic form being a "···" more button. The panel floats over content with a shadow; picking an item executes and closes, and destructive actions sit isolated below a divider in red.

use_when.zh: 次要操作较多但不值得常驻展示
use_when.en: Secondary actions do not warrant permanent visibility

use_when.zh: 列表行的行内操作收纳进「···」按钮
use_when.en: Row-level actions collected behind a "···" button

use_when.zh: 工具栏空间有限，需要折叠操作集
use_when.en: Toolbar space is tight and actions must fold up

avoid_when.zh: 高频主要操作，直接放按钮更高效
avoid_when.en: Frequent primary actions deserve real buttons

avoid_when.zh: 需要在多项输入间选择并提交，用下拉选择
avoid_when.en: Picking a value for a form — use a select instead

avoid_when.zh: 触屏端深度超过一层的嵌套菜单，改为抽屉或页面
avoid_when.en: Nested menus beyond one level on touch — use a drawer or page

disambiguation.zh: Dropdown 是「触发按钮 + 弹出菜单」的组合；Select 是表单取值控件；Popover 可承载任意内容而非仅命令。
disambiguation.en: A dropdown pairs a trigger button with a popup menu. A Select is a form-value control. A Popover can hold arbitrary content, not only commands.

note.zh: Menu 只是弹出列表，Dropdown 含触发按钮与关闭逻辑。
note.en: Menu is just the popup list; Dropdown includes trigger and dismiss logic.

note.zh: Select 用于表单取值，Dropdown 用于执行命令。
note.en: Select collects form values; Dropdown runs commands.

note.zh: Popover 内容任意、可交互，Dropdown 列表为命令项。
note.en: Popover content is free-form; a dropdown list is command items.

note.zh: 「···」触发的行内操作集
note.en: Row actions behind a "···" trigger

note.zh: 指针悬停即展开，适合桌面导航
note.en: Opens on pointer hover — desktop navigation

note.zh: 图标辅助识别，危险项用分隔线隔离
note.en: Icons aid scanning; a divider isolates the danger item

anatomy: 分隔线与危险项（Divider & danger item）

打断程度.en: Low — a small panel near the trigger

内容容量.en: Low to medium — a few to a dozen items

notes.zh: 面板绝对定位于触发器下方，展开做轻微 opacity + translateY 过渡（时长乘 --demo-speed）。role="menu" / role="menuitem" 标注，键盘上下移动、 Escape 关闭、点击外部关闭。危险项用红色文字并以分隔线隔离， 防止误点。触发器展开时保持高亮态。
notes.en: Absolutely position the panel below the trigger with a subtle opacity + translateY transition (durations multiplied by --demo-speed). Mark up with role="menu" and role="menuitem"; arrow keys move, Escape and outside click close. Isolate the danger item below a divider in red to prevent misclicks, and keep the trigger highlighted while open.

basic.zh: 创建一个下拉菜单组件，点击按钮弹出操作菜单，选择后自动关闭。
basic.en: Create a dropdown component that opens an action menu on click and closes after selection.

design.zh: 创建下拉菜单组件。要求：「···」按钮触发，面板带阴影就近弹出，菜单项带图标， 底部危险项（删除）红色并用分隔线隔离；展开有轻微浮入动画；点击外部与 Escape 关闭；深浅色一致。
design.en: Create a dropdown component. Requirements: triggered by a "···" button, a shadowed panel popping just below, menu items with icons, a red danger item (delete) isolated by a divider; a subtle float-in animation; closes on outside click and Escape; consistent in light/dark.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Dropdown：受控 open；面板 absolute right-0 top-full + shadow-lg，过渡 opacity + translateY（时长乘 --demo-speed）；菜单项数据驱动 （{label, icon, danger}）；document 点击与 Escape 关闭；role="menu" + role="menuitem"，上下键移动焦点，Enter 执行并关闭。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Dropdown: controlled open; panel absolute right-0 top-full with shadow-lg and an opacity + translateY transition (duration multiplied by --demo-speed); items data-driven ({label, icon, danger}); close on document click and Escape; role="menu" + role="menuitem" with arrow-key focus movement and Enter to execute and close.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现下拉菜单组件。

先检查现有弹出层组件与 z-index 约定，保持层级一致。
要求：
- 受控 open，触发器就近弹出面板
- 菜单项带图标，危险项红色 + 分隔线隔离
- 点击外部 / Escape 关闭，键盘上下选择
- 深浅色主题一致，动画尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a dropdown component in the current project.

Inspect existing overlay components and z-index conventions first; keep layers consistent.
Requirements:
- Controlled open, panel pops near the trigger
- Items with icons; danger item in red isolated by a divider
- Close on outside click / Escape; arrow-key selection
- Consistent light/dark themes; animation respects prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 打开操作菜单，用方向键选择重命名或删除，尝试撤销。
task.en: Open the action menu, navigate with arrows, rename or delete, then undo.

checks.zh: 选择动作后关闭菜单，焦点返回触发按钮。
checks.en: Close after an action and return focus to the trigger.

checks.zh: 删除需要清楚的确认与可理解的恢复方式。
checks.en: Make deletion confirmation and recovery clear.

description.zh: 锚在视口角落、悬浮于内容之上的圆形按钮，承载当前页面唯一的主操作（新建、撰写、扫码）。 用阴影和位置宣告「我在所有内容之上」，比行内主按钮更醒目，但一屏只应有一个。点击后可展开 为带标签的扩展形态，或扇出一组快捷动作。
description.en: A circular button anchored to a corner of the viewport, floating above the content and carrying the one primary action of the current view (create, compose, scan). Shadow and placement declare "I sit above everything" — louder than an inline primary button, but there should be only one per screen. On click it may expand into a labeled bar or fan out into a set of quick actions.

disambiguation.zh: 悬浮按钮不是「更显眼的主按钮」：主按钮嵌在页面布局里、随内容滚动；悬浮按钮脱离文档流、 常驻视口角落并覆盖在内容之上。判断标准是它是否悬浮在滚动内容之上，而不是颜色有多亮。
disambiguation.en: A FAB is not "a louder primary button": a primary button lives inside the layout and scrolls with content; a FAB detaches from the flow, stays pinned to a corner and overlays content. The test is whether it floats above scrolling content — not how bright its color is.

use_when.zh: 页面有唯一、高频、正向的主操作（新建、撰写）
use_when.en: The view has one frequent, constructive primary action (create, compose)

use_when.zh: 底部拇指热区需要常驻入口
use_when.en: A persistent entry point in the bottom thumb zone

use_when.zh: 工具型界面需要比行内按钮更强的操作召唤
use_when.en: A tool-like surface needs a stronger call to action than an inline button

avoid_when.zh: 有多个并列主操作（并列会互相削弱，用底部操作条）
avoid_when.en: Several co-equal primary actions — they cancel out; use a bottom action bar

avoid_when.zh: 操作是破坏性的（删除、清空）
avoid_when.en: Destructive actions (delete, wipe)

avoid_when.zh: 会遮挡关键内容或底部导航
avoid_when.en: It would cover key content or the bottom navigation

note.zh: 纯图标圆形按钮，最常见形态
note.en: Icon-only circle — the classic form

note.zh: 图标 + 文字标签，行动意图更明确
note.en: Icon plus label — a clearer call to action

note.zh: 点击扇出多个子动作，再点收起
note.en: Fans out several sub-actions on click, retracts on second click

anatomy: 扩展标签 / 子动作（Label / Speed dial actions）

task.zh: 点击右下角悬浮按钮，展开子动作后再收起，观察它与内容的层级关系。
task.en: Tap the corner FAB, fan out the sub-actions and retract; watch how it layers over content.

checks.zh: 按钮悬浮于滚动内容之上且不被遮挡
checks.en: The button floats above scrolling content and stays unoccluded

checks.zh: 扇出的子动作均可键盘到达
checks.en: Every fanned-out sub-action is keyboard reachable

notes.zh: position: fixed（或 absolute 于滚动容器外）锚定角落，圆形用 border-radius: 9999px； 抬升靠 box-shadow 多层阴影而非描边。扇出的子动作用 scale + opacity 依次错开出现， 主按钮旋转 45° 变关闭。按压 scale(0.94) 反馈；触控目标不小于 48px；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Anchor the corner with position: fixed (or absolute outside the scroller); make it circular with border-radius: 9999px; elevation comes from layered box-shadows, not outlines. Speed-dial actions stagger in with scale + opacity while the main button rotates 45° into a close affordance. Press feedback is scale(0.94); keep the touch target ≥ 48px; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个悬浮按钮（FAB）组件：圆形图标按钮固定在右下角，点击扇出多个子动作。
basic.en: Create a Floating Action Button: a circular icon button pinned to the bottom-right corner that fans out several sub-actions on click.

design.zh: 创建 FAB：56px 圆形、主色填充、白色图标、多层柔和阴影；右下角距边 16px； 扩展形态为图标 + 标签胶囊；扇出子动作为 40px 小圆钮，从下往上错开浮现； 按压轻微缩小；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a FAB: a 56px circle, accent fill, white icon, layered soft shadow; 16px from the bottom-right edge; the extended form is an icon-plus-label pill; speed-dial actions are 40px mini circles staggering upward; subtle press scale; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 FAB：variant 映射 single / extended / speed-dial；open 受控， 子动作用 CSS transition 交错 delay 呈现；role="menu" 或 group 语义，aria-expanded 标在主按钮上；主按钮点击切换 open，Esc 收起并归还焦点；active:scale-[0.94] 按压反馈； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。无新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind FAB: a variant map for single / extended / speed-dial; controlled open state with staggered CSS transition delays on sub-actions; role="menu" or group semantics with aria-expanded on the main button; clicking toggles open, Esc retracts and restores focus; active:scale-[0.94] press feedback; respect prefers-reduced-motion. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现一个 FAB 悬浮按钮组件。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前按钮与阴影变量。
与行内主按钮区分：悬浮、常驻、一屏一个。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，支持键盘操作。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Floating Action Button in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse button and shadow
variables.
Keep it distinct from an inline primary button: floating, persistent, one per screen.
Keep the project's visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and support keyboard operation.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 用于选择文件、展示校验反馈并管理待处理文件列表的表单区域。常见形式为原生文件选择按钮或可拖放区域；拖拽必须有按钮选择作为替代。选择文件不代表已经上传，界面应清楚区分待上传、处理中、成功和失败，并说明允许的格式与大小。
description.en: A form region for selecting files, checking constraints and managing a pending list. It may use a native picker or a drop zone, but drag-and-drop must have a picker alternative. Selection is not upload completion: distinguish pending, processing, success and failure, and explain accepted types and size limits.

use_when.zh: 提交图片、附件、PDF 等用户文件。
use_when.en: Select user images, attachments or PDFs.

use_when.zh: 多文件任务需要逐项查看和移除。
use_when.en: Review and remove individual files in a batch.

avoid_when.zh: 只需要一个网址时使用文本输入。
avoid_when.en: Use a text field when only a URL is needed.

avoid_when.zh: 未明确数据用途或上传目标时不要自动上传。
avoid_when.en: Do not auto-upload without explaining the purpose and destination.

note.zh: 同时提供拖放与文件选择入口。
note.en: Support both dropping files and a file picker.

note.zh: 空间紧凑时使用原生文件选择。
note.en: Use a native picker in a compact layout.

notes.zh: 保留原生 input type="file"，accept 只是筛选提示，还需校验类型与大小；服务端也必须验证上传内容。拖放阻止浏览器默认打开文件，错误明确到限制条件。示例不联网，只展示选择结果。
notes.en: Retain a native file input. The accept attribute is a picker hint; validate size and type and verify uploads on the server. Prevent the browser from navigating to dropped files. Explain constraints in errors. This demo only lists local selections.

task.zh: 选择或拖入 PNG、JPG、PDF，再尝试不支持的文件类型，并移除已选文件。
task.en: Choose or drop a PNG, JPG or PDF, try an unsupported type, then remove a selected file.

checks.zh: 文件选择与拖放采用相同限制，拒绝时不丢失已选文件。
checks.en: Picker and drop share constraints; a rejection preserves previous files.

checks.zh: 选择成功不能显示为上传成功；这里没有上传请求。
checks.en: Do not label a selected file as uploaded; this demo sends no upload request.

basic.zh: 创建文件上传区组件。提交图片、附件、PDF 等用户文件。
basic.en: Create a File Upload component. Select user images, attachments or PDFs.

design.zh: 设计文件上传区，以清楚的层级、可见的状态和明确的反馈为优先。同时提供拖放与文件选择入口。空间紧凑时使用原生文件选择。文件选择与拖放采用相同限制，拒绝时不丢失已选文件。选择成功不能显示为上传成功；这里没有上传请求。
design.en: Design a File Upload with clear hierarchy and state feedback. Support both dropping files and a file picker. Use a native picker in a compact layout. Picker and drop share constraints; a rejection preserves previous files. Do not label a selected file as uploaded; this demo sends no upload request.

implementation.zh: 保留原生 input type="file"，accept 只是筛选提示，还需校验类型与大小；服务端也必须验证上传内容。拖放阻止浏览器默认打开文件，错误明确到限制条件。示例不联网，只展示选择结果。
implementation.en: Retain a native file input. The accept attribute is a picker hint; validate size and type and verify uploads on the server. Prevent the browser from navigating to dropped files. Explain constraints in errors. This demo only lists local selections.

agent.zh:
先检查当前项目的组件与样式体系，复用已有能力实现文件上传区。
要求：
- 保留原生 input type="file"，accept 只是筛选提示，还需校验类型与大小；服务端也必须验证上传内容。拖放阻止浏览器默认打开文件，错误明确到限制条件。示例不联网，只展示选择结果。
- 文件选择与拖放采用相同限制，拒绝时不丢失已选文件。
- 选择成功不能显示为上传成功；这里没有上传请求。
- 窄屏可用，深浅色一致，尊重 reduced-motion。
- 不新增依赖。
运行项目现有检查，并列出修改文件及验证结果。
agent.en:
Inspect existing components and tokens before implementing File Upload.
Requirements:
- Retain a native file input. The accept attribute is a picker hint; validate size and type and verify uploads on the server. Prevent the browser from navigating to dropped files. Explain constraints in errors. This demo only lists local selections.
- Picker and drop share constraints; a rejection preserves previous files.
- Do not label a selected file as uploaded; this demo sends no upload request.
- Support narrow screens, both themes and reduced motion.
- Add no dependencies.
Run existing checks and list changed files and validation results.

aliases: 左边勾选条件的那种面板

description.zh: 集中承载筛选条件的面板，常驻列表侧边或以抽屉、浮层唤起：复选组、单选、滑杆组合出当前查询。 与列表实时联动刷新结果数，并支持已选条件回显与一键清除。
description.en: A panel concentrating filter controls beside the list (or revealed in a drawer or popover): checkbox groups, radios and sliders compose the current query. It syncs with the list to refresh result counts, echoes selected conditions and offers clear-all.

use_when.zh: 电商、检索结果等多维度数据浏览
use_when.en: Multi-facet browsing (commerce, search results)

use_when.zh: 后台列表需要组合条件定位记录
use_when.en: Admin lists locating records by combined conditions

use_when.zh: 需要展示各选项的结果数（facet count）
use_when.en: Showing per-option result counts (facets)

avoid_when.zh: 维度极少（1~2 个，用下拉或搜索框即可）
avoid_when.en: One or two dimensions — a select or search box suffices

avoid_when.zh: 筛选计算很慢（需要防抖与加载态）
avoid_when.en: Slow filtering — debounce and show a loading state

avoid_when.zh: 移动端直接堆砌（收进底部抽屉承载）
avoid_when.en: On mobile move it into a bottom drawer, do not stack it inline

note.zh: 桌面列表页左侧常驻
note.en: Persistent left rail on desktop list pages

note.zh: 移动端以底部抽屉承载
note.en: Mobile hosts it in a bottom drawer

note.zh: 已选条件以可删除胶囊回显在列表上方
note.en: Selected conditions echo as removable chips above the list

notes.zh: 左筛选 + 右结果的双栏布局（lg 以下收进抽屉）。多选状态用 Set<string> 管理， 过滤结果用 useMemo 派生；面板顶部常驻结果数与「清除全部」；已选条件回显为可删胶囊。 选项旁标注 facet 数量帮助用户预估结果规模；重筛选时防抖并给列表 loading 态。
notes.en: Two-pane layout: filters left, results right (collapse into a drawer below lg). Manage multi-select with Set<string> and derive filtered results with useMemo; keep result count and clear-all pinned at the panel top; echo selections as removable chips. Annotate options with facet counts to set expectations; debounce and show a list loading state on re-filter.

basic.zh: 创建一个筛选面板（Filter Panel）：左侧分组复选条件，右侧商品列表，勾选后列表实时过滤并显示结果数。
basic.en: Create a Filter Panel: grouped checkboxes on the left, a product list on the right; checking a box filters the list live and updates the result count.

design.zh: 创建筛选面板。要求：分组标题 + 复选项（右侧带 facet 数量灰字）；面板顶部显示「共 N 个结果」 与「清除全部」按钮；已选条件以可删除胶囊回显在列表上方；选中项强调色标识； 移动端收进底部抽屉；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a filter panel. Requirements: group labels and checkboxes (facet counts in grey at the right); panel top shows "N results" with a clear-all button; selected conditions echo as removable chips above the list; checked items marked with the accent; mobile folds into a bottom drawer; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 FilterPanel：selected: Set<string> 受控， filtered = useMemo(() => items.filter(...), [selected])；每组渲染 checkbox + facet 数量； 结果区显示 filtered.length 与空态（empty-state）；清除全部 selected.clear()； 胶囊回显 selected 项，点 × 移除；容器 lg:grid-cols-[200px_1fr]，小屏改抽屉； 防抖在数据源异步时处理。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind FilterPanel: selected: Set<string> controlled state, filtered = useMemo(() => items.filter(...), [selected]); each group renders checkboxes with facet counts; the results area shows filtered.length with an empty-state; clear-all empties the set; chips echo selections with an × to remove; container lg:grid-cols-[200px_1fr] collapsing to a drawer on small screens; debounce when the source is async.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现筛选面板（Filter Panel）。

先检查现有组件体系、路由参数与数据源，保持状态同步方式一致。
用途：检索结果页与后台列表。
要求：
- 分组复选 + facet 数量 + 实时过滤
- 结果数与「清除全部」常驻，已选条件胶囊回显
- 无结果时给出空态与清除入口
- URL 参数或状态可恢复，深浅色主题一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Filter Panel in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system, route params and data source first; keep the
state-sync approach consistent.
Usage: search results pages and admin lists.
Requirements:
- Grouped checkboxes + facet counts + live filtering
- Persistent result count and clear-all; selections echoed as chips
- An empty state with a clear entry when nothing matches
- Restorable from URL params or state; consistent light/dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 组合筛选条件，再重置，观察结果数量如何变化。
task.en: Combine filters, reset them and watch the result count change.

checks.zh: 已应用条件与结果数量应一起更新。
checks.en: Update applied filters and result counts together.

checks.zh: 无匹配结果时，应提供清除或放宽条件的路径。
checks.en: Offer a way to clear or relax filters when nothing matches.

description.zh: 用一条带边框的水平输入区收集单行文本，是表单的基本单元。 占位符提示期望格式，聚焦时高亮边框引导视线，校验失败时切换错误色 并附提示文案；可内嵌前后缀图标与清除按钮，受控管理输入值。
description.en: A single-line bordered field for collecting text — the basic unit of every form. Placeholder hints the expected format, focus highlights the border to guide the eye, and failed validation switches to an error color with a hint. Prefix and suffix icons or a clear button can live inside, and the value is controlled state.

use_when.zh: 收集用户名、邮箱、标题等单行短文本
use_when.en: Short single-line values like name, email or title

use_when.zh: 表单校验需要即时反馈错误与格式提示
use_when.en: Forms that need instant validation feedback

use_when.zh: 搜索等需要前后缀图标或清除按钮的场景
use_when.en: Search-like fields with icons or a clear button

avoid_when.zh: 长段落、简介等多行内容，改用 textarea
avoid_when.en: Multi-line content like bios — use a textarea

avoid_when.zh: 选项固定且少于 5 个，用 radio 或 select 更高效
avoid_when.en: Fewer than 5 fixed options — radio or select is faster

avoid_when.zh: 需要复杂格式编辑（富文本、日期），用专用组件
avoid_when.en: Complex formats like rich text or dates — use dedicated components

note.zh: 边框包裹，最通用
note.en: Bordered box — the default everywhere

note.zh: 浅灰底无边框，Material 常用
note.en: Tinted background, borderless — Material style

note.zh: 内嵌图标与清除按钮
note.en: Inline icons and a clear button

note.zh: 仅保留下边线，不使用圆角与填充底色；标签始终可见。
note.en: Keep only the bottom rule with no radius or fill; the label stays visible.

anatomy: 帮助 / 错误提示（Helper & error）

notes.zh: 基础样式是 border + rounded + px，focus 时叠加 accent 色描边（box-shadow 实现， 不改动布局）；错误态切换 border 与提示文字颜色。清除按钮用绝对定位内嵌右侧。 高度控制在 36～44px，placeholder 用低对比灰。始终配 label 或 aria-label。
notes.en: Base style is border + rounded + horizontal padding; focus adds an accent ring via box-shadow without shifting layout; the error state swaps border and hint colors. The clear button is absolutely positioned inside. Keep height 36–44px, low-contrast placeholder, and always attach a label or aria-label.

basic.zh: 创建一个输入框组件，支持标签、占位符、清除按钮和错误提示。
basic.en: Create an input component with a label, placeholder, clear button and error hint.

design.zh: 创建输入框组件。要求：外置左对齐 label，聚焦时 accent 描边，输入非空时右侧出现 清除按钮，校验失败切红并显示错误文案；提供描边与填充两种样式，深浅色一致。
design.en: Create an input component. Requirements: left-aligned external label, accent ring on focus, a clear button appearing when non-empty, red error state with a message; outline and filled styles; consistent in light/dark.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Input：受控 value；focus 态用 focus:border-accent + focus-visible ring；错误态由 error prop 驱动；清除按钮 absolute 定位并留出右侧 padding；支持 prefix / suffix 插槽与 maxLength。label 用 htmlFor 关联。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Input: controlled value; focus with focus:border-accent and ring; error driven by an error prop; absolutely positioned clear button with right padding reserved; prefix/suffix slots and maxLength support. Associate the label with htmlFor.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现输入框组件。

先检查现有表单组件与 Design Token，保持风格一致。
要求：
- 受控输入，支持 label、placeholder、prefix/suffix
- 聚焦描边与错误态（错误文案由外部校验逻辑传入）
- 非空时显示清除按钮
- 深浅色主题一致，无障碍标注齐全
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement an input component in the current project.

Inspect the existing form components and design tokens first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Controlled input with label, placeholder, prefix/suffix
- Focus ring and error state (message passed in from external validation)
- Clear button when non-empty
- Consistent light/dark themes and complete accessibility labels
- No new dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 修改邮箱、切换外观，尝试清空和错误输入，再保存偏好。
task.en: Edit the email, switch appearance, clear it, try an invalid value and save.

checks.zh: 占位符不能代替标签；错误必须说明如何修正。
checks.en: Placeholders are not labels; errors must explain the fix.

checks.zh: 清空后焦点留在输入框，方便继续输入。
checks.en: Keep focus in the field after clearing.

description.zh: 以压暗遮罩放大展示图片或视频的媒体浮层，原页面暂时失去交互。内容居中呈现，常配左右切换、缩放与关闭；它是媒体专用的模态框，与通用对话框的区别在于主体是可观赏的视觉内容而非表单或文案。
description.en: A media overlay that enlarges an image or video over a dimmed, temporarily inert page. The media is centered and usually paired with prev/next, zoom and close. It is a modal specialised for viewing rather than for forms or copy — that is what separates it from a generic dialog.

use_when.zh: 需要查看图片细节、原图或成组照片
use_when.en: Inspecting image detail, full-size originals or photo sets

use_when.zh: 视频需要脱离页面布局专注播放
use_when.en: Video must play focused, free of the page layout

use_when.zh: 缩略图点击后预期放大预览
use_when.en: Thumbnails are expected to open a larger preview on click

avoid_when.zh: 内容是表单、说明或确认操作，用 modal
avoid_when.en: Content is a form, message or confirmation — use a modal

avoid_when.zh: 用户需要边看边操作底层页面，用 drawer 或 popover
avoid_when.en: Users must act on the page while looking — use a drawer or popover

avoid_when.zh: 媒体本身就是页面主体，直接用画廊页或视频播放页
avoid_when.en: Media is the page itself — use a gallery page or player page

note.zh: 单图全屏放大，可缩放或平移查看细节
note.en: One image full-screen with zoom or pan for detail

note.zh: 带左右箭头与计数，连续浏览组图
note.en: Arrows plus a counter to step through a set

note.zh: 浮层内播放视频，常自动播放并可全屏
note.en: Video plays inside the overlay, often autoplaying to full screen

task.zh: 打开灯箱浏览一组图片，用箭头切换并尝试缩放与关闭。
task.en: Open the lightbox over a photo set, step with arrows and try zoom and close.

checks.zh: 遮罩外点击或 Esc 可关闭，关闭后焦点回到缩略图
checks.en: Outside click or Esc closes; focus returns to the thumbnail

checks.zh: 图片加载失败或视频不可用时有替代说明
checks.en: Failed image or video states carry a replacement message

note.zh: modal 承载通用任务与文案，lightbox 专用于放大观赏媒体
note.en: Modal hosts generic tasks and copy; lightbox exists to view media enlarged

note.zh: carousel 在页面内轮播，lightbox 在压暗遮罩上全屏展示
note.en: Carousel rotates in-page; lightbox presents full-screen over a dimmed page

disambiguation.zh: Lightbox 是媒体专用的 Modal；Modal 是通用容器。灯箱打开的是「可以看的东西」，对话框打开的是「要你处理的事」。
disambiguation.en: A lightbox is a media-focused Modal; Modal is the generic container. A lightbox opens something to look at, a dialog opens something to deal with.

sources.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines — Full Screen Modal

notes.zh: 遮罩固定铺满并压暗底层，媒体用 object-fit: contain 居中，避免裁切。打开时锁定页面滚动、焦点困在浮层内；左右箭头与 Esc 均可键盘操作。切换用轻微淡入而非大幅位移，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Fix a dimmed backdrop across the viewport and center the media with object-fit: contain so nothing is cropped. Lock page scroll and trap focus while open; arrows and Esc work from the keyboard. Cross-fade between items rather than sliding hard, and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个灯箱组件：点击缩略图在压暗遮罩上放大展示图片，支持左右切换与关闭。
basic.en: Create a lightbox that opens an enlarged image over a dimmed backdrop, with prev/next and close.

design.zh: 设计灯箱。要求：半透明压暗遮罩 + 居中媒体；底部计数与图注；左右切换箭头与右上角关闭；切换时轻微淡入；Esc 与点击遮罩可关闭；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Design a lightbox. Requirements: translucent dimmed backdrop with centered media; counter and caption at the bottom; prev/next arrows and a top-right close; gentle cross-fade when switching; close on Esc and backdrop click; consistent light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现灯箱：受控 index 与 open 状态；fixed inset-0 遮罩 + flex 居中的 figure；object-fit: contain 限制媒体尺寸；焦点困在浮层内，Esc 关闭并把焦点还给触发缩略图；图片 onError 显示占位说明。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind lightbox: controlled open and index state; fixed inset-0 backdrop with a flex-centered figure; object-fit: contain bounds the media; trap focus, close on Esc and restore focus to the trigger thumbnail; show a placeholder message on image error.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现灯箱（Lightbox）组件。
先检查现有浮层与 Design Token，优先复用遮罩、圆角与阴影变量。
用途：图片与视频的放大预览。
要求：
- 压暗遮罩 + 居中媒体，支持左右切换与关闭
- 焦点困在浮层内，关闭后焦点回到触发元素
- 图片加载失败有替代说明
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，支持键盘操作
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Lightbox component in the current project.
Inspect existing overlays and design tokens first and reuse backdrop, radius and shadow variables.
Usage: enlarged preview of images and video.
Requirements:
- Dimmed backdrop with centered media, prev/next and close
- Focus trapped in the overlay and restored to the trigger on close
- Replacement message when an image fails to load
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion and support keyboard operation
- No new dependencies
Run the existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 点击或右键触发的临时操作列表浮层：平铺或分组的命令项，选中即执行并关闭。 用于收纳非高频操作（更多、设置、删除），通常以「⋯」按钮或右键唤起。
description.en: A temporary overlay listing actions, opened by click or right-click: flat or grouped command items that execute and close on selection. It houses infrequent actions (more, settings, delete), usually behind a "⋯" button or a context click.

use_when.zh: 收纳低频操作，避免界面堆满按钮
use_when.en: Stash infrequent actions instead of crowding buttons

use_when.zh: 右键唤起的上下文操作（文件、画布元素）
use_when.en: Context actions on right-click (files, canvas items)

use_when.zh: 顶部导航的站点栏目入口
use_when.en: Site section entry points in a top nav

avoid_when.zh: 高频主操作（直接露出按钮）
avoid_when.en: Frequent primary actions — expose real buttons

avoid_when.zh: 层级很深的树（改用侧边栏或命令面板）
avoid_when.en: Very deep trees — use a sidebar or command palette

avoid_when.zh: 破坏性操作需二次确认，不能一触即发
avoid_when.en: Destructive items need confirmation, not one-click firing

disambiguation.zh: 菜单（Menu）是命令列表，点选即执行；导航（Navbar/Sidebar）是页面目的地；下拉（Dropdown）是「按钮 + 菜单」的组合控件。
disambiguation.en: A menu lists commands that run on click. Navigation (Navbar/Sidebar) lists destinations. A dropdown is the combined control — a button plus a menu.

note.zh: Dropdown 是按钮+菜单的完整控件，Menu 只是弹出的命令列表部分。
note.en: Dropdown is the full button+menu control; Menu is only the popup command list.

note.zh: Navbar 跳转页面目的地，Menu 执行即时命令。
note.en: Navbar jumps to destinations; Menu runs immediate commands.

note.zh: Select 选中一个值回填表单，Menu 触发一个动作。
note.en: Select picks a value for a form; Menu triggers an action.

note.zh: 点击按钮在下方弹出
note.en: Opens below its trigger button

note.zh: 右键在指针位置弹出
note.en: Opens at the pointer on right-click

note.zh: 带分组标题与分隔线
note.en: Group labels with separators

notes.zh: 以触发器为锚 absolute 定位，默认下方展开，贴近屏幕边缘时翻转。菜单项用 button （role="menuitem"），↑↓ 循环、Enter 执行、Esc 关闭；危险项用红色文字并与常规项分隔。 点击外部关闭：document 监听 pointerdown 判断 target。
notes.en: Anchor to the trigger with absolute positioning, opening below by default and flipping near screen edges. Items are buttons with role="menuitem"; ↑↓ cycles, Enter executes, Esc closes; destructive items get red text and a separator before them. Close on outside click: listen for pointerdown on document and check the target.

basic.zh: 创建一个菜单（Menu）组件：点击「⋯」按钮弹出操作列表（重命名、复制链接、删除）， 点击项执行并关闭菜单。
basic.en: Create a Menu component: a "⋯" button opens an action list (rename, copy link, delete); selecting an item executes it and closes the menu.

design.zh: 创建 Menu 组件。要求：浮层 min-w 160px、圆角、边框、大阴影；菜单项行高一致、hover 浅色高亮； 分组标题小写灰字；危险项红色文字并用分隔线隔开；展开时触发器保持强调态； 深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a Menu. Requirements: overlay min-w 160px, rounded, bordered, heavily shadowed; consistent item rows with light hover highlight; small grey group labels; destructive items in red separated by a divider; the trigger keeps an accent state while open; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Menu：open 受控；容器 relative，面板 absolute top-full mt-1； document pointerdown 监听外部关闭，Esc 关闭；焦点移入面板， ArrowUp/ArrowDown 在 item 间循环（role="menuitem"），Enter 执行并回调 onSelect； 项目数据驱动 {label, danger?, separator?}；入场 scale + fade（时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Menu: controlled open state; relative wrapper with an absolute top-full mt-1 panel; document pointerdown listener closes on outside click, Esc closes; focus moves into the panel and ArrowUp/ArrowDown cycles items (role="menuitem"), Enter executes via onSelect; items are data-driven {label, danger?, separator?}; enter animation scale + fade (duration scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1)).

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现菜单（Menu）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色与阴影变量。
用途：列表行的「更多」操作与右键上下文。
要求：
- 锚定触发器弹出，贴近边缘自动翻转
- 键盘可用：↑↓ 循环、Enter 执行、Esc 关闭
- 危险项红色 + 分隔线，触发二次确认的钩子
- 点击外部关闭，深浅色主题一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Menu component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface and shadow variables.
Usage: row "more" actions and right-click context.
Requirements:
- Anchored to the trigger, flips near screen edges
- Keyboard: ↑↓ cycling, Enter to execute, Esc to close
- Destructive items in red with a divider and a confirm hook
- Closes on outside click; consistent light/dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 用鼠标与键盘选择动作，体验重命名、删除确认与撤销。
task.en: Try pointer and keyboard actions, rename, confirm deletion and undo.

checks.zh: 所有菜单项包括危险项都应可用键盘到达。
checks.en: Every action, including destructive ones, must be keyboard reachable.

checks.zh: 点外部与 Esc 都能关闭，焦点不应丢失。
checks.en: Outside click and Escape should dismiss without losing focus.

aliases: 网页中间弹出来的窗口

description.zh: 覆盖在页面之上、带半透明遮罩的对话框，打断用户当前流程，要求先完成弹窗内的任务或决策。 遮罩阻断与底层页面的交互，焦点被暂时困在弹窗内，是容器类浮层中打断程度最高的一种。
description.en: A dialog rendered above the page with a translucent backdrop that interrupts the current flow and demands a task or decision first. The backdrop blocks interaction with the underlying page and focus is temporarily trapped inside — the most disruptive of the overlay containers.

use_when.zh: 需要明确决策的破坏性操作（删除、支付）
use_when.en: High-stakes confirmation such as delete or payment

use_when.zh: 任务必须完成后流程才能继续（向导、登录）
use_when.en: A task must finish before the flow continues (wizard, sign-in)

use_when.zh: 需要专注处理的临时内容（详情、快速编辑）
use_when.en: Focused temporary content like a detail view or quick edit

avoid_when.zh: 内容是辅助性的、可随时关闭（改用 popover 或 tooltip）
avoid_when.en: Supporting, dismissible content — use a popover or tooltip

avoid_when.zh: 用户需要对照底层页面操作（改用 drawer）
avoid_when.en: Users need the underlying page for context — use a drawer

avoid_when.zh: 移动端长内容滚动（改为全屏页面更稳）
avoid_when.en: Long scrolling content on mobile — a full page holds up better

disambiguation.zh: Modal 居中打断当前任务、要求处理；Drawer 从侧边滑出保留上下文；Popover 锚定触发元素、非打断；Sheet 只罩住当前窗口（macOS）。
disambiguation.en: A modal interrupts and demands resolution. A drawer slides from the side keeping context. A popover anchors to its trigger without blocking. A sheet covers only the current window on macOS.

note.zh: Drawer 从边缘滑出、空间更大，Modal 居中且更强调打断。
note.en: A drawer slides from an edge with more room; a modal is centered and more interrupting.

note.zh: Popover 非模态、锚定触发器，Modal 遮罩整页并阻断操作。
note.en: A popover is non-modal and anchored; a modal dims the page and blocks.

note.zh: Alert 是页内消息条，不打断；Modal 是必须处理的浮层。
note.en: Alert is in-page messaging; a modal is a blocking overlay.

note.zh: Lightbox 专管图片/视频放大，Modal 承载通用任务。
note.en: Lightbox is media zoom; a modal hosts general tasks.

note.zh: 最经典形态，标题 + 正文 + 操作区
note.en: The classic: title, body and action row

note.zh: 小尺寸，只放一句文案和两个按钮
note.en: Compact, one sentence plus two buttons

note.zh: 移动端常见，从底部升起承接长内容
note.en: Mobile pattern, rising from the bottom for longer content

内容容量.zh: 中，适合短内容与小型表单
内容容量.en: Medium — short content and small forms

移动端友好.en: Medium — go full-screen for long content

notes.zh: 遮罩用 fixed inset-0 + 半透明黑，面板用 flex 居中或 inset-0 m-auto。 打开时锁定 body 滚动，焦点移入面板，Esc 与点击遮罩均可关闭。 入场动画 scale 0.96→1 加淡入，200ms 左右；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Backdrop is fixed inset-0 with translucent black; center the panel with flex or auto margins. Lock body scroll on open, move focus into the panel, close on Esc and backdrop click. Enter animation: scale 0.96→1 with fade, ~200ms; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个模态框（Modal）组件：点击按钮弹出居中对话框，带遮罩层，包含标题、正文和操作按钮。
basic.en: Create a Modal component: a button opens a centered dialog with a backdrop, containing a title, body and action buttons.

design.zh: 创建模态框组件。要求：半透明遮罩 + 居中白色面板（圆角、阴影）；标题区、正文区、底部右对齐操作区（次要按钮 + 主要按钮）； 打开时面板轻微放大淡入；支持 Esc 与点击遮罩关闭；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a modal. Requirements: translucent backdrop plus a centered surface panel (rounded, shadowed); title, body and a bottom-right action row (secondary + primary button); panel zooms in slightly with a fade on open; closes on Esc and backdrop click; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Modal：open 受控；fixed inset-0 遮罩 + flex 居中面板； 打开时锁定 body overflow，焦点移入并做简单 focus trap，Esc 关闭； 入场用 keyframes（scale + opacity），时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)； aria-role="dialog" aria-modal="true"，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Modal: controlled open state; fixed inset-0 backdrop with a flex- centered panel; lock body overflow on open, move focus in with a simple focus trap, close on Esc; enter keyframes (scale + opacity) scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1); role="dialog" aria-modal="true"; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现模态框（Modal）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色、圆角与阴影变量。
用途：删除确认与快速编辑。
要求：
- 遮罩 + 居中面板，Esc 与点击遮罩关闭
- 打开时锁定滚动、焦点移入面板
- 入场动画轻微，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 深浅色主题一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Modal component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface, radius and shadow variables.
Usage: delete confirmation and quick edit.
Requirements:
- Backdrop + centered panel; close on Esc and backdrop click
- Lock scroll and move focus into the panel while open
- Subtle enter animation, respecting prefers-reduced-motion
- Consistent light/dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 打开对话框，尝试确认、取消与关闭。
task.en: Open the dialog and explore confirmation and dismissal.

checks.zh: 模态开启期间焦点应留在对话框内。
checks.en: Keep focus inside while the modal is open.

checks.zh: 关闭后回到触发入口，避免丢失操作位置。
checks.en: Return focus to the trigger after dismissal.

description.zh: 允许从一组选项中挑选多个值，并以标签形式回显已选集合的选择控件。与单选下拉不同，展开面板在选择后保持打开，已选项可逐个移除；适合标签、权限、筛选条件等需要累积多个值的表单场景。选项很多时应配合搜索。
description.en: A control for picking several values from one option set, echoing the chosen ones as removable chips. Unlike a single select, the panel stays open after each pick and every chip can be removed on its own. Fits tags, permissions and filter facets; pair it with search when the set is large.

use_when.zh: 需要一次提交多个值，如标签、权限、筛选条件
use_when.en: Several values must be committed at once — tags, permissions, filter facets

use_when.zh: 已选项需要随时可见并可单独删除
use_when.en: Selections must stay visible and individually removable

use_when.zh: 选项集合固定，且可能较多、需要搜索或分组
use_when.en: A fixed option set that may grow large and need search or grouping

avoid_when.zh: 只能选一个值，用 select 或 combobox 更准确
avoid_when.en: Only one value is allowed — select or combobox states that better

avoid_when.zh: 选项少于 5 个且无需回显，平铺 checkbox 更快
avoid_when.en: Fewer than 5 options with no echo needed — visible checkboxes are faster

avoid_when.zh: 值由用户自由创造而非从列表挑选，用 tag-input
avoid_when.en: Values are free-form inventions rather than list picks — use a tag input

note.zh: 已选项以可删除标签排布在控制区内，最常见形态
note.en: Selected values sit in the control as removable chips

note.zh: 选项平铺为复选框组，所见即所得
note.en: Options laid out as checkboxes — what you see is what you get

note.zh: 左右两个列表加转移按钮，适合大量已选项的管理
note.en: Two panes with transfer buttons for managing large selections

task.zh: 用鼠标和键盘各完成一次多选与删除标签。
task.en: Complete a multi-select and chip-remove once with mouse and once with keyboard.

checks.zh: 每个已选项可单独移除
checks.en: Each selected item can be removed individually

checks.zh: 空状态或搜索无结果时有提示
checks.en: Empty / no-result states are explained

note.zh: select 是互斥单选，多选框组累积多个值并以标签回显
note.en: Select commits one value; multi-select accumulates many and echoes them as chips

note.zh: combobox 强调输入检索并提交单值，多选框组强调集合管理
note.en: Combobox searches and commits one value; multi-select manages a set

disambiguation.zh: 「多选」口语上也可能指 checkbox 复选框本身；本词条专指带列表与标签回显的组合选择控件。
disambiguation.en: Colloquially "multi-select" may mean a plain checkbox; this entry covers the list-plus-chips composite control.

notes.zh: 控制区用 flex-wrap 排布标签，高度随已选项增长；列表绝对定位在下方，max-height + overflow-y-auto 控制高度。选择不关闭面板，Escape 收起，点击外部关闭。键盘在选项间移动并用 aria-selected 标注，标签的删除按钮需可聚焦。
notes.en: Lay chips out with flex-wrap so the control grows with the selection; park the listbox below with max-height and overflow-y-auto. Picking keeps the panel open, Escape collapses it and outside click closes it. Mark choices with aria-selected, and keep each chip's remove button focusable.

basic.zh: 创建一个多选框组组件，可从列表挑选多个值，已选项以标签回显并可单独删除。
basic.en: Create a multi-select that picks several values from a list and echoes them as individually removable chips.

design.zh: 设计多选框组。要求：控制区内已选项以标签回显，标签带删除按钮；展开列表中已选项有勾选态；空状态与无结果均有说明文案；选择后面板保持打开；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Design a multi-select. Requirements: selected values echo as chips with remove buttons inside the control; open options show a checked state; empty and no-result cases are explained; the panel stays open after picking; consistent light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现多选框组：value 为字符串数组；列表 role="listbox" 且 aria-multiselectable="true"，选项 role="option" + aria-selected；点击选项切换成员而不关闭面板；标签删除按钮与选项均可用键盘访问；支持清空全部。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind multi-select: value is a string array; the list uses role="listbox" with aria-multiselectable="true" and options use role="option" plus aria-selected; toggling membership keeps the panel open; chip remove buttons and options are keyboard reachable; provide clear-all.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现一个 Multi-select 多选控件。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，支持键盘操作。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Multi-select control in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first and reuse what is already there.
Keep the current visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and support keyboard operation.
Run the existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 固定在页面顶部的水平导航条：左侧品牌标识，中间主导航链接，右侧搜索、 入口按钮与用户头像。它是网站的"门面导航"，把最重要的三到七个入口压进 一条横向空间，移动端折叠为汉堡菜单。常配合 position: sticky 在滚动时保持可见。
description.en: A horizontal navigation bar pinned to the top of the page: brand on the left, primary links in the middle, search, actions and avatar on the right. It is the front door of a site — the 3–7 most important destinations compressed into one strip, folding into a hamburger menu on mobile. Usually kept visible with position: sticky.

use_when.zh: 入口少而扁平的官网、产品站、文档站
use_when.en: Marketing, product and docs sites with few flat destinations

use_when.zh: 品牌与全局动作需要常驻首屏
use_when.en: Brand and global actions must stay pinned above the fold

use_when.zh: 页面结构上下流动、适合顶部横向空间
use_when.en: Vertically scrolling layouts that can spare one horizontal strip

avoid_when.zh: 层级深、模块多的后台（侧边栏更合适）
avoid_when.en: Deep admin hierarchies — prefer a sidebar

avoid_when.zh: 需要同时扫视大量导航项
avoid_when.en: Scanning many nav items at once

avoid_when.zh: 沉浸式阅读、编辑器等全屏场景
avoid_when.en: Immersive reading or editor modes

note.zh: 品牌左、链接中、动作右
note.en: Brand left, links center, actions right

note.zh: 链接绝对居中，Apple 官网风格
note.en: Absolutely centered links, Apple-style

note.zh: 压在首屏大图上，滚动后加底色
note.en: Floats over the hero, gains a background on scroll

note.zh: 导航置于带圆角、描边与轻阴影的独立容器中。
note.en: Place navigation in a rounded, outlined container with a subtle shadow.

notes.zh: 用 sticky 置顶，内部 flex 三段式（品牌 / 链接 / 动作）。当前项用 accent 色或下划线标识（aria-current="page"）。移动端断点下隐藏链接、显示汉堡 按钮，展开为下拉面板或抽屉；透明悬浮变体在滚动超过首屏高度后切换 background 与 backdrop-filter。
notes.en: Sticky top bar with a three-part flex row (brand / links / actions). Mark the current item with accent color or underline (aria-current="page"). Below the mobile breakpoint hide the links behind a hamburger that opens a dropdown or drawer; the overlay variant gains background and backdrop-filter after scrolling past the hero.

basic.zh: 创建一个顶部导航栏组件，包含品牌标识、若干主导航链接、搜索入口和用户头像区。
basic.en: Create a navbar with a brand mark, a few primary links, a search entry and a user area.

design.zh: 创建顶部导航栏：高 56px、sticky 置顶；左侧 Logo + 产品名，中间 4 个导航链接 （当前项用强调色下划线标识），右侧搜索框 + 主按钮 + 头像。移动端折叠为汉堡 按钮并展开为下拉菜单。深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a navbar: 56px tall, sticky; logo + product name on the left, four links in the middle (active item marked with an accent underline), search box + primary button + avatar on the right. Folds into a hamburger dropdown on mobile. Consistent in light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Navbar：header + sticky top-0 + z-index；链接数据驱动， activeId 受控，当前项加 aria-current="page"；sm 断点以下切换汉堡按钮与折叠面板 （max-height 过渡）。提供 gap、theme 变体参数。不引入依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind navbar: header with sticky top-0 and z-index; data-driven links with a controlled activeId and aria-current="page" on the active item; below the sm breakpoint swap to a hamburger with a max-height transition panel. Expose gap and theme props. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现顶部导航栏。

先检查现有路由结构与导航数据来源，复用现有品牌资源与 Design Token。
要求：
- sticky 置顶，含品牌区、导航链接、搜索入口、用户区
- 当前路由高亮（aria-current="page"）
- 移动端折叠为汉堡菜单，展开动画平滑
- 深浅色主题一致
- 不新增不必要的依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a navbar in the current project.

Check the existing routing structure and nav data source first; reuse brand assets and design tokens.
Requirements:
- Sticky top bar with brand, links, search entry and user area
- Active route highlighted (aria-current="page")
- Folds into a hamburger menu on mobile with smooth animation
- Consistent light/dark themes
- No unnecessary dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 切换导航栏目，展开菜单，搜索资源并体验开始按钮。
task.en: Switch sections, expand navigation, search resources and try the primary action.

checks.zh: 当前栏目与展示内容应对应。
checks.en: The active section should agree with displayed content.

checks.zh: 窄屏下导航仍有可发现的入口。
checks.en: Keep navigation discoverable in narrow layouts.

description.zh: 用带页码的控件把长结果集切分为离散页面：用户显式点击页码或上一页 / 下一页 按钮取回对应片段，当前位置永远可知、可分享、可回退。与无限滚动的"失控 漂移"相对，它是数据浏览中最可控的方式，也是搜索结果与后台表格的默认选择。
description.en: A page-numbered control that slices long result sets into discrete pages: users explicitly click a page number or prev / next to fetch that slice, so the current position is always known, shareable and reversible. The controlled counterpart to infinite scrolling's endless drift — the default for search results and admin tables.

use_when.zh: 结果集有序、用户需要定位与回溯
use_when.en: Ordered results where users track and revisit positions

use_when.zh: 需要可分享的页码 URL（搜索、后台表格）
use_when.en: Shareable page URLs — search results, admin tables

use_when.zh: 需要跳到末页或精确页码
use_when.en: Jumping to an exact page or the last page matters

avoid_when.zh: 休闲浏览的无限信息流
avoid_when.en: Casual feeds meant for endless browsing

avoid_when.zh: 结果集很小，一页即可容纳
avoid_when.en: Tiny result sets that fit on one page

avoid_when.zh: 内容无法均匀切分且顺序常变
avoid_when.en: Content that cannot be evenly or stably sliced

note.zh: 完整页码 + 省略号，可控性最强
note.en: Full numbers + ellipsis, most control

note.zh: 仅上一页 / 下一页与计数
note.en: Prev / next with a counter only

note.zh: 页码 + 输入跳转，适合超大结果集
note.en: Numbers + jump input for huge sets

anatomy: 上一页 / 下一页按钮

触发方式.zh: 显式点击页码或翻页按钮

数据控制.zh: 强，用户掌握并记住页码位置
数据控制.en: Strong — the user holds the position

notes.zh: 页码窗口算法：始终显示首末页与当前页 ± 1，中间折叠为省略号。当前页用 aria-current="page" 与强调色块标识；首末页时禁用上一页 / 下一页 （disabled + aria-disabled）。URL 同步用查询参数 ?page=n，保证可分享可回退。
notes.en: Windowing algorithm: always show the first and last pages plus current ± 1, folding the middle into ellipses. Mark the current page with aria-current="page" and an accent block; disable prev / next at the edges (disabled + aria-disabled). Sync the URL with ?page=n so positions are shareable and reversible.

basic.zh: 创建一个分页组件：上一页、页码列表（带省略号折叠）、下一页，当前页高亮，点击切换。
basic.en: Create a pagination control: prev, a page list with ellipsis folding, next, active page highlighted, switching on click.

design.zh: 创建分页：28px 方形页码按钮，当前页用强调色实底反白；页码超过 7 位时中间 折叠为省略号；首末页禁用翻页按钮并用次级色表达；右侧显示"第 n / m 页"。 深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create pagination: 28px square page buttons with the current page in solid accent and reversed text; fold middles into ellipses beyond 7 slots; disable prev/next at the edges in secondary color; show "page n of m" on the right. Consistent in light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Pagination：total 与 page 受控，onChange 回调； 页码窗口算法（首末页 + 当前页 ± 1 + 省略号）；当前页 aria-current="page"； 边界禁用翻页；提供 simple（仅上下页）与 jump（输入跳页，回车提交）变体。 无新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind pagination: controlled total and page with an onChange callback; windowing algorithm (first/last + current ± 1 + ellipses); aria-current="page" on the active item; prev/next disabled at the edges; simple (prev/next only) and jump (input + Enter) variants. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现分页组件。

先检查现有列表 / 表格的数据获取方式，分页状态应与路由查询参数同步。
要求：
- page / total 受控，URL 同步（?page=n）
- 页码窗口折叠省略号，当前页 aria-current="page"
- 边界正确禁用上一页 / 下一页
- 切页后列表滚动位置回到顶部
- 键盘可达（页码为 button，跳页输入回车提交）
- 不新增不必要的依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement pagination in the current project.

Check how existing lists or tables fetch data; page state should sync with the route query (?page=n).
Requirements:
- Controlled page / total, URL-synced
- Windowed numbers with ellipses, aria-current="page" on the active one
- Prev / next correctly disabled at the edges
- Scroll the list back to the top after switching
- Keyboard accessible (page buttons; jump input submits on Enter)
- No unnecessary dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 切换页码与前后页，观察首尾边界。
task.en: Try page numbers and previous/next controls, including boundaries.

checks.zh: 第一页不能继续向前，最后一页不能继续向后。
checks.en: Disable movement before the first or beyond the last page.

checks.zh: 页码变化时同时更新内容，不只改变按钮颜色。
checks.en: Changing pages must update content as well as button styling.

description.zh: 点击触发元素后在其旁边弹出的非模态浮层，可承载文字说明、小型表单、日期选择等中等复杂内容。 无遮罩、不阻断页面其余部分，点击外部区域或 Esc 即关闭。
description.en: A non-modal layer that pops up beside its trigger on click, carrying medium-complex content such as text, a mini-form or a date picker. No backdrop and no blocking of the rest of the page; clicking outside or pressing Esc closes it.

use_when.zh: 点击后需要承载可交互内容（小表单、过滤、颜色选择）
use_when.en: Interactive content on click (mini-form, filters, color picker)

use_when.zh: 补充说明的信息量超过一行 tooltip
use_when.en: Explanations longer than a one-line tooltip

use_when.zh: 需要保持底层页面可见且可用
use_when.en: The page must stay visible and usable

avoid_when.zh: 只有一句话说明（改用 tooltip）
avoid_when.en: A one-line hint — use a tooltip

avoid_when.zh: 强制确认或长流程（改用 modal）
avoid_when.en: Forced confirmation or long flows — use a modal

avoid_when.zh: 内容需要大量滚动（改用 drawer）
avoid_when.en: Scroll-heavy content — use a drawer

disambiguation.zh: Popover 是锚定触发元素的非打断浮层，内容任意；Tooltip 只读、悬停即出；Dropdown 列表只放命令。
disambiguation.en: A popover is a non-blocking anchored overlay with free-form content. A tooltip is read-only on hover. A dropdown list holds commands only.

note.zh: Tooltip 只读、短暂、悬停触发；Popover 可交互、点击触发。
note.en: A tooltip is brief read-only on hover; a popover is interactive on click.

note.zh: Dropdown 列表是命令项，Popover 内容任意。
note.en: A dropdown list is commands; popover content is free-form.

note.zh: Modal 遮罩整页，Popover 不遮罩、可点外部关闭。
note.en: A modal dims the page; a popover does not, and dismisses on outside click.

note.zh: 帮助说明文字，最轻量
note.en: Help text only, the lightest

note.zh: 内含输入框、按钮等可操作元素
note.en: Contains inputs and buttons

note.zh: 带图片或结构化信息卡
note.en: Image or structured info card

打断程度.en: Low — no backdrop, page stays live

移动端友好.zh: 差，锚定位置易溢出屏幕

notes.zh: 以触发元素为锚 absolute 定位（或用 floating-ui 思路测量并翻转防溢出）。 点击外部关闭：在 document 上监听 pointerdown 判断 target 是否在浮层内；Esc 同样关闭，焦点移入浮层。 入场 scale 0.95→1 加淡入，150~200ms；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Anchor to the trigger with absolute positioning (or measure and flip like floating-ui to prevent overflow). Close on outside click: listen for pointerdown on document and check the target; Esc closes too and focus moves into the panel. Enter with scale 0.95→1 plus fade, 150–200ms; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个气泡卡片（Popover）组件：点击按钮在按钮旁弹出小卡片，点击外部区域关闭。
basic.en: Create a Popover component: clicking a button opens a small card next to it, clicking outside closes it.

design.zh: 创建 Popover 组件。要求：浮层卡片出现在触发元素下方（带小箭头），圆角、边框、大阴影； 标题 + 正文 + 可选操作区；入场轻微放大淡入；点击外部与 Esc 关闭；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a Popover. Requirements: the card appears below the trigger (with a small arrow), rounded, bordered, heavily shadowed; title, body and optional action row; subtle zoom-and-fade entrance; closes on outside click and Esc; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Popover：触发元素 relative 包裹，浮层 absolute top-full； open 受控，useEffect 在 document 监听 pointerdown，target 不在容器内则关闭， 监听 keydown Esc 关闭；入场 keyframes（scale + opacity，时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Popover: relative wrapper around the trigger, absolute top-full panel; controlled open state; useEffect listens for pointerdown on document and closes when the target is outside, plus Esc on keydown; enter keyframes (scale + opacity) scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1); respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现气泡卡片（Popover）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色、圆角与阴影变量。
用途：帮助说明与小型操作面板。
要求：
- 锚定触发元素，贴近屏幕边缘时自动翻转
- 点击外部与 Esc 关闭，焦点管理正确
- 入场动画轻微，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Popover component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface, radius and shadow variables.
Usage: help explanations and small action panels.
Requirements:
- Anchored to the trigger, flips near screen edges
- Closes on outside click and Esc, with correct focus management
- Subtle enter animation, respecting prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 点击触发入口打开浮层，检查内容与关闭方式。
task.en: Open the popover and inspect its content and dismissal.

checks.zh: 浮层应靠近触发位置，避免遮住关键操作。
checks.en: Position it near its trigger without obscuring essential actions.

checks.zh: 若内容可交互，必须支持键盘访问。
checks.en: Interactive content must remain keyboard accessible.

aliases: 显示百分之多少的横条

description.zh: 用横条从左到右填充来表示任务完成比例的加载指示，常配百分比或步骤文字。 适用于时长可预测的确定性任务：上传、下载、安装与分步表单。
description.en: A loading indicator where a horizontal bar fills left to right to express task completion, usually with a percentage or step label. For determinate tasks with predictable duration: uploads, downloads, installs and multi-step forms.

use_when.zh: 时长可预测的确定性任务（上传、导出）
use_when.en: Determinate tasks with known duration (upload, export)

use_when.zh: 分步流程中展示当前进行到第几步
use_when.en: Step position in a multi-step flow

use_when.zh: 时长超过 3 秒、需要传达量感
use_when.en: Tasks over 3 seconds where magnitude matters

avoid_when.zh: 时长不可知（用 loading-spinner 或骨架屏）
avoid_when.en: Indeterminate duration — use a spinner or skeleton

avoid_when.zh: 极短任务（< 1 秒，直接完成即可）
avoid_when.en: Very short tasks — just let them finish

avoid_when.zh: 无法给出真实进度（宁可显示不定态，避免假进度）
avoid_when.en: Unknown progress — show indeterminate rather than faking it

note.zh: 已知比例按值填充
note.en: Fills by value when the ratio is known

note.zh: 滑块往复运动，表达进行中但时长未知
note.en: A slider loop: working, duration unknown

note.zh: 附百分比或步骤文字
note.en: Percentage or step text beside the bar

notes.zh: 轨道固定高度（4~8px）圆角，填充条用 width 百分比或 transform scaleX 过渡； 不定态用 keyframes 平移一小块往复循环。务必绑定真实进度事件，无法获知时用不定态而非假进度。 可达性：role="progressbar" + aria-valuenow / aria-valuemin / aria-valuemax。
notes.en: Fixed-height (4–8px) rounded track; fill transitions by width percentage or transform scaleX; indeterminate loops a small block with keyframes. Bind to real progress events — prefer indeterminate over a fake bar. Accessibility: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow / aria-valuemin / aria-valuemax.

basic.zh: 创建一个进度条（Progress Bar）组件：显示任务完成百分比，支持确定与不定两种状态。
basic.en: Create a Progress Bar component: shows task completion as a percentage, supporting determinate and indeterminate states.

design.zh: 创建进度条组件。要求：6px 高圆角轨道 + 强调色填充；右侧或上方标注百分比（等宽数字）； 完成时变为成功色并可显示对勾；不定态用小块往复滑动动画；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a progress bar. Requirements: 6px rounded track with an accent fill; the percentage beside or above in tabular figures; turns success-coloured with a check on completion; indeterminate state slides a small block back and forth; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 ProgressBar：value 0-100 受控；轨道 div 内填充 div style={{ width: `${value}%` }} 配 transition（时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）； 不定态用 keyframes translateX 往复；role="progressbar" + aria-valuenow； 达 100 时切换成功态；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind ProgressBar: controlled value 0–100; inner fill div with style={{ width: `${value}%` }} and a transition (duration scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1)); indeterminate loop via translateX keyframes; role="progressbar" + aria-valuenow; switch to a success state at 100; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现进度条（Progress Bar）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的强调色与表面色变量。
用途：文件上传与分步表单。
要求：
- 确定态绑定真实进度值，不定态用往复动画
- role="progressbar" + aria-valuenow 可达性
- 完成态有明确的视觉变化
- 动画尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Progress Bar component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
accent and surface colour variables.
Usage: file uploads and multi-step forms.
Requirements:
- Determinate mode bound to real progress; indeterminate loop animation
- role="progressbar" + aria-valuenow accessibility
- Clear visual change on completion
- Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 观察进度变化，比较确定进度与不确定进度。
task.en: Compare determinate progress with an indeterminate indicator.

checks.zh: 已知总量才显示百分比，不伪造处理进度。
checks.en: Show percentages only when the total is known.

checks.zh: 进度完成后应切换为明确的成功或失败反馈。
checks.en: Follow completion with a clear success or failure message.

description.zh: 用一组圆形按钮表示互斥选项，同组内只能选中一个且不可取消。 与复选框的核心区别是多选与单选；选中圆点用填充动画反馈， 选项少（2～5 个）时平铺展示比下拉选择效率更高。
description.en: A set of circular buttons for mutually exclusive options — exactly one selected per group, never unset. The core contrast with checkboxes is single versus multi selection; the dot fills with animation on select, and with 2–5 options a visible radio group beats a dropdown.

use_when.zh: 选项 2～5 个且互斥，需要一眼看全
use_when.en: 2–5 mutually exclusive options that should stay visible

use_when.zh: 默认选中项明确、无需取消选择
use_when.en: A clear default exists and unselecting is not needed

use_when.zh: 支付方式、配送方式等并列方案选择
use_when.en: Parallel plans like payment or delivery methods

avoid_when.zh: 需要多选，用复选框
avoid_when.en: Multiple selections — use checkboxes

avoid_when.zh: 选项多于 5 个，用下拉选择节省空间
avoid_when.en: More than 5 options — a select saves space

avoid_when.zh: 开 / 关二元即时切换，用 switch
avoid_when.en: Binary on/off toggling — use a switch

note.zh: 圆点 + 文字的经典排布
note.en: Classic dot-and-text layout

note.zh: 整卡可点，带描述信息
note.en: Clickable card with descriptions

note.zh: 横向排布，适合密集表单
note.en: Horizontal row for dense forms

notes.zh: 自定义圆圈用 border 圆形 + 内部小圆点 scale 弹出动画；选中态整组 name 一致保证原生互斥。React 中受控 value 对比实现选中。 整行 label 可点击扩大热区；键盘上下键在组内移动（原生自带）。 卡片式用外框高亮代替圆点强调，但保留 radio 语义。
notes.en: Custom circles use a bordered ring with an inner dot scaling in; shared name keeps native exclusivity. In React, controlled value comparison drives selection. Make full rows clickable; arrow keys move within the group natively. Card styles emphasize via outer ring highlight while keeping radio semantics.

basic.zh: 创建一个单选框组件，支持默认、卡片式与行内分段三种样式。
basic.en: Create a radio group component with default, card and inline segmented styles.

design.zh: 创建单选框组件。要求：圆形框内选中圆点 scale 弹入；卡片式整卡可点、 选中时 accent 描边高亮并展示描述文案；组内互斥且始终有一项选中； 深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a radio group component. Requirements: inner dot scaling in inside a circular ring; card style fully clickable with an accent ring and description when selected; mutually exclusive with one always selected; consistent in light/dark.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 RadioGroup：受控 value + onChange，选项数据驱动 （{value, label, description}）；原生 input[type=radio] 隐藏 + 自定义外观， 保留键盘行为；圆点动画 scale 0 → 1，时长乘 --demo-speed；卡片式 aria-checked + 描边切换。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind RadioGroup: controlled value + onChange with data-driven options ({value, label, description}); hide native inputs but keep their keyboard behavior; dot animation scales 0 to 1 with duration multiplied by --demo-speed; card style toggles aria-checked and ring highlight.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现单选框组件。

先检查现有表单组件与 Design Token，保持风格一致。
要求：
- 受控单选，组内互斥、始终有选中项
- 支持默认 / 卡片式两种样式
- 键盘可达（原生 radio 行为 + label 关联）
- 深浅色主题一致，动画尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a radio group component in the current project.

Inspect existing form components and design tokens first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Controlled single selection, exclusive, always one selected
- Default and card styles
- Keyboard accessible (native radio behavior + label association)
- Consistent light/dark themes; animation respects prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 在互斥选项间切换，用方向键检查组内选择。
task.en: Switch mutually exclusive options and try arrow-key selection.

checks.zh: 同组只有一个当前值，标签描述选择后果。
checks.en: Keep one value per group and explain each choice.

checks.zh: 不能依赖占位说明传达组的名称。
checks.en: Give the group a visible, persistent name.

description.zh: 用有限等级收集主观评价的输入组件，常见形式是星级或带文字的满意度选项。悬停表示候选分值，点击或键盘选择才提交当前值。应提供每一档的文字含义，区分尚未评分与最低分；只读平均分则应明确标注统计数量，避免让用户误以为可以操作。
description.en: An input for a bounded subjective score, often represented by stars or labeled satisfaction levels. Hover previews a value; pointer or keyboard selection commits it. Give each level a text meaning, distinguish no rating from the lowest score, and label read-only averages and their sample counts clearly.

use_when.zh: 收集一次服务或产品体验的满意度。
use_when.en: Collect satisfaction after a service or product experience.

use_when.zh: 有明确等级定义的轻量反馈。
use_when.en: Gather lightweight feedback with defined score levels.

avoid_when.zh: 需要解释问题原因时还应提供文本反馈。
avoid_when.en: Add text feedback when reasons matter.

avoid_when.zh: 精确的数量或测量值应使用数字输入。
avoid_when.en: Use numeric input for precise quantities or measurements.

note.zh: 五级星标，每档带文字说明。
note.en: Five stars with labeled score levels.

note.zh: 用表情或符号表达满意程度。
note.en: Use expressive symbols to indicate satisfaction.

notes.zh: 单选评分可使用同名 radio。每档设置可访问名称，悬停预览不能覆盖已确认分值。未评分时禁用提交；尊重 reduced-motion。只读星级不要使用可交互角色。
notes.en: Use same-name radios for one score. Label each value and keep hover preview separate from the committed score. Disable submission before selection and respect reduced motion. Do not use interactive roles for read-only ratings.

task.zh: 悬停预览分数，再点击或用键盘选择。移开鼠标后确认所选分值，再提交。
task.en: Preview with hover, choose with pointer or keyboard, then move away to verify the committed score before submitting.

checks.zh: 悬停只预览，移开后恢复已选分数。
checks.en: Hover is temporary; leaving restores the selected score.

checks.zh: 零分值代表未选择，提交后有明确反馈。
checks.en: An unset value is distinct from a score; submission gives feedback.

basic.zh: 创建评分组件。收集一次服务或产品体验的满意度。
basic.en: Create a Rating component. Collect satisfaction after a service or product experience.

design.zh: 设计评分，以清楚的层级、可见的状态和明确的反馈为优先。五级星标，每档带文字说明。用表情或符号表达满意程度。悬停只预览，移开后恢复已选分数。零分值代表未选择，提交后有明确反馈。
design.en: Design a Rating with clear hierarchy and state feedback. Five stars with labeled score levels. Use expressive symbols to indicate satisfaction. Hover is temporary; leaving restores the selected score. An unset value is distinct from a score; submission gives feedback.

implementation.zh: 单选评分可使用同名 radio。每档设置可访问名称，悬停预览不能覆盖已确认分值。未评分时禁用提交；尊重 reduced-motion。只读星级不要使用可交互角色。
implementation.en: Use same-name radios for one score. Label each value and keep hover preview separate from the committed score. Disable submission before selection and respect reduced motion. Do not use interactive roles for read-only ratings.

agent.zh:
先检查当前项目的组件与样式体系，复用已有能力实现评分。
要求：
- 单选评分可使用同名 radio。每档设置可访问名称，悬停预览不能覆盖已确认分值。未评分时禁用提交；尊重 reduced-motion。只读星级不要使用可交互角色。
- 悬停只预览，移开后恢复已选分数。
- 零分值代表未选择，提交后有明确反馈。
- 窄屏可用，深浅色一致，尊重 reduced-motion。
- 不新增依赖。
运行项目现有检查，并列出修改文件及验证结果。
agent.en:
Inspect existing components and tokens before implementing Rating.
Requirements:
- Use same-name radios for one score. Label each value and keep hover preview separate from the committed score. Disable submission before selection and respect reduced motion. Do not use interactive roles for read-only ratings.
- Hover is temporary; leaving restores the selected score.
- An unset value is distinct from a score; submission gives feedback.
- Support narrow screens, both themes and reduced motion.
- Add no dependencies.
Run existing checks and list changed files and validation results.

description.zh: 将少量互斥选项并排放在同一个容器中的选择控件。选中状态通过底色、文字和边界同时表达，切换后立即更新当前视图或设置。它适合时间范围、显示方式等轻量选择；选项应简短、稳定且始终可见。与标签页不同，它通常修改同一内容的呈现方式，而不是进入另一组内容。
description.en: A compact group of mutually exclusive choices with an immediately visible selection. Use it to change a time range or display mode within the same view. Keep labels short and all choices visible. Unlike tabs, it usually changes how the current content is presented rather than moving between separate panels.

use_when.zh: 在统计图中选择周、月、年。
use_when.en: Choose a week, month or year for a chart.

use_when.zh: 在同一内容中切换显示密度或排序方式。
use_when.en: Change density or ordering in one view.

avoid_when.zh: 选项过多或名称较长时使用选择框。
avoid_when.en: Use a select for many or lengthy options.

avoid_when.zh: 允许同时选中多个值时使用复选框。
avoid_when.en: Use checkboxes for multiple selections.

disambiguation.zh: Segmented Control（分段控制器）是紧凑的互斥选择条，常用于模式/筛选；Tabs 切换内容面板；Radio 是表单内互斥选择。
disambiguation.en: A segmented control is a compact mutually-exclusive switch for modes or filters. Tabs swap content panels. Radio is in-form single choice.

note.zh: Tabs 对应内容面板，Segmented Control 对应状态/模式。
note.en: Tabs map to content panels; segmented control to state or mode.

note.zh: Radio 属表单字段，Segmented Control 属视图切换。
note.en: Radio is a form field; segmented control is a view switch.

note.zh: Switch 是开/关二态，Segmented Control 是多选一。
note.en: A switch is on/off; a segmented control picks one of several.

note.zh: 共享底板，选中项抬高，适合工具界面。
note.en: A shared surface with a raised selection for utility interfaces.

note.zh: 外边框包裹，选中项用强调色表达。
note.en: An outer border with an accented selection.

notes.zh: 互斥值优先使用原生同名 radio，保留方向键操作。整段共用一个可访问名称；不要只靠颜色表示选中状态。每个选项至少提供 40px 的点击高度，结果随选择同步更新。
notes.en: Use native radios with the same name to retain arrow-key navigation. Give the group an accessible name and make selection visible beyond color. Aim for a 40px target height and update the result immediately.

task.zh: 用鼠标或方向键切换周、月、年，观察统计数值和图表同步变化。
task.en: Switch between week, month and year with pointer or arrow keys; watch both the metric and chart update.

checks.zh: 选中项和展示结果应始终一致。
checks.en: The selected option must agree with the displayed result.

checks.zh: 一组只能选中一项，方向键可以连续切换。
checks.en: Exactly one option is selected; arrow keys move through the group.

basic.zh: 创建分段控制器组件。在统计图中选择周、月、年。
basic.en: Create a Segmented Control component. Choose a week, month or year for a chart.

design.zh: 设计分段控制器，以清楚的层级、可见的状态和明确的反馈为优先。共享底板，选中项抬高，适合工具界面。外边框包裹，选中项用强调色表达。选中项和展示结果应始终一致。一组只能选中一项，方向键可以连续切换。
design.en: Design a Segmented Control with clear hierarchy and state feedback. A shared surface with a raised selection for utility interfaces. An outer border with an accented selection. The selected option must agree with the displayed result. Exactly one option is selected; arrow keys move through the group.

implementation.zh: 互斥值优先使用原生同名 radio，保留方向键操作。整段共用一个可访问名称；不要只靠颜色表示选中状态。每个选项至少提供 40px 的点击高度，结果随选择同步更新。
implementation.en: Use native radios with the same name to retain arrow-key navigation. Give the group an accessible name and make selection visible beyond color. Aim for a 40px target height and update the result immediately.

agent.zh:
先检查当前项目的组件与样式体系，复用已有能力实现分段控制器。
要求：
- 互斥值优先使用原生同名 radio，保留方向键操作。整段共用一个可访问名称；不要只靠颜色表示选中状态。每个选项至少提供 40px 的点击高度，结果随选择同步更新。
- 选中项和展示结果应始终一致。
- 一组只能选中一项，方向键可以连续切换。
- 窄屏可用，深浅色一致，尊重 reduced-motion。
- 不新增依赖。
运行项目现有检查，并列出修改文件及验证结果。
agent.en:
Inspect existing components and tokens before implementing Segmented Control.
Requirements:
- Use native radios with the same name to retain arrow-key navigation. Give the group an accessible name and make selection visible beyond color. Aim for a 40px target height and update the result immediately.
- The selected option must agree with the displayed result.
- Exactly one option is selected; arrow keys move through the group.
- Support narrow screens, both themes and reduced motion.
- Add no dependencies.
Run existing checks and list changed files and validation results.

description.zh: 用收起的单行控件承载一组互斥选项，点击展开面板后选择其一，选中值常驻显示在触发器上。 比 radio 更省空间，适合选项多于 5 个的场景；面板支持滚动、分组或搜索，选择即关闭。
description.en: A collapsed single-line control holding a set of mutually exclusive options; expanding the panel reveals them and the chosen value stays on the trigger. More space-efficient than radios, suited to more than 5 options; the panel can scroll, group or search, and picking one closes it.

use_when.zh: 选项数量多于 5 个且互斥单选
use_when.en: More than 5 mutually exclusive options

use_when.zh: 表单空间有限，需要收起选项列表
use_when.en: Tight form space — options must stay collapsed

use_when.zh: 选项可分组或较长（国家、时区、分类）
use_when.en: Long or groupable option sets like countries, timezones, categories

avoid_when.zh: 选项少于 5 个，直接平铺 radio 更快
avoid_when.en: Fewer than 5 options — visible radios are faster

avoid_when.zh: 选项很多且需要键盘快速检索，用可搜索的下拉或命令面板
avoid_when.en: Many options needing quick search — use a searchable select or command palette

avoid_when.zh: 允许多选时需明确多选语义，避免误用单选下拉
avoid_when.en: Multi-select semantics must be explicit — do not disguise it as single select

note.zh: 系统控件，移动端体验最好
note.en: OS control — best on mobile

note.zh: 可完全定制样式与分组
note.en: Fully styleable with grouping

note.zh: 以标签（chip）呈现已选集合
note.en: Selected set shown as chips

notes.zh: 触发器样式与输入框一致，右侧 chevron 随展开旋转；面板绝对定位于触发器下方， max-height + overflow-y-auto 控制高度。键盘用 aria-expanded / role="listbox" / role="option" 与 aria-selected 标注，Escape 关闭、点击外部关闭。 多选时点击不关闭，已选项以 chip 展示。
notes.en: Style the trigger like an input with a chevron rotating when open; the panel is absolutely positioned below with max-height and overflow-y-auto. Mark up with aria-expanded, role="listbox", role="option" and aria-selected; close on Escape and outside click. In multi-select, clicks stay open and selections render as chips.

basic.zh: 创建一个下拉选择组件，点击展开选项面板，选中值显示在触发器上。
basic.en: Create a select component that opens an option panel on click and shows the chosen value on the trigger.

design.zh: 创建下拉选择组件。要求：触发器与输入框风格一致（边框 + 右侧旋转 chevron）， 展开面板带阴影、当前项高亮、支持滚动；选中后面板关闭并更新触发器文案； 支持选项分组；深浅色一致。
design.en: Create a select component. Requirements: trigger styled like an input (border + rotating chevron); panel with shadow, highlighted current option and scrolling; selecting closes the panel and updates the trigger; option groups supported; consistent in light/dark.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Select：受控 value 与 open 状态；面板绝对定位 + max-h-60 overflow-auto；选项 role="option" + aria-selected；监听 document 点击 与 Escape 关闭；键盘上下键移动高亮项。多选模式选项点击不关闭，value 为数组， 已选渲染为可删除 chip。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Select: controlled value and open state; panel absolutely positioned with max-h-60 overflow-auto; options with role="option" and aria-selected; close on document click and Escape; arrow keys move the highlight. Multi-select keeps the panel open, value is an array rendered as removable chips.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现下拉选择组件。

先检查现有表单组件与弹出层实现，保持风格与层级（z-index）一致。
要求：
- 受控单选，触发器显示当前值 + 旋转 chevron
- 展开面板：滚动、当前项高亮、点击外部与 Escape 关闭
- 无障碍：aria-expanded、role=listbox/option、键盘上下选择
- 深浅色主题一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a select component in the current project.

Inspect existing form components and overlay implementations first; keep styles and z-index consistent.
Requirements:
- Controlled single select; trigger shows the value + rotating chevron
- Panel: scrollable, highlighted current option, closes on outside click and Escape
- Accessibility: aria-expanded, role=listbox/option, arrow-key selection
- Consistent light/dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 打开选项列表并切换值，比较原生与自定义选择方式。
task.en: Open the list, change the value and compare selection variants.

checks.zh: 选中值应在关闭后继续清楚展示。
checks.en: Keep the selected value visible after closing.

checks.zh: 选项过多时考虑可搜索选择框。
checks.en: Consider a combobox for a large option set.

description.zh: 固定在页面一侧（通常左侧）的垂直导航区，承载产品的主要层级入口。 后台管理系统的事实标准：顶部放品牌与全局搜索，侧边栏放模块树，内容区专注任务。
description.en: A vertical navigation area pinned to one side of the page (usually the left), carrying the primary hierarchy of a product. The de facto standard of admin systems: brand and global search on top, module tree in the sidebar, content focused on the task.

use_when.zh: 层级较多的后台、文档站、管理面板
use_when.en: Deep-hierarchy admin panels, docs sites, dashboards

use_when.zh: 导航项需要常驻可见、随时切换
use_when.en: Navigation must stay visible for quick switching

use_when.zh: 桌面端为主的宽屏布局
use_when.en: Desktop-first, wide-screen layouts

avoid_when.zh: 移动端（改为抽屉或底部导航）
avoid_when.en: Mobile — use a drawer or bottom nav instead

avoid_when.zh: 层级极少的简单官网（顶部导航更轻）
avoid_when.en: Simple sites with few sections — a top nav is lighter

avoid_when.zh: 内容需要最大化宽度（如阅读、编辑器写作模式）
avoid_when.en: Width-hungry content like reading or writing modes

note.zh: 常驻 240px 左右，最经典
note.en: Persistent ~240px, the classic

note.zh: 收成图标条，兼顾密度与空间
note.en: Collapses to icon rail — balances density and space

note.zh: 与内容区脱开，卡片式悬浮（Linear 风格）
note.en: Detached, floating card style (Linear-like)

notes.zh: 布局用 flex：侧栏固定宽 + 内容区 flex-1；侧栏内部 overflow-y-auto，sticky 顶部。 折叠态用 width 过渡（240px ↔ 64px），图标居中，文字 opacity 隐藏。 移动端断点下转为 fixed 抽屉 + 遮罩。当前项用 accent 色块或左侧竖条标识。
notes.en: Flex layout: fixed-width sidebar + flex-1 content; sidebar scrolls internally, sticky top. Collapse animates width (240px ↔ 64px) with icon-centered items and text fading out. On mobile breakpoints it becomes a fixed drawer with backdrop. Mark the active item with an accent block or left bar.

basic.zh: 创建一个后台侧边栏组件，包含品牌区、分组导航和底部用户区。
basic.en: Create an admin sidebar with a brand area, grouped navigation and a bottom user section.

design.zh: 创建固定侧边栏（240px）：顶部 Logo，中部两级分组导航（分组标题小写灰字 + 菜单项），当前项用强调色左侧竖条 + 浅色背景标识；底部头像 + 设置。支持折叠为 64px 图标栏，折叠动画平滑。深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a fixed sidebar (240px): logo on top; two-level grouped nav (small grey group labels + items); active item marked with an accent left bar and soft background; bottom avatar + settings. Collapsible to a 64px icon rail with smooth animation. Consistent in light/dark.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Sidebar：aside 固定宽 + 内部 overflow-y-auto；分组数据驱动（{label, items}）；activeId 受控；折叠态通过 width transition 与图标 tooltip；移动端 lg 断点以下转 fixed 抽屉 + 遮罩，受 open 受控。键盘可访问：nav landmark + aria-current。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind sidebar: fixed-width aside with internal scroll; data-driven groups ({label, items}); controlled activeId; collapsed state via width transition with icon tooltips; below lg it becomes a fixed drawer with backdrop, open state controlled. Accessibility: nav landmark + aria-current.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现后台侧边栏。

先检查现有路由结构与导航数据来源，保持一致。
要求：
- 固定 240px，可折叠为 64px 图标栏（记忆折叠状态）
- 分组导航数据驱动，当前路由项高亮（aria-current）
- 移动端转为抽屉 + 遮罩
- 深浅色主题一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement an admin sidebar in the current project.

Check the existing routing structure and navigation data source first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Fixed 240px, collapsible to a 64px icon rail (persist collapsed state)
- Data-driven grouped nav; active route highlighted (aria-current)
- Becomes a drawer with backdrop on mobile
- Consistent light/dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 切换侧栏入口，比较展开和收起后的信息密度。
task.en: Switch navigation items and compare expanded and collapsed density.

checks.zh: 当前页面有明确标记，收起后保留可理解名称。
checks.en: Mark the current page and retain accessible names when collapsed.

checks.zh: 窄屏要避免侧栏长期占用内容宽度。
checks.en: Avoid permanently reserving sidebar width on narrow screens.

description.zh: 用轨道上可拖动的手柄在连续区间内取值，拖动时数值与已填充轨道实时跟随。 适合调音量、亮度、价格区间等量级选择，比输入框更直观； 可带刻度标记、步进与双端区间形态。
description.en: A draggable handle on a track picks a value from a continuous range, with the number and filled track following in real time. Ideal for magnitudes like volume, brightness or price ranges — more intuitive than a text box; supports tick marks, steps and a dual-handle range form.

use_when.zh: 在连续区间内选量级（音量、透明度、预算）
use_when.en: Picking a magnitude in a range like volume, opacity or budget

use_when.zh: 精确数值不重要，相对大小即可
use_when.en: Exact numbers matter less than relative magnitude

use_when.zh: 双端选择价格区间等范围场景
use_when.en: Range scenarios like dual-handle price bounds

avoid_when.zh: 需要精确输入，用带验证的数字输入框
avoid_when.en: Precise input is required — use a validated number field

avoid_when.zh: 离散选项少于 5 个，用 radio 或分段控件
avoid_when.en: Fewer than 5 discrete options — use radios or a segmented control

avoid_when.zh: 触控目标过小且无键盘替代，导致拖动困难
avoid_when.en: Tiny touch targets without keyboard fallback make dragging hard

note.zh: 一个手柄取一个值
note.en: One handle, one value

note.zh: 轨道下方标注刻度点
