Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 悬停或聚焦触发元素，查看补充说明。
task.en: Hover or focus the trigger to view supporting text.

checks.zh: 提示补充标签，不承载唯一的关键说明。
checks.en: Supplement labels rather than hide essential instructions.

checks.zh: 不能只支持鼠标悬停，键盘聚焦也应可见。
checks.en: Expose the same hint on keyboard focus, not only hover.

description.zh: 以嵌套分支展示层级结构的可展开列表，每层节点可折叠或展开，子节点缩进排布于父节点之下。适合文件目录、组织架构、分类体系等天然成树的数据；节点可单选或多选，展开状态与选中状态相互独立。
description.en: An expandable list that shows hierarchy as nested branches: each node folds or opens and its children indent underneath. Fits file directories, org charts and taxonomies. Nodes may be single- or multi-select, and expanded state stays independent of selection.

use_when.zh: 数据天然分层，如目录、组织架构、分类树
use_when.en: Data is naturally hierarchical — directories, org charts, taxonomies

use_when.zh: 需要折叠分支以管理大量同级节点
use_when.en: Branches must fold to manage a large number of siblings

use_when.zh: 层级关系本身是信息的一部分
use_when.en: The nesting itself is part of the information

avoid_when.zh: 只有两层且每层几项，用 accordion 或分组列表
avoid_when.en: Two shallow levels with few items — accordion or grouped list is lighter

avoid_when.zh: 层级是导航框架而非内容，用 sidebar 或 menu
avoid_when.en: Hierarchy is site chrome rather than content — use a sidebar or menu

avoid_when.zh: 扁平长列表更适合，用 table 或 list
avoid_when.en: A flat long list serves better — use a table or list

note.zh: 同时只有一个节点被选中，常配合详情面板
note.en: One node selected at a time, often feeding a detail pane

note.zh: 可勾选多个节点，父节点支持半选态
note.en: Nodes checkable in batches, parents exposing an indeterminate state

note.zh: 带类型图标的目录树，最常见的产品形态
note.en: Directory tree with type icons — the familiar product form

task.zh: 展开与折叠若干分支，用方向键在节点间移动并选中一个深层节点。
task.en: Expand and collapse branches, move with arrow keys and select a deep node.

checks.zh: 展开状态与选中状态相互独立
checks.en: Expanded state and selected state are independent

checks.zh: 键盘可在父子与兄弟节点间连续移动
checks.en: Keyboard focus walks parents, children and siblings in order

note.zh: accordion 是并列分区的开合，tree-view 表达任意深度的父子层级
note.en: Accordion opens sibling sections; tree-view expresses parent-child nesting at any depth

note.zh: menu 用于命令与导航动作，tree-view 用于浏览并选择层级数据
note.en: Menu issues commands and navigation; tree-view browses and selects hierarchical data

disambiguation.zh: 「树」有时也指思维导图或组织架构图；本词条专指可展开、可选择的列表式树形控件。
disambiguation.en: Tree may also mean a mind map or org chart; this entry covers the expandable, selectable list control.

notes.zh: 子层级用递归缩进（padding-left 或 margin-left）表达深度，也可用竖向参考线辅助阅读。展开指示是小三角或加减号，旋转或切换图标表达状态；折叠时隐藏子树但保留 DOM 语义。键盘遵循 roving tabindex，方向键在可见节点间移动。
notes.en: Show depth with recursive indent (padding-left or margin-left), optionally with guide rules. The twisty is a small triangle or plus/minus that rotates or swaps with state; collapsed subtrees hide visually while keeping tree semantics. Use a roving tabindex and let arrows walk visible nodes.

basic.zh: 创建一个树形控件，展示可展开折叠的层级节点，并支持选中某个节点。
basic.en: Create a tree view of expandable hierarchical nodes with node selection.

design.zh: 设计树形控件。要求：子节点缩进对齐父节点；展开指示清晰且状态可辨；选中行有高亮；层级过深时缩进收敛；空分支有说明；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Design a tree view. Requirements: children indent under parents; the twisty is legible across states; the selected row highlights; indent stays readable when nesting goes deep; empty branches explain themselves; consistent light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现树形控件：数据为嵌套节点数组，递归渲染 role="tree" / role="treeitem"；节点带 aria-expanded，容器 aria-multiselectable 视需求而定；roving tabindex + 方向键（上/下/左/右）控制焦点，Enter 或 Space 选中。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind tree view: render a nested node array recursively into role="tree" and role="treeitem"; nodes carry aria-expanded and the container takes aria-multiselectable as needed; a roving tabindex with arrow keys (up/down/left/right) drives focus and Enter or Space selects.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现树形控件（Tree View）组件。
先检查现有列表、折叠与 Design Token，优先复用缩进、图标与高亮样式。
用途：文件目录、组织架构、分类体系。
要求：
- 嵌套节点可展开折叠，展开态与选中态独立
- role=tree / treeitem，aria-expanded 正确标注
- 键盘可在节点间连续移动并选中
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，深浅色一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Tree View component in the current project.
Inspect existing lists, collapsibles and design tokens first and reuse indent, icon and highlight styles.
Usage: file directories, org charts and taxonomies.
Requirements:
- Nested nodes expand and collapse; expanded state is independent of selection
- role=tree / treeitem with correct aria-expanded
- Keyboard focus walks nodes continuously and can select
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion; consistent light and dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run the existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

aliases: 为什么卡片看起来不精致

description.zh: 把盒子四角做成圆弧，半径越大越柔和、越像卡片与气泡。圆角要和组件尺寸成套：按钮小、卡片中、大容器大，才像同一个家族；相邻圆角盒之间会留下难看的凹口，需要用同心圆角（外半径 = 内半径 + 间距）修正，或让它们干脆对齐。
description.en: Rounding a box's corners softens it; the bigger the radius, the more it reads as a card or bubble. Radius must scale with the component — small on buttons, medium on cards, large on containers — so everything looks like one family. Adjacent rounded boxes leave an awkward notch, fixed with concentric radii (outer = inner + gap) or by aligning them flush.

use_when.zh: 需要柔化品牌气质，并区分卡片、按钮与容器的层级
use_when.en: Softening the brand feel while separating cards, buttons and containers

use_when.zh: 按钮、输入框、头像等基础控件要统一圆角语言
use_when.en: Buttons, inputs and avatars need one shared rounding language

use_when.zh: 嵌套容器需要同心圆角，保持内角与外角视觉顺滑
use_when.en: Nested containers need concentric radii so inner and outer corners stay smooth

avoid_when.zh: 严肃的数据表格与像素级对齐的网格
avoid_when.en: Serious data tables and pixel-aligned grids

avoid_when.zh: 12px 的小图标上加大圆角，反而糊成一团
avoid_when.en: Heavy rounding on a 12px icon just smears it

avoid_when.zh: 用超大圆角把方形卡片压成胶囊，丢掉信息密度
avoid_when.en: Blowing a rectangular card into a pill and losing information density

note.zh: 支持斜杠语法分别控制横纵半径
note.en: Slash syntax controls horizontal and vertical radii separately

note.zh: 成档的圆角工具类
note.en: Stepped rounding utilities

note.zh: 4～8px，克制、专业，适合表格与密集控件
note.en: 4–8px — restrained and professional for tables and dense controls

note.zh: 12～16px，卡片与面板的常用档，友好但不轻浮
note.en: 12–16px — the usual card and panel step, friendly but not gimmicky

note.zh: 9999px 或 50%，用于按钮、标签和头像
note.en: 9999px or 50% — for buttons, tags and avatars

notes.zh: 用 rem 定义 4～5 档：--radius-sm 4px、--radius-md 8px、--radius-lg 12px、--radius-xl 16px、--radius-full 9999px。组件的圆角跟随自身尺寸取档，父容器圆角明显时内层用 calc(var(--radius-lg) - var(--space-2)) 做同心。头像与开关用 50% 或 --radius-full。密切注意 1px 边框下的圆角抗锯齿，必要时内层留 1px。
notes.en: Define four or five rem steps — --radius-sm 4px, --radius-md 8px, --radius-lg 12px, --radius-xl 16px, --radius-full 9999px. Components pick a step by their own size, and inside a visibly rounded parent the child uses calc(var(--radius-lg) - var(--space-2)) to stay concentric. Avatars and switches take 50% or --radius-full. Watch anti-aliasing under 1px borders and inset by 1px where needed.

basic.zh: 建立圆角体系：用成档的半径令牌统一按钮、卡片与容器，并处理嵌套时的同心圆角。
basic.en: Build a radius system — stepped tokens unifying buttons, cards and containers, with concentric radii for nesting.

design.zh: 圆角规范：4～5 档（sm 4 / md 8 / lg 12 / xl 16 / full 9999px）；按钮用 md，卡片用 lg，大面板用 xl，头像用 50%；嵌套容器内圆角 = 外圆角 − 内边距；同一界面圆角档位不超过四种；1px 边框下注意内外对齐。
design.en: Radius spec: four to five steps (sm 4 / md 8 / lg 12 / xl 16 / full 9999px); buttons use md, cards lg, large panels xl, avatars 50%. For nested containers, inner radius = outer − padding. Keep to four radius steps per screen, and align inner and outer edges under 1px borders.

implementation.zh: 令牌写成 :root { --radius-sm: 4px; --radius-md: 8px; --radius-lg: 12px; --radius-xl: 16px; --radius-full: 9999px; }，组件引用 var(--radius-md)。同心圆角写 border-radius: calc(var(--radius-lg) - var(--space-2))。Tailwind 侧映射到 theme 的 --radius-*，避免在组件里散落裸 px 值。
implementation.en: Write the tokens as :root { --radius-sm: 4px; --radius-md: 8px; --radius-lg: 12px; --radius-xl: 16px; --radius-full: 9999px; } and reference var(--radius-md) from components. For concentric corners use border-radius: calc(var(--radius-lg) - var(--space-2)). Map them into Tailwind theme --radius-* tokens and avoid scattering raw px values in components.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现圆角体系。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 4～5 档圆角令牌，组件按尺寸取档
- 嵌套容器使用同心圆角 calc(外 − 内边距)
- 头像与开关用 50% / full，不散落裸 px
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a border-radius system in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Four to five radius tokens; components pick a step by size
- Nested containers use concentric calc(outer − padding)
- Avatars and switches use 50% / full; no scattered raw px
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 用线条勾出元素的边界与状态：border 占据盒模型空间、outline 画在盒外不挤动布局、box-shadow 的 ring 用透明阴影描一圈。 普通态用低对比 border 静默分界，悬停加深、聚焦用 outline、报错换色；三者各司其职，边界才既清楚又不抖动。
description.en: Lines that mark an element's edge and its state. border takes up box-model space, outline paints just outside it without nudging layout, and a box-shadow ring draws a halo that costs no space. Pair a low-contrast border for quiet division with a darker hover, an outline for focus, and a recolour for errors so edges read clearly and nothing jumps.

use_when.zh: 输入框、卡片、按钮需要用细线勾出可点区域
use_when.en: Inputs, cards and buttons need a thin line to mark the hit area

use_when.zh: 悬停、聚焦、报错需要可感知但不重排布局的状态差
use_when.en: Hover, focus and error states need a visible cue that does not reflow

use_when.zh: 扁平风格里没有投影，靠描边区分相邻表面
use_when.en: Flat styles with no shadows rely on strokes to separate surfaces

avoid_when.zh: 用粗彩色边框装饰每个区块，页面像被框满的表格
avoid_when.en: Thick coloured borders on every block make the page a grid of boxes

avoid_when.zh: 在 border 与 outline 之间反复切换同一元素，宽度突跳
avoid_when.en: Toggling one element between border and outline makes widths jump

avoid_when.zh: 拿描边替代留白和分隔线来组织信息层级
avoid_when.en: Strokes used instead of whitespace or rules to organise hierarchy

note.zh: 计入盒模型尺寸，稳定但会占位；配 box-sizing: border-box 不撑破容器
note.en: Counts in the box model and always takes space; pair with box-sizing: border-box

note.zh: 画在盒外，可 outline-offset 拉开距离，不参与布局；聚焦态首选
note.en: Painted outside the box, offsettable, layout-neutral; first choice for focus

note.zh: 用 0 0 0 Npx 的 box-shadow 模拟描边，不占空间、可叠多层
note.en: A 0 0 0 Npx box-shadow fakes a stroke with zero space and stackable layers

sources.name: W3C — CSS Backgrounds and Borders Level 3

notes.zh: 全局设 box-sizing: border-box，让边框算进声明宽度，加粗描边不会把相邻元素挤走。默认态用 1px 的 --color-line 静默分界； 悬停换成 --color-line-strong；聚焦用 outline（不占位、可 offset），不要用 border 代替，否则元素会跳 2px； 报错换语义色并加一条 error 文案，别只靠颜色。需要无位描边时用 box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-accent-soft)。
notes.en: Set box-sizing: border-box globally so borders count inside the declared width and a heavier stroke cannot shove neighbours. Default to a 1px --color-line; swap to --color-line-strong on hover; use outline for focus (no space, offsettable) rather than border, which would jump the element by its own width. Errors recolour semantically and add text, never colour alone. For a zero-space stroke use box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-accent-soft).

basic.zh: 建立描边规范：定义 border、outline、ring 三种描边的用法与默认 1px 边框令牌。
basic.en: Define a stroke system — when to use border, outline and a shadow ring, plus a default 1px border token.

design.zh: 描边规范：默认 1px 低对比边框，悬停加深一档；聚焦一律用 2px outline + 2px offset，禁止用 border 做聚焦； 报错换语义色并附文案；所有元素 box-sizing: border-box；圆角成阶梯（4/8/12/16）；同屏描边颜色不超过三档。
design.en: Stroke spec: a 1px low-contrast border by default, one step darker on hover; focus is always a 2px outline with 2px offset, never a border; errors recolour semantically and add text; everything uses box-sizing: border-box; corner radii step 4/8/12/16; no more than three stroke colours on one screen.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 变量落地：--border-width: 1px; --color-line 与 --color-line-strong 控制默认与悬停；聚焦写成 :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }；全局 * { box-sizing: border-box; }。 需要无位描边时改用 box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-accent-soft)。不要在内容盒上写死 px 边框。
implementation.en: Ship it with CSS variables: --border-width: 1px; --color-line and --color-line-strong for default and hover; focus as :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }; and * { box-sizing: border-box; } globally. For space-free strokes use box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-accent-soft). Never hard-code pixel borders in content boxes.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现边框与描边。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 全局 box-sizing: border-box
- border / outline / ring 三种描边各有明确用途，聚焦只用 outline
- 悬停、聚焦、报错三种状态有可感知但不重排的差异
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement borders and strokes in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- box-sizing: border-box globally
- Clear roles for border / outline / ring, with focus using outline only
- Hover, focus and error states differ without reflowing layout
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 断点是布局发生切换的视口宽度临界值：窄于此用一套排版，宽于此换另一套。断点应由内容决定——把窗口慢慢拉宽，哪里开始拥挤、哪里变难看，那里就是断点，而不是照搬 iPhone、iPad 的型号宽度。移动优先用 min-width 从小到大叠加，断点越少越容易维护。
description.en: Breakpoints are viewport widths where a layout changes. Pick them where content crowds, not device names, then stack mobile-first min-width rules.

use_when.zh: 同一页面在手机和桌面需要不同列数或导航形态
use_when.en: One page needs different column counts or navigation on phone and desktop

use_when.zh: 需要在某个宽度切换侧栏、字号或间距密度
use_when.en: A width threshold should switch the sidebar, type scale or density

use_when.zh: 从移动端基线出发、逐级增强的响应式布局
use_when.en: Building mobile-first and enhancing upward step by step

avoid_when.zh: 只有一种固定宽度、无需适配的嵌入式控件
avoid_when.en: A fixed-width embedded widget that never adapts

avoid_when.zh: 用设备型号（iPhone 15、iPad Pro）当断点名
avoid_when.en: Naming breakpoints after device models such as iPhone 15 or iPad Pro

avoid_when.zh: 断点堆到十来个，样式互相打架、难以维护
avoid_when.en: A dozen breakpoints fighting each other and hard to maintain

note.zh: 移动优先的最小宽度媒体查询
note.en: Mobile-first minimum-width media query

note.zh: 前缀即 min-width 断点
note.en: Prefixes are min-width breakpoints

note.zh: 按组件容器宽度而非视口切换
note.en: Switch on component width, not the viewport

note.zh: 先写窄屏基线，再用 min-width 逐级叠加
note.en: Write the narrow baseline first, then stack min-width rules

note.zh: 把窗口拉宽，哪里挤了哪里就是断点
note.en: Widen the window; wherever it crowds is the breakpoint

note.zh: 断点值集中成变量或配置，避免散落魔法数
note.en: Centralise breakpoint values as tokens, not scattered magic numbers

notes.zh: 先写窄屏样式作为基线，再用 @media (min-width: ...) 逐级覆盖，避免 desktop-first 的 max-width 降级写法。断点值用 em/rem（48rem＝768px）而不是 px，用户放大字号时仍按内容切换；断点集中定义成 CSS 变量或 Tailwind screens，组件内不散写魔法数。能靠 flex-wrap、grid auto-fit、clamp() 自适应的地方就别加断点。
notes.en: Write narrow styles as the base, then override upward with @media (min-width: ...) instead of desktop-first max-width. Express breakpoints in em/rem (48rem = 768px) so they follow zoom; define them once as CSS variables or Tailwind screens and never scatter magic numbers inside components. Where flex-wrap, grid auto-fit or clamp() can adapt, skip the breakpoint entirely.

basic.zh: 建立一套响应式断点：按内容需要定义切换宽度，让布局从小屏到大屏平滑变化。
basic.en: Establish a set of responsive breakpoints — define switch widths from content needs so the layout adapts from small to large screens.

design.zh: 断点规范：移动优先，只用 min-width；断点值用 rem（48rem＝768px、64rem＝1024px）并集中定义；每档写清布局怎么变（列数、导航、间距）；断点数量控制在 3～5 个；优先用 flex-wrap、grid auto-fit、clamp() 做自适应，只有真正需要换结构时才新增断点。
design.en: Breakpoint spec: mobile-first, min-width only; values in rem (48rem = 768px, 64rem = 1024px) defined in one place; document what changes at each step (columns, navigation, spacing); keep to three to five breakpoints; prefer flex-wrap, grid auto-fit and clamp() for adaptation, adding a breakpoint only when the structure truly changes.

implementation.zh: 用 min-width 媒体查询从窄到宽覆盖：.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; } @media (min-width: 48rem) { .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }。断点值写成 CSS 变量或 Tailwind screens；组件级切换用 container-type: inline-size 配合 @container。避免 max-width 降级写法，也不要逐元素写死断点。
implementation.en: Layer min-width queries from narrow to wide: .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; } @media (min-width: 48rem) { .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }. Keep breakpoint values in CSS variables or Tailwind screens; for component-scoped switching add container-type: inline-size and use @container. Avoid desktop-first max-width rewrites and per-element hard-coded thresholds.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现响应式断点。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 移动优先，只用 min-width 媒体查询
- 断点值集中定义（CSS 变量或 Tailwind screens），组件内不写魔法数
- 断点数量控制在 3～5 个，优先用自适应布局替代断点
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement responsive breakpoints in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Mobile-first, min-width media queries only
- Breakpoint values defined in one place (CSS variables or Tailwind screens); no magic numbers in components
- Three to five breakpoints at most; prefer adaptive layout over new breakpoints
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 从一个基色出发生成有规律的色阶（50～900），再分配主色、辅助色、点缀色与中性色角色。色阶靠明度递进而非随手取色，保证 hover、disabled、边框都有对应深度可选；角色先于色值被命名，主题才换得动。
description.en: Start from one base hue and generate an ordered ramp (50–900), then assign primary, secondary, accent and neutral roles. Steps advance by lightness rather than ad-hoc picks, so hover, disabled and border always have the right depth on hand. Name roles before hex values and themes stay swappable.

use_when.zh: 产品需要一套可扩展的品牌色与中性灰体系
use_when.en: The product needs an extensible brand ramp plus neutral greys

use_when.zh: 同一色相需要 hover、active、disabled 等多个深度
use_when.en: One hue needs several depths for hover, active and disabled

use_when.zh: 深浅主题共用同一套角色，只换色阶取值
use_when.en: Light and dark themes share roles and swap only ramp values

avoid_when.zh: 插画或营销页一次性用色，不需要系统化
avoid_when.en: One-off illustration or campaign colours with no system need

avoid_when.zh: 把十种高饱和色直接堆进界面，无主次
avoid_when.en: Ten saturated hues stacked with no hierarchy

avoid_when.zh: 只有黑白灰两色且永不扩展——写死即可
avoid_when.en: A permanent two-colour black-and-white UI — hard-code it

note.zh: 感知均匀的色阶插值
note.en: Perceptually even ramp interpolation

note.zh: 一个基色拉出 50～900，配中性灰
note.en: One base hue stretched 50–900 plus neutrals

note.zh: 色轮对面取辅助色，对比强
note.en: Secondary from the opposite side of the wheel — high contrast

note.zh: 只用明度差，彩色仅作点缀
note.en: Lightness-only with a single accent spark

notes.zh: 用 oklch() 或 hsl() 按明度生成 50～900 十档：浅端 L≈97%，深端 L≈12%，中间保持感知均匀；饱和度浅端略降、深端略升。色阶命名 --color-primary-500，不要写 --color-brand-blue。中性灰单独一条低饱和色阶，不要用纯黑纯白。生成后用对比度工具抽查 500/600 与白字的组合。
notes.en: Generate ten steps (50–900) in oklch() or hsl() by lightness: near L≈97% at the light end, L≈12% at the dark end, perceptually even between; ease saturation down at the light end and up at the dark. Name steps --color-primary-500, never --color-brand-blue. Keep a separate low-saturation neutral ramp — no pure black or white. Spot-check 500/600 against white text with a contrast tool.

basic.zh: 生成一套调色板：从品牌基色拉出 50～900 色阶，并定义主色、辅助色、点缀色与中性色。
basic.en: Generate a colour palette — a 50–900 ramp from the brand hue plus primary, secondary, accent and neutral roles.

design.zh: 调色板规范：一个基色生成 50～900 十档色阶（oklch 明度递进），主色取 500～600，点缀色一个即可，中性灰单独成阶；浅端降饱和、深端升饱和；所有文字与底色组合须过 WCAG AA；命名按角色不按色相。
design.en: Palette spec: one base hue generates ten steps 50–900 via oklch lightness; primary sits at 500–600; a single accent; a separate neutral ramp. Ease saturation down at the light end and up at the dark. Every text-on-background pair must pass WCAG AA. Name by role, not by hue.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 自定义属性输出色阶：--color-primary-50: oklch(97% 0.02 250); … --color-primary-900: oklch(18% 0.05 250);。角色层再引用色阶：--color-accent: var(--color-primary-600)。Tailwind 侧映射到 @theme 色板。生成脚本一次写入，后续只调角色指向。
implementation.en: Emit the ramp as CSS custom properties: --color-primary-50: oklch(97% 0.02 250); … --color-primary-900: oklch(18% 0.05 250);. A role layer then references steps: --color-accent: var(--color-primary-600). Map into Tailwind @theme. Generate once from a script; afterwards only re-point roles.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现调色板。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 基色生成 50～900 色阶，明度递进
- 主色 / 辅助 / 点缀 / 中性四类角色
- 命名按角色与档位，不写死色相名
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a colour palette in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- A 50–900 ramp from the base hue, advancing by lightness
- Primary / secondary / accent / neutral roles
- Names follow role and step, never the hue name
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 前景与背景的亮度比值，衡量文字是否看得清。WCAG 2.1 给出硬性门槛：正文 AA 4.5:1、AAA 7:1，大号文字降到 3:1 与 4.5:1。APCA 按字重与字号给出更贴近感知的建议值。先算比值再选色，不要靠肉眼验收。
description.en: The luminance ratio between foreground and background — the measure of whether text can be read. WCAG 2.1 sets hard floors: 4.5:1 for AA body, 7:1 for AAA, dropping to 3:1 and 4.5:1 for large text. APCA refines this by weight and size against perception. Compute the ratio before picking colours; never sign off by eye.

use_when.zh: 正文、标签、按钮文字需要满足无障碍基线
use_when.en: Body copy, labels and button text must meet accessibility floors

use_when.zh: 深浅主题切换后需要重新验证文字可读性
use_when.en: Text legibility must be re-verified after a theme switch

use_when.zh: 灰阶辅助文字（muted）容易不知不觉掉到 3:1 以下
use_when.en: Greyscale muted text silently drops below 3:1

avoid_when.zh: 装饰性大字或纯图形标识（另有非文本对比 3:1 要求）
avoid_when.en: Decorative display type or pure graphics — non-text contrast rules apply instead

avoid_when.zh: 被禁用的控件文字（WCAG 明确豁免）
avoid_when.en: Disabled control text — explicitly exempt in WCAG

avoid_when.zh: 把 AAA 当作所有界面的强制标准，导致设计空间过窄
avoid_when.en: Mandating AAA everywhere and strangling the design space

note.zh: 颜色 5 草案中的比值函数
note.en: The ratio function in CSS Color 5

note.zh: 4.5:1，绝大多数界面的默认门槛
note.en: 4.5:1 — the default floor for most UI

note.zh: 7:1，长文与老年用户场景
note.en: 7:1 — long-form and older audiences

note.zh: ≥24px 或 18.66px 粗体，门槛降到 3:1
note.en: ≥24px or 18.66px bold drops the floor to 3:1

notes.zh: 比值算法：先 sRGB 转线性亮度 Y，再 (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05)。正文锁 4.5:1，大号锁 3:1；辅助文字不要靠降低透明度凑层级，改用 ink-2 色阶。高对比主题用 prefers-contrast: more 或独立角色表。交付前对文字角色两两抽查，尤其是 muted 与 line。
notes.en: The formula: convert sRGB to linear luminance Y, then (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05). Lock body text at 4.5:1 and large text at 3:1. Do not fake hierarchy with opacity — use the ink-2 step instead. High-contrast themes come from prefers-contrast: more or a dedicated role table. Spot-check every text role pair before shipping, muted and line especially.

basic.zh: 检查界面对比度：保证正文、标题、辅助文字与背景的对比比值达到 WCAG AA。
basic.en: Check interface contrast — body, headings and captions must meet WCAG AA against their backgrounds.

design.zh: 对比度规范：正文 ≥4.5:1，大号文字（≥24px 或 18.66px 粗体）≥3:1，AAA 场景 7:1 / 4.5:1；边框与图标属非文本对比 ≥3:1；禁用态豁免但需可辨识；高对比主题单独取值表。颜色选择先过比值再进稿。
design.en: Contrast spec: body ≥4.5:1; large text (≥24px or 18.66px bold) ≥3:1; AAA targets 7:1 and 4.5:1. Borders and icons need non-text contrast ≥3:1. Disabled states are exempt but must stay recognisable. High contrast uses its own value table. Compute ratios before colours enter the design.

implementation.zh: 实现一个对比度工具函数 relativeLuminance(hex) 与 contrastRatio(a, b)，在 Storybook 或设计系统文档里对每个语义色组合跑断言；CSS 侧用 @media (prefers-contrast: more) 切换高对比角色值。CI 可对 token 表做批量校验，输出不达标的组合清单。
implementation.en: Ship relativeLuminance(hex) and contrastRatio(a, b) helpers and assert every semantic pair in Storybook or the design-system docs. Switch high-contrast role values with @media (prefers-contrast: more). Have CI batch-check the token table and list failing pairs.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现对比度。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 文字组合过 WCAG AA（正文 4.5:1 / 大号 3:1）
- 提供比值计算与达标判定工具函数
- 高对比主题走独立角色表或 prefers-contrast
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement contrast ratio in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Text pairs pass WCAG AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large)
- Helpers for ratio computation and pass/fail judgement
- High contrast via its own role table or prefers-contrast
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 用阴影的深浅表达元素离纸面的远近：0 贴平、1～2 浮起、3 以上成浮层。一套阴影由本影、半影、环境三层叠加而成，档位越高投影越大越淡。层级只用来表达叠放关系，不要拿它当装饰。
description.en: Shadow depth expresses how far an element sits from the page: 0 rests flat, 1–2 lift, 3 and above become overlays. Each shadow stacks umbra, penumbra and ambient layers — higher levels mean larger, softer casts. Use elevation to describe stacking relations, never as ornament.

use_when.zh: 卡片、菜单、弹层需要可感知的叠放次序
use_when.en: Cards, menus and popovers need a perceivable stacking order

use_when.zh: 可点击块要暗示“浮在页面之上”
use_when.en: Clickable blocks must suggest they float above the page

use_when.zh: 模态与吸顶栏需要比内容更高的投影档位
use_when.en: Modals and sticky bars need a higher level than content

avoid_when.zh: 扁平风格或新粗野主义，投影与语言冲突
avoid_when.en: Flat or neobrutalist languages where shadows clash

avoid_when.zh: 全屏堆满高档位投影，层级通胀后无人可信
avoid_when.en: High levels everywhere — inflation destroys the signal

avoid_when.zh: 用投影代替分隔线或留白来划分区域
avoid_when.en: Shadows used instead of rules or whitespace to divide regions

note.zh: 本影 + 半影双阴影，档位 0～5 清晰
note.en: Umbra plus penumbra — clear levels 0–5

note.zh: 无投影，靠 1px 边框与底色差
note.en: No shadow — 1px borders and surface tints

note.zh: 大而淡的单层投影，气质轻盈
note.en: One large, faint cast — airy and light

notes.zh: 把档位做成令牌：--elev-0: none; --elev-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.12); 每升一档投影更扩散、更淡。深色模式阴影几乎不可见，改用更亮的描边或提高表面亮度。浮层记得配 z-index 阶梯；贴边浮层用 env(safe-area-inset-*) 避开手势区。
notes.en: Tokenise the levels: --elev-0: none; --elev-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.12); each step spreads wider and lighter. Shadows barely read on dark surfaces — switch to brighter borders or lighter surface tints. Pair overlays with a z-index ladder and keep edge-docked layers clear of gestures via env(safe-area-inset-*).

basic.zh: 建立投影层级：定义 0～5 档 box-shadow 令牌，让卡片与浮层有清晰的深度差。
basic.en: Build an elevation system — 0–5 box-shadow tokens giving cards and overlays clear depth.

design.zh: 层级规范：0 贴平、1～2 卡片、3～4 弹层、5 模态；每档由本影 + 半影 + 环境三层叠加，档位越高投影越大越淡；深色模式改用描边或表面提亮；同屏浮层数量不超过 3 个档位差。投影只表达叠放，不作装饰。
design.en: Elevation spec: 0 flat, 1–2 cards, 3–4 popovers, 5 modals. Each level stacks umbra, penumbra and ambient — higher means larger and fainter. On dark surfaces use borders or lighter tints. Keep at most three level gaps among stacked overlays. Shadows describe stacking only, never decoration.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 变量定义档位：--elev-0 … --elev-5，组件写 box-shadow: var(--elev-2)。浮层容器配 z-index 令牌（--z-dropdown: 40; --z-modal: 50）。深色模式在 .dark 下覆盖 --elev-* 为描边方案。贴边浮层加 env(safe-area-inset-bottom) 内边距。
implementation.en: Define --elev-0 … --elev-5 as CSS variables and consume them as box-shadow: var(--elev-2). Overlays get z-index tokens (--z-dropdown: 40; --z-modal: 50). Override --elev-* to a border scheme under .dark. Edge-docked overlays take env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现层级。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 0～5 档投影令牌，档位越高越扩散越淡
- 卡片 / 弹层 / 模态各自固定档位
- 深色模式用描边或表面提亮补偿
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement elevation in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Levels 0–5 as shadow tokens, spreading lighter as they rise
- Fixed levels for cards / popovers / modals
- Dark mode compensated with borders or lighter surfaces
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 按优先级排列的字体回退链：首选字体缺席时依次落到下一个，最后由通用族兜底。系统栈零下载、即时渲染，网络字体保品牌气质但要配 font-display 控制闪烁，本地优先则两者之间取平衡。栈的顺序就是渲染的决策顺序。
description.en: An ordered fallback chain of typefaces: when the first face is missing the browser walks down to the next, with a generic family as the final safety net. System stacks cost nothing and render instantly; web fonts carry brand character but need font-display to tame flashing; local-first splits the difference. The order of the stack is the order of rendering decisions.

use_when.zh: 正文与 UI 文字需要在任何设备上稳定渲染
use_when.en: Body and UI text must render reliably on any device

use_when.zh: 品牌字体只覆盖部分字重或字符集，需要可靠回退
use_when.en: Brand fonts cover only some weights or scripts and need a solid fallback

use_when.zh: 首屏性能敏感，不希望字体请求阻塞文字显示
use_when.en: First paint matters and font requests must not block text

avoid_when.zh: 排版完全依赖单一展示字体且缺失即失效（如 Logo 字标）
avoid_when.en: Layout collapses without one display face — e.g. a logotype

avoid_when.zh: 栈里堆了七八个几乎相同的字体，决策成本高却无收益
avoid_when.en: Seven or eight near-identical faces — decision cost with no payoff

avoid_when.zh: 不同回退字体字宽差异过大，换字后版式崩坏
avoid_when.en: Fallbacks with wildly different metrics that break the layout on swap

note.zh: 自动子集化与 size-adjust 对齐
note.en: Automatic subsetting and size-adjust matching

note.zh: 零下载零闪烁，随操作系统变化而变化
note.en: Zero download, zero flash — varies with the OS

note.zh: 品牌一致性优先，需 font-display 与字宽度量对齐
note.en: Brand consistency first — needs font-display and metric matching

note.zh: 先用同名本地字体，缺了再下载，兼顾速度与气质
note.en: Use the local face when present, download only when missing

notes.zh: 字体栈写成一行：'Inter', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif。中文场景务必在拉丁字体后接中文族，否则汉字会落到丑陋的默认宋体。网络字体用 font-display: swap 或 optional；用 size-adjust / ascent-override 把回退字的字宽字高对齐到首选字体，换字瞬间不跳版。等宽场景单独维护 mono 栈。
notes.en: Write the stack in one line: 'Inter', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif. For CJK, always place a Chinese family after the Latin face or glyphs fall to an ugly default. Load web fonts with font-display: swap or optional; use size-adjust and ascent-override to match fallback metrics so nothing jumps on swap. Keep a separate mono stack for code.

basic.zh: 为项目建立字体栈：定义正文、标题、等宽三套 font-family 回退链。
basic.en: Set up font stacks — three font-family fallback chains for body, display and mono.

design.zh: 字体栈规范：正文 'Inter', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif；标题可用高对比衬线并给出中文回退；等宽 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace。网络字体 font-display: swap，并用 size-adjust 对齐回退度量；每条栈末尾必须有 sans-serif / serif / monospace 通用族。
design.en: Font stack spec: body 'Inter', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif; display may use a high-contrast serif with a CJK fallback; mono 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace. Web fonts load with font-display: swap and size-adjust metric matching. Every stack ends in a generic sans-serif / serif / monospace.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 变量集中管理字体栈：:root { --font-sans: 'Inter', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif; --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, monospace; }。@font-face 声明里写 font-display: swap 与 size-adjust；Tailwind 侧映射 font-sans / font-serif / font-mono。禁止在组件内散写 font-family 字符串。
implementation.en: Centralise stacks in CSS variables: :root { --font-sans: 'Inter', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif; --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, monospace; }. Declare font-display: swap and size-adjust on @font-face; map to Tailwind font-sans / font-serif / font-mono. Never scatter raw font-family strings inside components.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现字体栈。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 正文 / 标题 / 等宽三套 font-family 回退链，末尾带通用族
- 网络字体用 font-display 控制闪烁，并对齐回退字度量
- 中文回退族紧跟拉丁字体之后
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Three font-family chains for body / display / mono, each ending in a generic family
- Web fonts use font-display and metric-matched fallbacks
- CJK fallback sits directly after the Latin face
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 用列、槽间距与外边距把页面切成可复用的骨架。12 列最通用，因为它能被 2、3、4、6 整除，任意区块都能对齐到列线。 固定栅格稳但脆，repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) 让列数随可用宽度自动增减；容器查询进一步让组件按自身容器而非视口回流。
description.en: A reusable skeleton of columns, gutters and margins. Twelve columns is the default because 2, 3, 4 and 6 all divide into it, so any block can snap to the lines. A fixed grid is stable but brittle; repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) adds and drops tracks as space allows, and container queries reflow a component by its own width, not the viewport.

use_when.zh: 页面多个区块需要对齐到同一套列线
use_when.en: Several page blocks must align to one shared set of column lines

use_when.zh: 卡片墙要随可用宽度自动增减列数
use_when.en: A card wall should add or drop columns as width allows

use_when.zh: 同一组件在侧栏与主区都要自适应，不能只看视口
use_when.en: One component must adapt in a sidebar and a main column, not just by viewport

avoid_when.zh: 只有单块内容的极简页面，栅格只添嵌套
avoid_when.en: A single-block page where a grid only adds nesting

avoid_when.zh: 用栅格硬凑本就不需要对齐的自由排版
avoid_when.en: Forcing a grid onto free-form art that never needed alignment

avoid_when.zh: 嵌套栅格超过三层，间距层层叠加失控
avoid_when.en: Nesting grids more than three deep until gutters compound out of control

note.zh: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr))，区块按列数跨格，稳但断点写死
note.en: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)) with blocks spanning tracks — stable but breakpoints are fixed

note.zh: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))，列数交给浏览器，内容决定宽度
note.en: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) — the browser picks the count from content width

note.zh: 组件包 container-type: inline-size，按自身宽度而非视口回流
note.en: container-type: inline-size reflows by the component's own width, not the viewport

sources.name: W3C — CSS Grid Layout Module Level 1

notes.zh: 外层定容器最大宽与左右外边距（--grid-margin），列与列之间用 gap 而非 margin，避免末列多余间距。固定栅格写 repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr))，minmax 的 0 防止内容撑破列。自适应列表写 repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))， 列数交给浏览器。组件级响应式用 container-type: inline-size 配 @container，别一律迁就视口断点。
notes.en: Cap an outer container with a max width and side margins (--grid-margin); space columns with gap, never margins, so the last column has no extra offset. A fixed grid is repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)) — the 0 stops content from blowing out a track. Self-managing lists use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) and let the browser pick the count. For component-level responsiveness use container-type: inline-size with @container instead of always bending to viewport breakpoints.

basic.zh: 建立栅格系统：定义列数、槽间距与外边距，让区块对齐到同一套列线。
basic.en: Build a grid system — columns, gutters and margins that align blocks to one set of lines.

design.zh: 栅格规范：桌面 12 列、平板 8 列、手机 4 列；槽间距 16 与 24 两档；左右外边距随容器封顶；列表用 auto-fit + minmax 自适应，组件级布局用容器查询；禁止用 margin 模拟列间距，嵌套栅格不超过三层。
design.en: Grid spec: 12 columns desktop, 8 tablet, 4 mobile; gutters at 16 and 24; side margins capped with the container; lists adapt with auto-fit + minmax and components use container queries; never fake gutters with margins; do not nest more than three grids deep.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 变量落地：--grid-gutter 与 --grid-margin；外层容器 max-width 居中。栅格写 display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--grid-gutter)。自适应列表写 repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))。组件包 container-type: inline-size 并配 @container 规则。
implementation.en: Ship it with CSS variables: --grid-gutter and --grid-margin, with a centred max-width outer container. Grids are display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--grid-gutter). Adaptive lists use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)). Wrap components in container-type: inline-size and pair with @container rules.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现栅格系统。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 桌面 12 列 / 平板 8 列 / 手机 4 列，槽间距用 gap 令牌
- 卡片墙用 auto-fit + minmax 自适应列数
- 组件级响应式用 container-type 与 @container
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行现有项目检查，并列出修改的文件。

description.zh: 一行文字占的垂直空间，决定段落的松紧与呼吸。标题收紧（1.1～1.3）显得挺拔，正文放宽（1.5～1.8）利于逐行阅读，引文可以更松。优先用无单位倍数，让行高随字号缩放，而不是写死像素值。
description.en: The vertical space one line of text occupies — it sets how tight or airy a paragraph feels. Display type tightens (1.1–1.3) to look built; body loosens (1.5–1.8) to support line-by-line reading; quotes can go looser still. Prefer unitless multiples so leading scales with font size instead of freezing in pixels.

use_when.zh: 长段落正文需要可逐行追踪的阅读节奏
use_when.en: Multi-line body copy needs a trackable reading rhythm

use_when.zh: 标题与正文混排，需要通过行高拉开层级
use_when.en: Headings and body share a page and leading must separate them

use_when.zh: 字号会响应式变化，行高必须跟着缩放
use_when.en: Font sizes respond to viewport and leading must scale with them

avoid_when.zh: 单行标签、按钮文字——行高只用来垂直居中时改用 flex
avoid_when.en: Single-line labels — use flex for vertical centring, not leading

avoid_when.zh: 行高设得过松（> 2.0 正文），行与行失去联系
avoid_when.en: Body leading beyond 2.0 — lines lose their connection

avoid_when.zh: 用 px 锁死行高，字号一变就出现裁切或重叠
avoid_when.en: Pixel-locked leading that clips or overlaps when size changes

note.zh: 1.1～1.3，大标题挺拔不散
note.en: 1.1–1.3 — large headings stay solid

note.zh: 1.5～1.8，长文逐行好跟
note.en: 1.5–1.8 — long copy stays trackable

note.zh: 1.9～2.2，引文与短诗留呼吸
note.en: 1.9–2.2 — quotes and verse breathe

适用文本.zh: 段落正文为主，标题单独收紧
适用文本.en: Body paragraphs mainly; display tightens separately

调节粒度.zh: 连续微调，0.05 即可感知

notes.zh: 行高写无单位倍数（line-height: 1.6），继承时按自身字号换算；写 px 会把子元素行高锁死在父级字号上。经验值：标题 1.15～1.3、正文 1.6～1.75、辅助文字 1.4。中文正文比英文略松（1.7 上下）更耐读。用 ex / 半 leading 技巧做首行基线对齐时要单独验证。
notes.en: Set unitless multiples (line-height: 1.6) so children recompute against their own size; pixels freeze leading on the parent size. Starting points: display 1.15–1.3, body 1.6–1.75, captions 1.4. CJK body reads a touch looser than Latin — around 1.7. Verify separately if you use half-leading tricks for first-baseline alignment.

basic.zh: 统一项目的行高体系：标题、正文、辅助文字分别给出合适的 line-height。
basic.en: Define the project's leading system — line-height for display, body and captions.

design.zh: 行高规范：大标题 1.15，小标题 1.3，正文 1.65，辅助文字 1.4；全部使用无单位倍数；中文长文正文放宽到 1.7；段间距不小于 0.75em；行高与字号阶梯成对交付，不允许单独调整其一。
design.en: Leading spec: display 1.15, subhead 1.3, body 1.65, caption 1.4 — all unitless. CJK long-form body loosens to 1.7. Paragraph spacing at least 0.75em. Deliver leading together with the type scale; never tune one without the other.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 变量配对字号阶梯定义行高：--leading-tight: 1.2; --leading-body: 1.65; --leading-loose: 1.9。正文 class 组合 font-size: var(--text-base); line-height: var(--leading-body)。Tailwind 侧映射到 leading-* 令牌。禁止在组件里写 line-height: 24px。
implementation.en: Pair leading variables with the type scale: --leading-tight: 1.2; --leading-body: 1.65; --leading-loose: 1.9. Body classes combine font-size: var(--text-base) with line-height: var(--leading-body). Map to Tailwind leading-* tokens. Never write line-height: 24px inside a component.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现行高。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 标题 / 正文 / 辅助三级无单位行高令牌
- 与字号阶梯成对引用，禁止写死 px 行高
- 中文正文适当放宽
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement line height in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Three unitless leading tokens for display / body / caption
- Referenced together with the type scale; no pixel-locked leading
- CJK body copy set slightly looser
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 一段文字每行容纳的字符数，决定眼睛回行是否省力。舒适区大约 45～75 个拉丁字符（中文 28～40 字），最常用 65ch 左右。行太窄回行太频繁，太宽则跟丢行；用 max-width 以 ch 为单位控制，比按像素猜更可靠。
description.en: How many characters fit on one line — it decides whether the eye can return to the next line without effort. The comfort zone is roughly 45–75 Latin characters (28–40 CJK glyphs), with 65ch the usual target. Too narrow and the eye turns constantly; too wide and it loses the line. Control it with max-width in ch rather than guessing in pixels.

use_when.zh: 长文阅读、文章正文、帮助文档等逐行阅读场景
use_when.en: Long-form reading — articles, docs, help centre copy

use_when.zh: 容器宽度随屏幕变化，需要给正文一个稳定上限
use_when.en: Containers grow with the viewport and body copy needs a hard cap

use_when.zh: 多栏排版，每栏正文需要独立约束行长
use_when.en: Multi-column layouts where each column caps its own measure

avoid_when.zh: 表格、数据密集列表——行宽由列结构决定
avoid_when.en: Tables and data grids — column structure dictates width

avoid_when.zh: 单行输入框、按钮标签等非段落文字
avoid_when.en: Single-line fields and button labels — not paragraph text

avoid_when.zh: 在 65ch 上继续做复杂断行调优，收益极低
avoid_when.en: Fancy line-breaking tuning on top of a 65ch cap — diminishing returns

note.zh: 以零字宽为单位的行长上限
note.en: Line cap measured in zero-glyph width

note.zh: 约 65ch 的预设
note.en: The ~65ch preset

note.zh: 长文默认档，回行省力
note.en: The long-form default — easy on the return sweep

note.zh: 侧栏说明、引文块，45ch 上下
note.en: Sidebars and pull quotes — around 45ch

note.zh: 设置页、表单说明，可放到 80ch
note.en: Settings and form help — may stretch to 80ch

调节粒度.zh: 按容器宽度拖动，以 ch 为单位
调节粒度.en: Drag container width, measured in ch

响应式.en: High — max-width inside a fluid container

notes.zh: 正文容器写 max-width: 65ch（或 36rem 上下），放进流体外层让左右留白随屏变化。ch 单位跟随当前字体的零字宽，换字体后行长自动重算，比写死 px 稳。中文行长用字数估：28～40 字约等于 56ch～80ch 的视觉长度。多栏每栏单独限宽，不要让整页宽度决定行长。
notes.en: Cap body containers at max-width: 65ch (or about 36rem) inside a fluid shell so side margins breathe with the viewport. The ch unit tracks the current font's zero width and recalculates on font swap — steadier than pixels. For CJK, 28–40 glyphs is the target. Cap each column individually; never let whole-page width decide the measure.

basic.zh: 为长文正文设置合适的行宽：限制每行字数，保证阅读舒适。
basic.en: Set an optimal measure for long-form body copy — cap characters per line for comfortable reading.

design.zh: 行宽规范：长文正文 65ch（约 28～40 个汉字）；侧栏与引文 45ch；表单说明可放宽至 80ch。行长与行高 1.6～1.75 成对使用；窄屏下让容器自然收窄，不要再加额外缩进；英文段落开启 hyphens: auto 前先确认断词表。
design.en: Measure spec: long-form body at 65ch (≈28–40 CJK glyphs); sidebars and pull quotes at 45ch; form help up to 80ch. Pair measure with 1.6–1.75 leading. On narrow screens let the container shrink naturally — no extra indents. Enable hyphens: auto on Latin paragraphs only after checking the dictionary.

implementation.zh: 用 max-width: 65ch 限制 .prose 类正文容器，外层保持 width: 100% 做流体布局；多栏用 minmax(45ch, 1fr) 定义栅格列。Tailwind 可用 max-w-prose。调试时在控制台用元素宽度除以平均字宽估算 CPL，或临时用 Intl.Segmenter 统计。
implementation.en: Cap .prose body containers with max-width: 65ch while the outer shell stays width: 100%. Define grid columns as minmax(45ch, 1fr) in multi-column layouts. Tailwind offers max-w-prose. When tuning, estimate CPL from element width over average glyph width, or count with Intl.Segmenter.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现行宽。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 长文正文容器 max-width 65ch 左右，外层保持流体
- 多栏每栏独立限宽
- 与行高、字号阶梯配套，不写死像素行长
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement measure in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Long-form body containers capped near 65ch inside a fluid shell
- Each multi-column column capped independently
- Paired with leading and the type scale; no pixel-locked measure
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 动效时长是动画从开始到结束的时间，按交互类型分档：微反馈 100–150ms、标准过渡 200–300ms、强调入场 300–500ms。缓动决定加速减速的节奏，入场用 ease-out、退场用 ease-in。始终尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，把位移降级为淡入。
description.en: Motion duration is how long an animation runs: micro 100–150ms, standard 200–300ms, entrances 300–500ms. Ease out on entry; honour prefers-reduced-motion.

use_when.zh: 按钮、开关、卡片等元素的悬停、按下、状态切换
use_when.en: Hover, press and state changes on buttons, switches and cards

use_when.zh: 弹层、抽屉、面板的入场与退场
use_when.en: Entrances and exits for popovers, drawers and panels

use_when.zh: 需要统一全站动效节奏、避免每个组件各写一个时长
use_when.en: One motion rhythm for the whole product instead of per-component timing

avoid_when.zh: 用户开启 prefers-reduced-motion（应降级为短淡入或无动画）
avoid_when.en: When the user enables prefers-reduced-motion — fall back to a short fade or none

avoid_when.zh: 关键操作等待反馈，动画拖慢到让人觉得卡顿
avoid_when.en: Critical feedback slowed to the point of feeling laggy

avoid_when.zh: 超过 500ms 的装饰性动画反复播放、抢占注意力
avoid_when.en: Decorative animations over 500ms looping and stealing attention

note.zh: 分档时长与标准缓动令牌
note.en: Staged durations and standard easing tokens

note.zh: 用动效表达层级与空间关系
note.en: Use motion to convey hierarchy and spatial relationships

note.zh: 直接控制过渡时长的属性
note.en: The property that controls transition length

note.zh: 100–150ms，点按、悬停要立刻可感知
note.en: 100–150ms — presses and hovers must feel instant

note.zh: 200–300ms，展开、切换、淡入淡出
note.en: 200–300ms — expand, switch, cross-fade

note.zh: 300–500ms，页面与全屏浮层入场
note.en: 300–500ms — page and full-screen overlay entrances

notes.zh: 时长按交互类型分档并用变量统一（--motion-fast: 120ms; --motion-base: 240ms; --motion-slow: 400ms）。入场用 ease-out 或 cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)，退场用 ease-in，并让退场比入场略快。只动 transform 与 opacity，避免触发 layout。媒体查询 prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 下把位移改成 opacity 淡入并压到 150ms 内，或直接 transition: none。
notes.en: Stage durations as variables (--motion-fast: 120ms; --motion-base: 240ms; --motion-slow: 400ms) keyed to interaction type. Use ease-out or cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) for entrances, ease-in for exits, and make exits slightly faster than entrances. Animate transform and opacity only to avoid layout. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, swap travel for an opacity fade capped at 150ms, or set transition: none.

basic.zh: 为项目定义统一的动效时长与缓动档位，让所有交互节奏一致。
basic.en: Define one set of motion durations and easings so every interaction shares a rhythm.

design.zh: 动效规范：微反馈 100–150ms，标准过渡 200–300ms，强调入场 300–500ms，退场比入场快约 20%；缓动入场 ease-out、退场 ease-in、标准用 cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)；同一元素只动 transform 与 opacity；用户开启 prefers-reduced-motion 时去掉位移，只保留 ≤150ms 的淡入。
design.en: Motion spec: micro feedback 100–150ms, standard transitions 200–300ms, emphasised entrances 300–500ms, exits about 20% faster than entrances; ease-out for entrances, ease-in for exits, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) as the standard; animate transform and opacity only; under prefers-reduced-motion drop travel and keep only a fade of 150ms or less.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 变量分档：--motion-fast: 120ms; --motion-base: 240ms; --motion-slow: 400ms，缓动 --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)。元素写 transition: transform var(--motion-base) var(--ease-standard), opacity var(--motion-base) var(--ease-standard)。用 @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) 覆盖为短淡入或 transition: none。不要给所有属性加 transition: all。
implementation.en: Stage durations as CSS variables: --motion-fast: 120ms; --motion-base: 240ms; --motion-slow: 400ms, with --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Elements use transition: transform var(--motion-base) var(--ease-standard), opacity var(--motion-base) var(--ease-standard). Override with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to a short fade or transition: none. Never use transition: all.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中统一动效时长与缓动。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 定义快 / 标准 / 慢三档时长令牌与标准缓动曲线
- 只动 transform 与 opacity，退场比入场略快
- 在 prefers-reduced-motion 下把位移降级为短淡入或取消动画
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
沿用项目现有时长体系，避免逐组件各写一套。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Unify motion duration and easing in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Define fast / standard / slow duration tokens and a standard easing curve
- Animate transform and opacity only; exits slightly faster than entrances
- Under prefers-reduced-motion, demote travel to a short fade or drop animation
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Reuse the existing timing system instead of per-component values.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

aliases: 为什么图在手机上发虚

description.zh: 屏幕同时用两套像素计数：真实的设备像素与布局用的 CSS 像素，一个 CSS 像素里塞进几个设备像素就是设备像素比 DPR。手机像素密、CSS 像素少，位图被撑到 CSS 尺寸就发虚。位图按 2x/3x 提供并配 srcset 与矢量即可锐利；文字清晰度取决于字形渲染，与单位无关，rem 只用于相对根字号缩放。
description.en: A screen counts pixels two ways: physical device pixels and the CSS pixels used for layout. The device pixel ratio, or DPR, is how many device pixels fill one CSS pixel. Phones pack many device pixels into few CSS pixels, so a bitmap shown at its CSS size looks blurry. Serve 2x/3x assets with srcset and vectors to stay sharp; text sharpness comes from glyph rendering, not units — rem only scales relative to the root font size.

use_when.zh: 位图、图标与截图需要在手机等高密度屏上保持锐利
use_when.en: Bitmaps, icons and screenshots must stay sharp on dense phone screens

use_when.zh: 设计稿以 px 标注，开发需要换算到不同 DPR
use_when.en: The design spec is annotated in px and must map onto different DPRs

use_when.zh: 排查“为什么图在 Retina 上发虚”或配置响应式图片
use_when.en: Debugging why an image looks soft on Retina, or setting up responsive images

avoid_when.zh: 纯文字页面没有位图与图标，密度差异基本无感
avoid_when.en: A text-only page with no bitmaps or icons, where density barely shows

avoid_when.zh: 只面向固定 1x 的投屏或信息屏，不涉及高密度设备
avoid_when.en: A fixed 1x signage or projector target with no dense displays

avoid_when.zh: 把所有尺寸都乘 DPR 写死，丢掉 CSS 像素这层抽象
avoid_when.en: Multiplying every size by DPR and hard-coding it, losing the CSS-pixel abstraction

note.zh: 按屏幕密度切换资源或样式
note.en: Switch assets or styles by screen density

note.zh: 让浏览器按 DPR 选图
note.en: Lets the browser pick the right crop per DPR

note.zh: 一个 CSS 像素等于一个设备像素，资源原样显示
note.en: One CSS pixel equals one device pixel — assets show as-is

note.zh: 一个 CSS 像素摊到四个设备像素，位图要出 2x 才不虚
note.en: One CSS pixel covers four device pixels — ship 2x bitmaps

note.zh: 手机常见 2x～3x，位图按此出图；图标与 Logo 用矢量，文字交给系统字体渲染
note.en: Phones commonly reach 2x–3x; export bitmaps accordingly, use vectors for icons/logos and let the system render text

notes.zh: 位图按目标 DPR 出 2x/3x 资源，用 image-set() 或 srcset/sizes 让浏览器自己挑，不要只把 1x 放大。CSS 尺寸一律按 CSS 像素写，映射到设备像素交给浏览器；图标与 Logo 优先 SVG，字号与间距可用 rem 做相对缩放（这是缩放策略，与清晰度无关），发丝线保持 1px。devicePixelRatio 只用于需要精确像素计算的 canvas 或图片预览，不要拿它缩放整个界面。
notes.en: Export bitmaps at 2x/3x for the target DPR and let image-set() or srcset/sizes choose; never upscale a 1x asset. Always write CSS sizes in CSS pixels and leave the mapping to device pixels to the browser. Prefer SVG for icons and logos; rem may scale font size and spacing relative to the root (a scaling choice, not a sharpness fix), and hairlines stay at 1px. Use devicePixelRatio only for canvas or image previews that need exact pixel math, never to scale the whole UI.

basic.zh: 让位图与图标在手机等高密度屏上保持清晰：按 DPR 提供多倍图，并说清 CSS 像素与设备像素的区别。
basic.en: Keep bitmaps and icons crisp on dense phone screens — serve multiple densities and explain CSS pixels versus device pixels.

design.zh: 像素密度规范：布局与标注统一用 CSS 像素，交付 1x/2x/3x 位图；图标与 Logo 用 SVG；字号与间距可用 rem 相对缩放，发丝线固定 1px；切图命名带 @2x/@3x；说明目标设备的 DPR 区间，不要用设备像素直接标注设计稿。
design.en: Pixel density spec: lay out and annotate in CSS pixels, deliver 1x/2x/3x bitmaps, use SVG for icons and logos, scale text and spacing with rem, and keep hairlines at 1px. Name exports with @2x/@3x, state the target DPR range, and never annotate the design in device pixels.

implementation.zh: 用 image-set() 或 srcset/sizes 提供多倍图，例如 img { width: 24px; height: 24px; content: image-set(url(icon.png) 1x, url(icon@2x.png) 2x); }。高密度下再用 @media (min-resolution: 2dppx) 覆盖细节。字号与间距可用 rem 相对缩放，canvas 里乘 window.devicePixelRatio 设置 backing store，并按 CSS 尺寸缩放上下文。
implementation.en: Serve multiple densities with image-set() or srcset/sizes, e.g. img { width: 24px; height: 24px; content: image-set(url(icon.png) 1x, url(icon@2x.png) 2x); } and refine details under @media (min-resolution: 2dppx). Scale text and spacing with rem; in canvas multiply window.devicePixelRatio for the backing store and scale the context back to CSS size.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现像素密度适配。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 布局与尺寸全部按 CSS 像素书写，不乘 DPR
- 位图提供 1x/2x/3x 并用 image-set() 或 srcset/sizes 选择
- 图标与 Logo 用 SVG；字号与间距可用 rem（相对缩放，与清晰度无关），发丝线保持 1px
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement pixel density handling in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Write all layout and sizes in CSS pixels; never multiply by DPR
- Provide 1x/2x/3x bitmaps and choose with image-set() or srcset/sizes
- Use SVG for icons and logos; rem may scale text and spacing (a scaling choice, not sharpness); keep hairlines at 1px
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

aliases: rem 和 em 的区别
为什么改浏览器字号界面不变大

description.zh: 长度可以写死成 px，也可以相对别的量：rem 相对根元素字号，em 相对元素自身或父级的字号，% 相对容器，vw/vh 相对视口。用户把浏览器默认字号调大时，用 px 排的版面纹丝不动，用 rem 的会整体放大。字号、间距、圆角尽量用 rem，只有边框与发丝线才写死 px。
description.en: A length can be absolute (px) or relative: rem scales from the root font size, em from the element's own font size, % from the container, and vw/vh from the viewport. When a user raises the browser's default font size, px layouts refuse to move while rem-based ones grow with it. Prefer rem for type, spacing and radius; keep px for borders and hairlines.

use_when.zh: 用户能改浏览器默认字号，界面需要跟着一起放大
use_when.en: Users can change the browser default font size and the UI must scale with it

use_when.zh: 同一组件要在不同容器与字号下复用，尺寸需自适应
use_when.en: One component is reused across containers and font sizes and must adapt

use_when.zh: 做随视口变化的流式排版、间距或整屏区块
use_when.en: Fluid type, spacing or full-screen sections that follow the viewport

avoid_when.zh: 1px 发丝线与需要绝对精确的边框
avoid_when.en: 1px hairlines and borders that must be exactly one pixel

avoid_when.zh: 位图按原始像素对齐，不允许任何取整偏差
avoid_when.en: Bitmaps aligned to exact source pixels, where any rounding hurts

avoid_when.zh: em 在多层嵌套里层层放大，尺寸彻底失控
avoid_when.en: Nested em compounding until the size runs away entirely

note.zh: 相对根字号与相对父级字号
note.en: Relative to the root and to the parent size

note.zh: 相对视口宽高，dvh 处理移动端地址栏
note.en: Relative to viewport — dvh handles mobile browser chrome

note.zh: 1rem 等于根字号，改根字号整页同步缩放
note.en: 1rem equals the root size — change it and the page scales together

note.zh: 1em 取决于当前字号，嵌套会层层相乘
note.en: 1em follows the current font size and compounds when nested

note.zh: 随窗口尺寸变化，适合整屏区块与流式间距
note.en: Follows the window — good for full-bleed sections and fluid spacing

sources.name: W3C — CSS Values and Units Module Level 4

notes.zh: :root 不写死 font-size，让浏览器默认字号保持可调；正文用 1rem，组件内字号与间距用 rem，最大宽度用 ch/rem。vw/vh 用于整屏区块，vh 在移动端改用 dvh 以避开地址栏跳动。发丝线与边框保留 1px。em 只用在确实需要随局部字号缩放的场合，并留意嵌套相乘。
notes.en: Never hard-set font-size on :root — keep the browser default adjustable. Set body copy in 1rem, and use rem for type and spacing inside components, with ch/rem for max widths. Reserve vw/vh for full-screen sections, and prefer dvh on mobile to dodge the address bar. Keep hairlines and borders at 1px. Use em only where a size must follow the local font size, and watch for nesting compounding.

basic.zh: 用相对单位改造布局：字号、间距、圆角用 rem，整屏区块用 vw/vh，只保留边框为 px。
basic.en: Convert a layout to relative units — rem for type, spacing and radius, vw/vh for full-screen sections, px only for borders.

design.zh: 相对单位规范：根字号保持浏览器默认（不写死 html font-size）；正文与组件字号用 rem；间距与圆角用 rem；整屏高度用 dvh；发丝线用 1px；禁止用 vw 直接设正文字号以免小屏过小；em 仅在随局部字号缩放时使用，嵌套不超过两层。
design.en: Relative unit spec: leave the root font size at the browser default (do not hard-set html); use rem for body and component type, spacing and radius; use dvh for full-height; keep hairlines at 1px. Never size body text in vw or it collapses on small screens. Use em only for local scaling and no more than two nesting levels.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 自定义属性把基准集中：:root { --space-4: 1rem; --radius-md: 0.5rem; }，组件引用变量而不写 px。流式尺寸写 clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem)。移动端整屏用 min-height: 100dvh。验证方法是把浏览器默认字号从 16px 改到 20px，检查版面和控件是否等比例放大。
implementation.en: Centralise the basis in custom properties — :root { --space-4: 1rem; --radius-md: 0.5rem; } — and have components reference variables instead of px. Write fluid sizes as clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem) and full-height sections as min-height: 100dvh. To verify, change the browser default from 16px to 20px and check that layout and controls scale proportionally.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现相对单位体系。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 不写死 html 根字号，正文用 1rem
- 字号、间距、圆角用 rem，视口区块用 dvh
- 边框与发丝线保持 px，em 仅局部使用
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a relative-unit system in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Never hard-set the html root size; keep body text at 1rem
- Use rem for type, spacing and radius, and dvh for viewport sections
- Keep borders and hairlines in px; use em only locally
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 按用途而非色相命名的颜色变量：bg、surface、text、muted、accent、danger。组件只认角色，主题切换时在映射层换指向即可，不必改组件。浅色、深色、高对比、品牌皮肤都是同一套角色的不同取值表。
description.en: Colour variables named by purpose, not hue: bg, surface, text, muted, accent, danger. Components consume roles only, so a theme switch re-points the mapping layer instead of touching components. Light, dark, high-contrast and brand skins are simply different value tables over the same roles.

use_when.zh: 需要浅色 / 深色双主题或可换肤
use_when.en: Light and dark themes, or skinnable branding, are required

use_when.zh: 组件库要跨产品复用，颜色含义必须稳定
use_when.en: A component library ships across products and colour meaning must stay stable

use_when.zh: 无障碍要求高对比主题或强制配色
use_when.en: Accessibility demands a high-contrast or forced-colours theme

avoid_when.zh: 单页营销稿，颜色即最终视觉，无需抽象
avoid_when.en: A one-page campaign where the colour is the final visual

avoid_when.zh: 角色名起得比色值还多（--color-card-header-icon-hover）
avoid_when.en: More role names than actual colours — --color-card-header-icon-hover

avoid_when.zh: 把插画专用色也塞进语义层
avoid_when.en: Illustration-only colours forced into the semantic layer

note.zh: 让 UA 控件跟随浅深主题
note.en: Lets UA controls follow the theme

note.zh: 同一角色两套取值，.dark 下整体切换
note.en: Two value tables per role, swapped under .dark

note.zh: 收紧明度差，边界与文字加强
note.en: Tightened lightness gaps, heavier borders and text

note.zh: 只换 accent 与少数角色，其余不动
note.en: Swap accent and a few roles; leave the rest alone

notes.zh: 分两层：色阶层（--color-primary-500）与角色层（--color-accent: var(--color-primary-600)）。组件只允许引用角色层。深色主题覆盖角色层取值并加 color-scheme: dark，让滚动条与表单控件同步变暗。高对比主题独立一张表，不要在深色表上继续堆 if。强制配色场景再补 forced-colors 适配。
notes.en: Two layers: the ramp (--color-primary-500) and the role layer (--color-accent: var(--color-primary-600)). Components may only reference roles. The dark theme overrides role values and sets color-scheme: dark so scrollbars and form controls follow. High contrast gets its own table — do not pile conditionals onto the dark one. Add forced-colors handling where the OS palette applies.

basic.zh: 建立语义色 Token：用 bg / surface / text / muted / accent / danger 等角色名定义颜色变量，并支持深浅主题。
basic.en: Define semantic colour tokens — bg, surface, text, muted, accent, danger roles with light and dark themes.

design.zh: 语义色规范：角色层固定为 bg、surface、raised、text、muted、line、accent、danger；浅深主题各一张取值表，组件不感知主题；accent 全局唯一，danger 只用于破坏性操作；所有文字角色对当前底色过 WCAG AA；禁止在组件里出现 #hex。
design.en: Semantic colour spec: role layer fixed to bg, surface, raised, text, muted, line, accent, danger. One value table per theme; components stay theme-agnostic. A single global accent; danger reserved for destructive actions. Every text role passes WCAG AA against its background. No #hex inside components.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 自定义属性实现：:root { --color-bg: #fafaf7; --color-surface: #fff; --color-text: #17150f; --color-accent: var(--color-primary-600); }，.dark { --color-bg: #121210; … } 并设 color-scheme: dark。Tailwind 通过 @theme inline 映射 bg-bg、text-text 等工具类。主题切换只换 class。
implementation.en: Implement with CSS custom properties: :root { --color-bg: #fafaf7; --color-surface: #fff; --color-text: #17150f; --color-accent: var(--color-primary-600); } and .dark { --color-bg: #121210; … } with color-scheme: dark. Map into Tailwind via @theme inline for bg-bg / text-text utilities. Theming is a class swap.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现语义色。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- bg / surface / text / muted / accent / danger 角色层
- 浅深双主题取值表，组件不写死色值
- 配 color-scheme，组合对比度过 AA
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement semantic colour in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- A role layer of bg / surface / text / muted / accent / danger
- Light and dark value tables; components never hard-code colours
- color-scheme set and pairings pass AA contrast
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 用一组固定的间距档位（如 4、8、12、16、24、32、48px，通常按 4 或 8 的倍数生长）统一控制 padding、margin 与 gap。所有留白都从同一把尺子里取，而不是随手写数值，疏密节奏才稳定；间距同时承担分组，间距越大，元素之间的关系越疏远。
description.en: A fixed ladder of spacing steps (4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48px, usually multiples of 4 or 8) that all padding, margin and gap values come from. Drawing every gap off one ruler instead of inventing numbers keeps density consistent, and spacing also signals grouping: the larger the gap, the looser the relationship between elements.

use_when.zh: 多组件、多页面需要统一的疏密节奏，避免每处随手写数
use_when.en: Many components and pages need one density rhythm instead of ad-hoc numbers

use_when.zh: 设计系统要交付 padding / margin / gap 的间距令牌
use_when.en: The design system must ship spacing tokens for padding, margin and gap

use_when.zh: 想用间距表达分组与层级，而不是到处加分割线
use_when.en: Grouping and hierarchy should come from spacing, not divider lines everywhere

avoid_when.zh: 一次性插画或版式实验，间距本就该自由
avoid_when.en: A one-off illustration or layout experiment where spacing should stay free

avoid_when.zh: 需要光学对齐时，仍要靠目测微调而非死守档位
avoid_when.en: Optical alignment still needs hand tuning rather than a fixed step

avoid_when.zh: 档位过密（每 2px 一档），选型反而变慢
avoid_when.en: Too many steps (one every 2px) makes picking slower, not easier

note.zh: 间距落地的三个属性
note.en: The three properties spacing lands on

note.zh: 4px 基准的成倍工具类
note.en: A 4px-based set of multiplier utilities

note.zh: 4 的倍数逐档递增，最通用也最密
note.en: Every step a multiple of 4 — the most common and granular

note.zh: 以 8 为基准、必要时补 4 与 12，节奏更疏
note.en: Based on 8 with 4 and 12 as fillers — a looser rhythm

note.zh: inline / stack / section 按关系命名，跨组件稳定
note.en: Named inline / stack / section by relationship — stable across components

notes.zh: 用 rem 定义 6～8 档：--space-1 到 --space-8（4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64px）。组件只引用令牌，不写裸数值；同组元素用同一档，分组越大用越大的档。全局密度用一个乘数（--density）整体缩放，暗色或移动端可单独收紧。相邻档差距过小就合并，档位控制在 8 个以内。
notes.en: Define six to eight rem steps — --space-1 through --space-8 (4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64px). Components reference tokens only, never raw numbers; siblings share one step, and larger groups take larger steps. Scale the whole density with one multiplier (--density) and tighten it per breakpoint or dark theme. Merge steps that are too close; keep the ladder under eight entries.

basic.zh: 建立间距系统：用 4 或 8 的倍数定义 6～8 档间距令牌，并用它统一组件的 padding、margin 与 gap。
basic.en: Build a spacing scale — six to eight 4/8-based tokens that unify padding, margin and gap across components.

design.zh: 间距规范：基准 4px（或 8px），档位 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64；同组元素用同一档，分组越大档位越大；组件内只用令牌不写裸数；提供 --density 乘数用于紧凑与宽松；相邻档至少相差 4px，总档位不超过 8。
design.en: Spacing spec: a 4px (or 8px) base with steps 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64; siblings share a step and larger groups take larger steps; components reference tokens only, never raw numbers. Expose a --density multiplier for compact and loose modes. Keep adjacent steps at least 4px apart and the ladder to eight entries or fewer.

implementation.zh: 落地为 CSS 变量：:root { --space-1: 0.25rem; --space-2: 0.5rem; --space-3: 0.75rem; --space-4: 1rem; --space-6: 1.5rem; --space-8: 2rem; }，组件用 gap: var(--space-4) 与 padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4)。Tailwind 映射到 theme 的 spacing。整体密度靠 --density 乘数一次性调整。
implementation.en: Ship as custom properties — :root { --space-1: 0.25rem; --space-2: 0.5rem; --space-3: 0.75rem; --space-4: 1rem; --space-6: 1.5rem; --space-8: 2rem; } — and use gap: var(--space-4) with padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4). Map into Tailwind theme spacing. Adjust overall density through a single --density multiplier.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现间距系统。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 用 rem 定义 6～8 档间距令牌，按 4 或 8 的倍数
- 组件只引用令牌，不写裸 margin/padding 数值
- 用间距表达分组，并提供密度乘数
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a spacing scale in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Six to eight rem spacing tokens based on multiples of 4 or 8
- Components reference tokens only; no raw margin/padding numbers
- Express grouping through spacing and expose a density multiplier
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 触控目标是手指能点中的可交互范围，不等于图标看起来多大。苹果 HIG 建议至少 44×44 CSS 像素，Material 建议 48dp；相邻目标之间还要留约 8px 间距，避免误触。视觉小图标可以用透明内边距或伪元素把热区撑大，而不用改变外观。
description.en: A touch target is the tappable area a finger must hit, not the icon size. Aim for 44×44 CSS px (48dp), about 8px between targets, and pad small icons to size.

use_when.zh: 任何需要手指或鼠标点击、拖动的可交互控件
use_when.en: Any control a finger or pointer taps, drags or presses

use_when.zh: 图标按钮、关闭按钮、列表行等视觉尺寸偏小的元素
use_when.en: Icon buttons, close buttons and list rows that look small

use_when.zh: 边缘或角落里的操作，容易和相邻目标一起点到
use_when.en: Edge and corner actions that sit close to their neighbours

avoid_when.zh: 纯展示、不可点击的图标与装饰元素
avoid_when.en: Decorative icons that are never interactive

avoid_when.zh: 桌面端密集数据表格内的单元格选择
avoid_when.en: Dense desktop data grids where cells are selected intentionally

avoid_when.zh: 把热区无节制扩大导致相邻目标重叠
avoid_when.en: Blowing up hit areas until neighbouring targets overlap

note.zh: 苹果建议的最小可点尺寸
note.en: Apple's recommended minimum tappable size

note.zh: Material 建议的最小触控目标
note.en: Material's minimum touch target

note.zh: WCAG 的合规底线，产品应做得更大
note.en: The accessibility floor — ship larger in practice

note.zh: 热区 44×44 起，主操作最稳妥
note.en: Hit area from 44×44 — safest for primary actions

note.zh: 视觉 24px，靠透明 padding 撑到 44px
note.en: 24px glyph grown to 44px with transparent padding

note.zh: 用行高与内边距扩热区，不改视觉
note.en: Extend the hit area with line-height and padding

notes.zh: 给可交互元素设 min-width / min-height: 44px（或 48px），并在容器上用 gap 保证目标间距，而不是靠 margin 互相挤。图标视觉保持 24px，用 padding: 10px 把热区补到 44px；不方便加 padding 时用 ::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -10px; } 扩展热区。onmouseover 出现的内容不算触控目标。触摸端加 touch-action: manipulation 去掉 300ms 双击缩放延迟。
notes.en: Give interactive elements min-width / min-height: 44px (or 48px) and use gap on the container for spacing instead of margins. Keep the glyph at 24px and pad it to 44px; when padding is awkward, expand with ::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -10px; }. Content only revealed on hover is not a valid target. On touch devices add touch-action: manipulation to drop the 300ms double-tap delay.

basic.zh: 统一可交互控件的触控目标尺寸，让手指在手机上都能轻松点中。
basic.en: Unify touch target sizes across controls so every action is easy to tap on a phone.

design.zh: 触控目标规范：可点区域至少 44×44 CSS 像素（Material 48dp）；相邻目标之间留 8px 以上间距；视觉小于 44px 的图标用透明内边距或伪元素补足热区；默认图标 24px 配 10px 内边距达到 44px；列表行高不低于 44px；任何操作都不应只能 hover 触发。
design.en: Touch target spec: tappable area at least 44×44 CSS px (Material 48dp); 8px or more between neighbours; pad small glyphs up to the minimum with transparent padding or a pseudo-element; the default 24px icon plus 10px padding reaches 44px; list rows no shorter than 44px; no action should be hover-only.

implementation.zh: 用 min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px 给按钮、图标按钮和列表行兜底，容器用 display: flex; gap: 8px 控制间距。图标热区不足时用 padding 或 ::before 的负 inset 扩展，不要放大图标本身。用 :active / :focus-visible 给出命中反馈。检查所有触控目标在 320px 宽屏下不重叠。
implementation.en: Back buttons, icon buttons and list rows with min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px, and space them with display: flex; gap: 8px. When an icon's hit area is short, extend it with padding or a negative-inset ::before rather than enlarging the glyph. Provide :active / :focus-visible feedback. Verify no targets overlap at 320px wide.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中落实触控目标尺寸。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 所有可交互元素热区至少 44×44 CSS 像素，间距不少于 8px
- 小图标用内边距或伪元素扩展热区，不改变视觉尺寸
- 提供可见的按下与聚焦反馈，不依赖 hover
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Enforce touch target sizes in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Every interactive element has a hit area of at least 44×44 CSS px with 8px spacing
- Small icons extend their hit area via padding or pseudo-elements without changing visual size
- Provide visible press and focus feedback; never rely on hover
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 用一组按比例递增的字号定义标题与正文层级，让排版有稳定节奏。以正文基准字号乘以固定比例（如 1.25 大三度、1.333 纯四度）逐级放大，标题之间形成可预期的视觉落差，不必逐档拍脑袋定 px；也可用 sm/md/lg 尺码或 clamp() 流式档位落地。
description.en: A ratio-based set of font sizes that assigns heading and body levels a stable rhythm. Multiply a base body size by a fixed ratio (1.25 major third, 1.333 perfect fourth) to step upward, producing predictable contrast between headings instead of hand-picked pixels. Ship it as sm/md/lg tokens or fluid clamp() steps.

use_when.zh: 页面存在标题、正文、辅助文字等多级文本层级
use_when.en: The page carries multiple text levels — headings, body, captions

use_when.zh: 多人协作需要统一字号，避免各自随手写 13px、15px
use_when.en: Teams need one shared size system instead of ad-hoc 13px and 15px

use_when.zh: 响应式排版希望字号随视口连续或按断点有节制地变化
use_when.en: Responsive type should scale fluidly or step at breakpoints with restraint

avoid_when.zh: 单一字号就够的极简控件条、图标工具栏
avoid_when.en: Icon toolbars and micro UI where one size is enough

avoid_when.zh: 像素级还原设计稿且不允许任何取整合并
avoid_when.en: Pixel-exact design reproduction that forbids any rounding

avoid_when.zh: 比例档位过多（超过 8 档），层级反而失去可辨识度
avoid_when.en: More than eight steps — the hierarchy stops being legible

note.zh: 流体字号的首选写法
note.en: The go-to for fluid type steps

note.zh: 基准字号乘固定比例逐级放大，档位离散、节奏稳定
note.en: Base size times a fixed ratio per step — discrete and rhythmic

note.zh: clamp(最小, 视口插值, 最大)，小屏大屏连续过渡
note.en: clamp(min, viewport interpolation, max) — continuous across viewports

note.zh: sm / md / lg / xl 语义命名，工程侧好引用
note.en: Semantic sm / md / lg / xl tokens — easy to reference in code

适用文本.zh: 标题与正文的全部层级

调节粒度.zh: 按比例档位跳变，一档一档调
调节粒度.en: Steps by ratio — one level at a time

notes.zh: 用 rem 定义 6～8 档字号变量（--text-xs 到 --text-3xl），比例写进注释；标题跳档而非连续堆砌，相邻档位差异不小于 1.15 倍才可感知。流式档位写成 clamp(0.95rem, 0.8rem + 0.6vw, 1.25rem)，两端封顶防止 4K 失控。中文正文基准 15～17px，英文 16px 起。字号变更必须同步检查行高与行长。
notes.en: Define six to eight rem size variables (--text-xs … --text-3xl) with the ratio noted in a comment. Jump levels rather than stacking near-equal sizes — adjacent steps need at least a 1.15× gap to read. Fluid steps look like clamp(0.95rem, 0.8rem + 0.6vw, 1.25rem) with both ends capped. CJK body starts at 15–17px, Latin at 16px. Any size change must re-check leading and measure.

basic.zh: 建立一套字号阶梯：按比例定义标题与正文的字号层级，并输出为可复用的 Design Token。
basic.en: Build a type scale — ratio-based heading and body sizes exposed as reusable design tokens.

design.zh: 字号阶梯设计规范：正文基准 16px，比例 1.25（大三度）或 1.333（纯四度）；共 6～8 档，命名 xs/sm/base/lg/xl/2xl/3xl；标题与正文共用同一阶梯，禁止页外写死 px；移动端用 clamp() 流式插值，两端封顶；每档同步给出对应行高建议。
design.en: Type scale spec: 16px body base, 1.25 (major third) or 1.333 (perfect fourth) ratio; six to eight steps named xs/sm/base/lg/xl/2xl/3xl; headings and body share one ladder — no hard-coded pixels outside it; fluid clamp() interpolation capped at both ends on mobile; pair every step with a leading suggestion.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 自定义属性落地字号阶梯：:root { --text-base: 1rem; --text-lg: 1.25rem; --text-xl: 1.5625rem; }，标题用 var(--text-2xl) 引用；流式档位 --text-h1: clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 2.5vw, 3.5rem)。Tailwind 侧映射到 @theme 的 --text-* 令牌。变更阶梯只改根变量，不改组件。
implementation.en: Ship the scale as CSS custom properties: :root { --text-base: 1rem; --text-lg: 1.25rem; --text-xl: 1.5625rem; } and reference var(--text-2xl) from headings; fluid steps like --text-h1: clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 2.5vw, 3.5rem). Map them into Tailwind @theme --text-* tokens. Changing the ladder means editing root variables only, never components.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现字号阶梯。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 用 CSS 变量定义 6～8 档字号，按 1.25 或 1.333 比例生成
- 标题与正文共用同一阶梯，组件内禁止写死 px
- 需要响应式时用 clamp() 流式档位，两端封顶
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a type scale in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Six to eight size variables generated from a 1.25 or 1.333 ratio
- Headings and body share one ladder; never hard-code pixels in components
- Use capped clamp() fluid steps where responsiveness is needed
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 用 z-index 决定已定位元素在纸面上的前后顺序，但真正说话的是层叠上下文：一旦祖先把 transform、opacity 或 isolation 变成上下文， 子元素的 9999 就只在这个盒子里有效，永远压不过外面的 z-index: 1。与其到处写魔法数字，不如定一套从小到大的命名档位。
description.en: z-index orders positioned elements on the page, but stacking contexts decide who really wins: once an ancestor gains transform, opacity or isolation, a child's 9999 only competes inside that box and can never beat an outside z-index: 1. Replace scattered magic numbers with one small named ladder.

use_when.zh: 下拉、气泡、抽屉、模态需要固定的前后叠放次序
use_when.en: Dropdowns, tooltips, drawers and modals need a fixed stacking order

use_when.zh: 吸顶导航与浮动按钮要始终压在滚动内容之上
use_when.en: Sticky bars and floating buttons must stay above scrolling content

use_when.zh: 调试“弹窗被遮住”时先定位层叠上下文，再谈数值
use_when.en: When an overlay is hidden, find the stacking context before raising numbers

avoid_when.zh: 把 z-index 9999 当万能药，出问题就再加一位
avoid_when.en: Treating 9999 as a cure-all and bumping digits when it fails

avoid_when.zh: 没有档位体系，1、5、100、9999 随手混用
avoid_when.en: Random values — 1, 5, 100, 9999 — with no shared ladder

avoid_when.zh: 元素只想视觉浮起，却忘了它既没定位也没上下文
avoid_when.en: Expecting lift from z-index on an element that is not positioned

note.zh: 10 / 20 / 40 留出插队空隙，够用且仍可读
note.en: 10 / 20 / 40 leave gaps to insert layers later

note.zh: --z-dropdown、--z-modal、--z-toast，按用途引用
note.en: --z-dropdown, --z-modal, --z-toast referenced by purpose

note.zh: 父级 isolation: isolate，把子元素锁在局部，数值不外泄
note.en: Parent isolation: isolate traps children locally so values cannot leak

notes.zh: 先保证定位（position 非 static），z-index 才生效。把档位做成令牌：--z-base: 0; --z-dropdown: 10; --z-sticky: 20; --z-modal: 40; --z-toast: 60。需要把子元素锁在局部时给父级 isolation: isolate（或明确的 position 与 z-index）， 避免子元素的大数值越级。不要用 9999 兜底，档位之间留出插队空间。
notes.en: z-index only applies to positioned elements, so non-static position comes first. Tokenise the ladder: --z-base: 0; --z-dropdown: 10; --z-sticky: 20; --z-modal: 40; --z-toast: 60. To trap children locally give a parent isolation: isolate (or an explicit position plus z-index) so a big child number cannot escape. Never fall back to 9999 — leave room to insert layers.

basic.zh: 建立层级体系：定义从小到大的 z-index 档位，让弹层与内容有稳定的前后顺序。
basic.en: Build a stacking system — a small z-index ladder giving overlays and content a stable order.

design.zh: 层级规范：档位固定为 base 0 / dropdown 10 / sticky 20 / modal 40 / toast 60，中间留空隙；同屏浮层差不超过两档； 需要局部隔离时用 isolation: isolate；禁止出现 9999 之类的魔法数字；层级只表达前后关系，不承担视觉深度。
design.en: Stacking spec: fixed levels base 0 / dropdown 10 / sticky 20 / modal 40 / toast 60 with gaps between; overlays on one screen stay within two levels; use isolation: isolate for local containment; no magic numbers like 9999; z-index describes order only, never visual depth.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 变量落地：--z-base: 0; --z-dropdown: 10; --z-sticky: 20; --z-modal: 40; --z-toast: 60；组件写 z-index: var(--z-modal) 并配 position。浮层容器加 isolation: isolate 防止内部数值越级。排查遮挡时先看祖先是否因 transform、 opacity、filter 生成了新的层叠上下文，再决定调值还是改结构。
implementation.en: Ship the ladder as CSS variables: --z-base: 0; --z-dropdown: 10; --z-sticky: 20; --z-modal: 40; --z-toast: 60; consume them as z-index: var(--z-modal) with a position. Add isolation: isolate on overlay containers so inner values cannot escape. When something is covered, first check whether an ancestor created a new stacking context via transform, opacity or filter, then choose between raising a value and fixing the structure.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现层级与堆叠。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 一套命名 z-index 档位（base / dropdown / sticky / modal / toast）
- 浮层容器用 isolation: isolate，避免子元素数值越级
- 消除 9999 等魔法数字
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement stacking and z-index in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- A named z-index ladder (base / dropdown / sticky / modal / toast)
- Overlay containers use isolation: isolate so inner values cannot escape
- Remove magic numbers such as 9999
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 点击标题后内容区在高度方向展开或收起，像手风琴风箱。 关键是用 grid-template-rows 从 0fr 到 1fr 的高度动画， 让内容"推开来"而不是瞬间出现， 同时箭头旋转呼应状态。
description.en: Tapping a header expands or collapses the content vertically, like a bellows. The crux is animating grid-template-rows from 0fr to 1fr so content unfolds instead of popping in, with the chevron rotating in sync.

use_when.zh: FAQ、设置分组、详情页补充信息
use_when.en: FAQs, grouped settings, supplementary detail sections

use_when.zh: 长页面需要折叠低优先级内容
use_when.en: Long pages hiding low-priority content

use_when.zh: 同组内容一次只看一个（互斥手风琴）
use_when.en: Exclusive sections — one open at a time

avoid_when.zh: 用户需要对比多个展开项（互斥会烦）
avoid_when.en: Comparing several sections open at once

avoid_when.zh: 内容超过两屏（滚动比折叠更自然）
avoid_when.en: Content over two screens — scrolling beats folding

avoid_when.zh: 关键操作路径上的步骤（隐藏即摩擦）
