avoid_when.en: Critical steps in a flow — hiding adds friction

note.zh: 同时只开一项，经典手风琴
note.en: One open at a time — the classic accordion

note.zh: 各项独立开合，适合并列内容
note.en: Independent toggles for parallel content

note.zh: grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr，免测高度
note.en: grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr — no height measuring

notes.zh: 现代纯 CSS 法：外层 display:grid，grid-template-rows 在 0fr 与 1fr 间过渡（300ms）， 内层 min-height:0 + overflow:hidden。 免去 JS 测量高度。 展开/收起方向一致；箭头 rotate 90/180 同步过渡； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 改为瞬时切换。
notes.en: Modern CSS recipe — outer display:grid with grid-template-rows transitioning between 0fr and 1fr (300ms), inner min-height:0 plus overflow:hidden. No height measuring needed. Keep expand/collapse symmetric; rotate the chevron 90/180 in sync; under prefers-reduced-motion switch instantly.

basic.zh: 给 FAQ 列表添加手风琴展开效果：点击标题展开答案，再点收起。
basic.en: Add accordion expand to the FAQ — tapping a header reveals the answer, tapping again collapses it.

design.zh: FAQ 项点击后答案在 300ms 内由 0fr 展开到 1fr，箭头同步旋转 180°；同组互斥，一次只开一项；展开不跳页。
design.en: On tap, the answer unfolds from 0fr to 1fr within 300ms while the chevron rotates 180°; sections are mutually exclusive — one open at a time; no page jump.

implementation.zh: 外层 grid + grid-template-rows: 0fr/1fr 过渡 300ms，内层 overflow:hidden + min-height:0。React 里用 useState 存展开 id，互斥取单值。加 aria-expanded 与按钮语义；reduced-motion 直接切换。
implementation.en: Outer grid with grid-template-rows 0fr/1fr transition over 300ms, inner overflow:hidden + min-height:0. Store the open id in useState; mutual exclusion means a single value. Add aria-expanded and button semantics; switch instantly under reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目 FAQ 区添加手风琴展开动效。

先检查现有 accordion/折叠组件，避免重复实现。
要求：
- grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr 高度动画，300ms
- 同组互斥（可配置多开），箭头同步旋转
- aria-expanded 正确、键盘可操作
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add accordion expand motion to the project's FAQ section.

Check existing accordion/collapse components first; avoid duplicating them.
Requirements:
- grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr height animation, 300ms
- Mutually exclusive within a group (multi-open configurable), chevron in sync
- Correct aria-expanded and keyboard operability
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 完成关键动作后从一点爆出彩色纸屑飘落，用一次性高能量庆祝"做成了"。 只在里程碑出现：提交成功、任务完成、订阅达成—— 正因为稀有，才有庆祝的分量。
description.en: On completing a key action, a burst of coloured pieces erupts and falls — a one-shot, high-energy celebration. It belongs only to milestones: submission success, task done, subscription reached. Rarity is what gives it weight.

use_when.zh: 里程碑完成（首次发布、支付成功、目标达成）
use_when.en: Milestones — first publish, payment success, goal reached

use_when.zh: 空状态被首次打破、成就解锁
use_when.en: First-time moments and achievements unlocked

use_when.zh: 品牌调性允许庆祝的 C 端产品
use_when.en: Consumer products whose brand welcomes celebration

avoid_when.zh: 高频操作（每次保存都撒花即灾难）
avoid_when.en: Frequent actions — confetti on every save is a disaster

avoid_when.zh: 严肃或专业工具界面
avoid_when.en: Serious or professional tooling

avoid_when.zh: 会遮挡关键结果信息的时机
avoid_when.en: Moments where it obscures the result itself

note.zh: 从按钮中心向外抛射，最常用
note.en: Erupts from the button center — the default

note.zh: 左右两门礼炮对射，仪式感更强
note.en: Two cannons firing from both sides — more ceremony

note.zh: 从顶部持续飘落数秒，覆盖感最强
note.en: Drifts down from the top for seconds — maximum coverage

notes.zh: 用绝对定位的若干小块（div 或 canvas 粒子），随机角度、初速、颜色做抛物线下落并旋转， 1～2s 动画结束后立即从 DOM 移除， 防止节点泄漏。 一次性触发，不循环； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 改为静态成功图标。
notes.en: Spawn absolutely positioned small pieces (divs or canvas particles) with random angle, initial velocity and colour, falling in a parabola while spinning; remove them from the DOM as soon as the 1–2s animation ends to prevent node leaks. Fire once, never loop; respect prefers-reduced-motion with a static success glyph instead.

basic.zh: 给任务完成时刻添加撒花庆祝效果：点击完成后爆出彩色纸屑。
basic.en: Add a confetti celebration to task completion — a burst of colour when the task is done.

design.zh: 完成按钮点击后从按钮中心爆出 30～60 枚纸屑，抛物线下落 1.5s 后消失；颜色取品牌色板；一次性，不循环。
design.en: On completion, 30–60 pieces burst from the button center, fall in parabolas for 1.5s, then vanish; colours come from the brand palette; one-shot, never looping.

implementation.zh: 点击时生成 N 个绝对定位小 div，随机 --dx/--dy/--rot 自定义属性驱动 @keyframes 抛物线 + 旋转，animationend 后 remove()。容器 pointer-events:none + overflow:hidden。reduced-motion 直接显示成功状态。
implementation.en: On click, spawn N absolutely positioned divs with random --dx/--dy/--rot custom properties driving a parabola + spin keyframe; remove() each on animationend. Container gets pointer-events:none and overflow:hidden. Under reduced-motion show the success state directly.

agent.zh:
为项目里程碑时刻添加撒花庆祝动效。

先检查产品调性与触发时机清单，确认撒花是合适的（低频正向）。
要求：
- 30～60 枚纸屑，1～2s 抛物线飘落后清理 DOM
- 一次性触发，颜色用品牌令牌
- 不遮挡结果信息，pointer-events 不拦截点击
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add confetti celebration to the project's milestone moments.

Check brand tone and the trigger list first; confirm confetti fits (low-frequency, positive).
Requirements:
- 30–60 pieces, 1–2s parabola, DOM cleaned up afterwards
- One-shot, brand token colours
- Never obscures results; pointer-events must not block clicks
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 面板从屏幕边缘（常为右侧或底部）滑入并带遮罩，像从抽屉里拉出来。 转场方向即空间隐喻：从边缘滑入表示"叠加的临时层"， 关闭时原路滑回，保持心智模型不换。
description.en: A panel slides in from a screen edge — usually right or bottom — over a scrim, like pulling out a drawer. Direction carries the spatial metaphor: entering from the edge marks it as a temporary layer, and it exits back the same way, keeping the mental model intact.

use_when.zh: 移动端筛选、设置、详情等次级内容
use_when.en: Secondary content on mobile — filters, settings, detail sheets

use_when.zh: 需要保留主页面上下文的侧边操作
use_when.en: Side panels that must keep the main page in context

use_when.zh: 底部抽屉（bottom sheet）承载移动端快捷操作
use_when.en: Bottom sheets for quick mobile actions

avoid_when.zh: 不可跳过的强制任务（抽屉可随手关掉）
avoid_when.en: Unskippable tasks — drawers are dismissed on a whim

avoid_when.zh: 内容复杂需要大空间（改用整页或 modal）
avoid_when.en: Complex content needing room — use a page or modal

avoid_when.zh: 滑入动画超过 300ms（等待感明显）
avoid_when.en: Slide durations past 300ms — waits feel long

note.zh: X 轴位移，桌面端最常见
note.en: X-axis motion — the desktop default

note.zh: Y 轴上滑，移动端标准形态
note.en: Slides up on the Y axis — the mobile standard

note.zh: 遮罩与面板同步淡入，加深层次
note.en: Scrim fades in with the panel for depth

notes.zh: 面板 transform 从 translateX(100%)（或 translateY(100%)）到 0，260～300ms， 材料系抽屉曲线 cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)；关闭方向相反。 遮罩 opacity 0→1 同步。 只动 transform/opacity 不引起回流；打开时锁 body 滚动并管理焦点与 Esc 关闭。
notes.en: Animate the panel transform from translateX(100%) (or translateY(100%)) to 0 over 260–300ms using the Material drawer curve cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); reverse on close. Fade the scrim opacity 0→1 in sync. Animate transform/opacity only to avoid reflow; lock body scroll and manage focus plus Esc-to-close while open.

basic.zh: 给筛选面板添加抽屉滑入效果：从右侧滑入并带遮罩。
basic.en: Add a drawer slide to the filter panel — sliding in from the right over a scrim.

design.zh: 筛选抽屉从右侧滑入 280ms，曲线带回抽感，遮罩同步淡入；关闭时原路滑回；底部抽屉在移动端从下方上滑。
design.en: The filter drawer slides in from the right over 280ms with a decelerating-with-snap curve, scrim fading in sync; it exits back the same way; on mobile the bottom sheet slides up instead.

implementation.zh: transform: translateX(100%) ↔ 0，transition 280ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)；遮罩 opacity 过渡同步。挂载期用两帧（rAF）切状态避免首帧跳变。打开时 document.body.style.overflow = hidden，Esc 与遮罩点击关闭，焦点移入抽屉。
implementation.en: transform translateX(100%) ↔ 0 with transition 280ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); scrim opacity in sync. Toggle the state after a double rAF on mount to avoid a first-frame jump. Lock body overflow while open, close on Esc and scrim click, move focus into the drawer.

agent.zh:
为项目添加抽屉滑入转场（右侧筛选抽屉）。

先检查现有 drawer/modal 组件，复用其焦点与滚动锁定逻辑。
要求：
- transform 滑入 260～300ms，材料抽屉曲线
- 遮罩同步淡入，Esc/遮罩点击可关
- 只动 transform/opacity，无布局位移
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion（改为淡入淡出）
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add a drawer-slide transition to the project (right-side filter drawer).

Check existing drawer/modal components first; reuse their focus trap and scroll lock.
Requirements:
- transform slide 260–300ms with the Material drawer curve
- Scrim fades in sync; close on Esc and scrim click
- transform/opacity only, no layout shift
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion (fall back to fades)
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 元素到位后不是稳稳停住，而是带一两次越过后回弹的振荡， 像有弹性地"Q 一下"。 给界面注入物理感和俏皮感， 常用于成功状态、奖励时刻或品牌化入场。
description.en: The element overshoots its resting point and oscillates once or twice before settling — a springy "boing". It injects physics and playfulness, best saved for success states, reward moments and branded entrances.

use_when.zh: 成功、奖励、升级等正向关键时刻
use_when.en: Positive peaks — success, rewards, level-ups

use_when.zh: 品牌调性活泼，需要记忆点
use_when.en: Playful brands that want a signature moment

use_when.zh: 拖拽松手后的回弹落位
use_when.en: Snap-back after releasing a drag

avoid_when.zh: 高频操作按钮（每次都弹，很快变烦）
avoid_when.en: High-frequency buttons — the bounce wears out fast

avoid_when.zh: 严肃场景（支付、医疗、法律）
avoid_when.en: Serious contexts — payments, healthcare, legal

avoid_when.zh: 弹跳幅度过大（超过元素尺寸 10% 显得失控）
avoid_when.en: Oversized bounce — past ~10% of size it looks broken

note.zh: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 一次过冲，最简
note.en: One overshoot via cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) — simplest

note.zh: keyframes 缩放 1→1.2→0.9→1 连续振荡
note.en: Keyframed scale 1→1.2→0.9→1 for continuous wobble

note.zh: 松手后带回弹归位，物理感最强
note.en: Snaps back with spring physics on release

notes.zh: 最简法用带 y>1 的 cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)（ease-out-back）让过渡末段越过终点再回来； 多次振荡用 keyframes 显式写缩放序列。 transform-origin 保持居中， 幅度控制在元素尺寸 10% 以内； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 直接落到终态。
notes.en: Simplest recipe — a cubic-bezier with y>1, (0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), lets the transition overshoot the end and settle back; multi-oscillation needs explicit keyframed scale sequences. Keep transform-origin centered and the amplitude within 10% of the element's size; with prefers-reduced-motion land on the final state directly.

basic.zh: 给成功状态添加弹性回跳动画：图标出现时 Q 弹一下。
basic.en: Add an elastic bounce to the success state — the icon lands with a springy pop.

design.zh: 成功徽章出现时缩放从 0.6 弹到 1，带一次过冲回落，450ms；幅度不超过尺寸 10%；只在成功时刻触发。
design.en: The success badge scales from 0.6 to 1 with a single overshoot over 450ms; amplitude stays under 10% of size; triggered only at the moment of success.

implementation.zh: transition/animation 用 cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)；果冻版写 keyframes scale 1→1.08→0.96→1， 总时长 400～600ms。注意与 opacity 组合时过冲只作用于 scale。reduced-motion 直接显示终态。
implementation.en: Use cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) for transitions/animations; the jelly variant writes keyframes scale 1→1.08→0.96→1 over 400–600ms total. When combined with opacity, let only scale overshoot. Land on the final state directly under reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目成功/奖励时刻添加弹性回跳动效。

先检查现有动效令牌与缓动变量，避免私加曲线。
要求：
- 过冲幅度 ≤ 元素尺寸 10%，总时长 ≤ 600ms
- 只用于低频正向时刻，不挂在常规按钮上
- transform-origin 居中，不影响布局
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add an elastic bounce to success and reward moments in the project.

Check existing motion tokens and easing variables first; don't invent private curves.
Requirements:
- Overshoot within 10% of element size, total ≤ 600ms
- Only on low-frequency positive moments, never on routine buttons
- Centered transform-origin, no layout impact
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 鼠标悬停时元素边缘泛出柔和光晕，用外发光阴影或径向渐变沿边框晕开， 颜色多为品牌强调色。相比投影的"物理抬升"，光晕暗示的是"能量"与"可交互"， 常用于深色界面、游戏感产品与霓虹风格按钮。
description.en: On hover, a soft glow blooms around the element's edges — an outer box-shadow or radial gradient tinted with the brand accent. Unlike a shadow's physical lift, glow signals energy and interactivity; common on dark UIs, gaming products and neon-style buttons.

use_when.zh: 深色界面上突出主操作按钮或图标
use_when.en: Highlighting primary actions or icons on dark UIs

use_when.zh: 霓虹 / 游戏 / 科技感的产品调性
use_when.en: Neon, gaming or sci-fi product tones

use_when.zh: 与 hover-lift 二选一，避免同时叠加
use_when.en: Choose instead of hover-lift — avoid stacking both

avoid_when.zh: 浅色背景上低对比光晕（几乎不可见）
avoid_when.en: Low-contrast glow on light backgrounds — nearly invisible

avoid_when.zh: 大面积元素整块发光（刺眼且廉价）
avoid_when.en: Large surfaces glowing wholesale — harsh and cheap-looking

avoid_when.zh: 信息密集的工具界面（光晕分散注意力）
avoid_when.en: Dense utility interfaces — glow steals attention

note.zh: box-shadow 大模糊 + 强调色，最常用
note.en: Large-blur accent box-shadow — the default

note.zh: 径向渐变沿边框晕开，霓虹感更强
note.en: Radial gradient tracing the border — more neon

note.zh: inset 阴影向内晕光，适合深色卡片
note.en: Inset shadow glowing inward — suits dark cards

适合元素.zh: 按钮 / 图标 / 深色卡片

notes.zh: 基础写法是 transition: box-shadow 200ms 后在 :hover 加 0 0 0 1px + 0 0 24px 两层强调色阴影；更高级的边框流光用伪元素 + 径向渐变 配合 mask 或 background 定位动画。光晕颜色取品牌强调色并保持 40%～60% 透明度， 避免纯白发光。触屏设备用 @media (hover:hover) 门控。
notes.en: Base recipe: `transition: box-shadow 200ms`, then on :hover stack two accent shadows (a 1px ring + a ~24px blur bloom). The border-gradient variant uses a pseudo-element with a radial gradient behind a mask, or animates background position. Tint the glow with the accent at 40–60% opacity; avoid pure white. Gate behind @media (hover:hover) for touch devices.

basic.zh: 给按钮添加 hover 发光效果：鼠标悬停时边缘泛出柔和光晕。
basic.en: Add a hover glow to buttons — a soft halo blooming around the edges on hover.

design.zh: 按钮 hover 时边缘泛出品牌强调色光晕：1px 同色描边 + 24px 模糊外发光， 200ms 过渡；只用于主操作，普通按钮仅描边着色不发光。
design.en: On hover, buttons bloom with an accent-colored halo — a 1px matching ring plus a 24px blurred outer glow, 200ms transition; reserve it for primary actions.

implementation.zh: 纯 CSS：transition: box-shadow .2s；hover 时 box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent), 0 0 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 50%, transparent)。 用 @media (hover:hover) 门控触屏；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion（降级为仅描边变色）。
implementation.en: CSS-only: `transition: box-shadow .2s`; on hover `box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent), 0 0 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 50%, transparent)`. Gate behind @media (hover:hover); respect prefers-reduced-motion (ring-color-only fallback).

agent.zh:
为当前项目的主操作按钮添加 hover 发光反馈。

先检查现有按钮层级与强调色令牌，保持一致。
要求：
- hover 时 1px 描边 + 24px 强调色外发光，200ms 过渡
- 仅主按钮发光，次要按钮降级为描边着色
- 仅在支持 hover 的设备启用（@media hover:hover）
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add a hover glow to the project's primary action buttons.

Inspect existing button hierarchy and accent tokens first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- 1px ring + 24px accent glow on hover, 200ms transition
- Glow only on primary buttons; secondary gets ring tint only
- Only on hover-capable devices (@media hover:hover)
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 鼠标悬停时卡片或按钮轻轻上浮（translateY -2～6px）并加深投影， 像被无形的手托起。最常见的"这个可以点"的桌面端暗示， 成本极低但立刻让页面有层次和呼吸感。
description.en: On hover, a card or button lifts slightly (translateY -2–6px) while its shadow deepens — as if raised by an invisible hand. The most common desktop affordance for "this is clickable": nearly free, instantly adds depth and life.

use_when.zh: 卡片网格、商品卡、文章卡等可点击块
use_when.en: Card grids, product cards, article cards — clickable blocks

use_when.zh: 桌面端为主的交互（hover 是桌面专属语言）
use_when.en: Desktop-first contexts — hover is a desktop language

use_when.zh: 平面层级需要区分可交互与静态元素
use_when.en: When flat layouts need to separate interactive from static elements

avoid_when.zh: 触屏设备（没有 hover，会粘滞），改用按压反馈
avoid_when.en: Touch devices — no hover, sticky triggers; use press feedback instead

avoid_when.zh: 页面上所有元素都上浮（通胀，暗示失效）
avoid_when.en: Everything lifts — the affordance inflates and stops meaning anything

avoid_when.zh: 大幅位移（> 8px 会显得跳动）
avoid_when.en: Large offsets — beyond 8px it feels jumpy

note.zh: 经典组合，-4px + 阴影加深
note.en: The classic — -4px + deeper shadow

note.zh: 叠加 scale(1.02)，电商感更强
note.en: Adds scale(1.02) — more e-commerce energy

note.zh: 投影换成强调色边框，扁平风格适用
note.en: Swap shadow for accent border — suits flat styles

notes.zh: transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms；hover 时 translateY(-4px) + 更大更淡的 box-shadow（如 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12)）。注意上浮方向始终向上， 阴影随之上移。与 press-feedback 组合时：hover 上浮、active 缩回，层次分明。
notes.en: `transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms`; on hover translateY(-4px) plus a larger, softer shadow (e.g. 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12)). The shadow grows and lifts together with the element. Pairs with press-feedback: lift on hover, scale back on press.

basic.zh: 给卡片添加 hover 上浮效果：鼠标悬停时轻微上移并加深阴影。
basic.en: Add a hover lift to cards — a slight upward shift with a deepening shadow.

design.zh: 卡片 hover 时上移 4px，阴影从 subtle 变为 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12)，200ms ease 过渡；上浮方向与阴影一致；不动布局。
design.en: On hover, cards rise 4px while the shadow deepens to 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12); 200ms ease; shadow follows the lift; no layout shift.

implementation.zh: "纯 CSS：transition: transform .2s ease", box-shadow .2s ease；hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg。触屏设备禁用（@media (hover:hover)）。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion（降级为仅阴影变化）。
implementation.en: "CSS-only: `transition: transform .2s ease", box-shadow .2s ease` with `hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg`. Gate behind @media (hover:hover) for touch. Respect prefers-reduced-motion (shadow-only fallback).

agent.zh:
为当前项目的卡片列表添加 hover 上浮反馈。

先检查现有卡片组件，保持圆角与阴影令牌一致。
要求：
- hover 上移 4px + 阴影加深，200ms 过渡
- 仅在支持 hover 的设备启用（@media hover:hover）
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不影响布局（transform 实现）
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add hover lift feedback to the project's card lists.

Inspect existing card components first; keep radius and shadow tokens consistent.
Requirements:
- 4px rise + deeper shadow on hover, 200ms transition
- Only on hover-capable devices (@media hover:hover)
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No layout shift (transform-based)
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 用一个持续旋转的圆环或圆点表示"正在处理"。占用空间极小、语义全球通用， 适合嵌入按钮内、跟随光标或作为局部区块的轻量加载反馈。 它只表达"忙碌"，不表达进度多少，也不预告还剩多久。
description.en: A continuously rotating ring or dots that says "work in progress". Tiny in footprint and universally understood, it fits inside buttons, cursors or small regions as lightweight feedback. It communicates busyness only — neither progress amount nor time remaining.

use_when.zh: 1～5 秒的短时等待（请求、提交、刷新）
use_when.en: Short waits of 1–5 seconds — requests, submits, refreshes

use_when.zh: 按钮内联表示"点击已生效，处理中"
use_when.en: Inline in a button to confirm the click registered

use_when.zh: 局部小区域加载，不值得整页骨架屏
use_when.en: Small local regions where a full skeleton is overkill

avoid_when.zh: 超过 5～10 秒的等待（改用进度条）
avoid_when.en: Waits beyond 5–10 seconds — use a progress bar

avoid_when.zh: 首屏内容加载（改用骨架屏保布局）
avoid_when.en: Initial content loads — skeletons preserve layout

avoid_when.zh: 无限旋转但任务可能失败（需可取消/可退出）
avoid_when.en: Potentially failing tasks — spinner alone offers no escape

note.zh: 部分弧线旋转，Material 风格
note.en: Partial arc rotating — Material style

note.zh: 三点波浪起伏，社交产品常用
note.en: Three dots waving — social products' favorite

note.zh: 双层反向旋转，科技感更强
note.en: Two counter-rotating rings — more techy

与结果一致性.en: Low — no shape of the result

notes.zh: 最简实现：直径 16～24px 的圆，边框 2～3px，只给顶部一个强调色边框， animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite。圆点版用三个圆 + 交错 animation-delay。 必须加 role="status" 与 aria-label="加载中"， 并尊重 prefers-reduced-motion（降级为呼吸透明度）。
notes.en: Simplest recipe: a 16–24px circle with a 2–3px border where only the top arc takes the accent color, animated with `spin 0.8s linear infinite`. The dots variant staggers animation-delay across three circles. Always add role="status" with an aria-label, and respect prefers-reduced-motion (fall back to a gentle opacity pulse).

basic.zh: 给按钮添加旋转加载指示器：提交中按钮内显示转圈图标并禁用点击。
basic.en: Add a spinner to the button — show a rotating icon and disable clicks while submitting.

design.zh: 提交时按钮文字替换为 16px 强调色圆环指示器，按钮禁用并保持宽度不变， 旋转 0.8s linear infinite；完成后恢复文字。
design.en: While submitting, swap the button label for a 16px accent ring spinning at 0.8s linear infinite; disable the button, keep its width fixed, restore the label when done.

implementation.zh: 纯 CSS：border: 2px solid transparent; border-top-color: var(--accent); animation: spin .8s linear infinite。按钮内联时用 flex 居中并锁宽 （min-width 防抖动）。加 role="status" aria-label="加载中"； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion（改用透明度呼吸）。
implementation.en: CSS-only: `border: 2px solid transparent; border-top-color: var(--accent);` with `animation: spin .8s linear infinite`. Inline in buttons via flex centering and a min-width to avoid layout shift. Add role="status" + aria-label; respect prefers-reduced-motion (opacity pulse instead).

agent.zh:
为项目中的异步按钮与局部区块统一加载指示器。

先检查现有 loading 组件与令牌，避免重复造轮子。
要求：
- 16px 圆环指示器，0.8s 匀速旋转，颜色用强调色令牌
- 按钮场景禁用交互并锁定宽度防抖动
- 可访问性：role="status" + aria-label
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Unify the loading indicator for async buttons and local regions in the project.

Check existing loading components and tokens first; don't reinvent.
Requirements:
- 16px ring, 0.8s linear spin, accent token color
- In buttons: disable interaction and lock width to prevent shift
- Accessibility: role="status" + aria-label
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 鼠标靠近按钮时，按钮像被磁铁吸住一样朝光标方向偏移一小段距离， 离开后弹性归位。偏移量按光标与按钮中心的距离计算，通常限制在 8～20px。 一种高"手感"的桌面端彩蛋交互，常出现在作品集与创意官网。
description.en: As the cursor approaches, the button is pulled toward it like iron to a magnet, then springs home on leave. The offset is computed from cursor-to-center distance and usually clamped to 8–20px. A tactile desktop flourish common on portfolios and creative sites.

use_when.zh: 落地页的 CTA、导航图标等少量关键按钮
use_when.en: A few key targets — landing-page CTAs, nav icons

use_when.zh: 创意类 / 作品集网站的品牌调性
use_when.en: Creative or portfolio sites leaning into personality

use_when.zh: 桌面端为主、留白充足的布局
use_when.en: Desktop-first layouts with room to move

avoid_when.zh: 触屏设备（没有 hover，效果失效）
avoid_when.en: Touch devices — no hover, no effect

avoid_when.zh: 表单控件与密集操作区（偏移破坏瞄准）
avoid_when.en: Form controls and dense toolbars — offset ruins aiming

avoid_when.zh: 页面大量按钮全部磁吸（眩晕且廉价）
avoid_when.en: Magnetizing every button on the page — dizzying and cheap

note.zh: 按钮整体向光标平移，最基础
note.en: The whole button translates toward the cursor

note.zh: 文字比外壳多移一档，产生视差
note.en: The label travels further than the shell — parallax

note.zh: 叠加轻微 rotateX/Y，立体感更强
note.en: Adds subtle rotateX/Y for depth

notes.zh: 在按钮（或更大的热区）上监听 mousemove，用 getBoundingClientRect 求光标相对 中心的比例，乘以最大偏移（如 0.3 × 40px）写入 transform: translate； mouseleave 时归零并给 300～500ms 的弹性过渡（cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1.2)）。 进入热区时把 transition 缩短到 100ms 让跟随更"黏"。 触屏直接禁用，配 @media (hover:hover)。
notes.en: Listen for mousemove on a hotspot wrapping the button; derive the cursor's offset ratio from center via getBoundingClientRect, multiply by max travel (e.g. 0.3 × 40px) and write it to `transform: translate`. On mouseleave, return to zero with a springy 300–500ms transition (cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1.2)); shorten to ~100ms while inside so the follow feels sticky. Disable on touch behind @media (hover:hover).

basic.zh: 给按钮添加磁吸效果：鼠标靠近时按钮朝光标方向轻微偏移，离开后弹回。
basic.en: Add a magnetic effect to buttons — the button drifts toward the nearby cursor and springs back on leave.

design.zh: 按钮在光标进入 1.5 倍热区时按比例向光标平移（最大 12px），跟随 100ms、 弹回 400ms 弹性缓动；只用于主 CTA，触屏与键盘操作不受影响。
design.en: Within a 1.5x hotspot the button translates proportionally toward the cursor (max 12px), 100ms follow and a 400ms springy return; reserve for primary CTAs, keep touch and keyboard unaffected.

implementation.zh: React 实现：热区 div 监听 onMouseMove/onMouseLeave，getBoundingClientRect 计算相对中心偏移，setState 驱动 transform: translate(x,y)；内部用 will-change: transform。跟随 100ms、回弹 400ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1.2)。 @media (hover:hover) 门控；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion（禁用偏移）。
implementation.en: React: attach onMouseMove/onMouseLeave to a hotspot div, compute the center-relative offset with getBoundingClientRect, drive `transform: translate(x,y)` from state; add will-change: transform. 100ms follow, 400ms return with cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1.2). Gate behind @media (hover:hover); disable offsets under prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目的主 CTA 按钮添加磁吸交互。

先确认按钮组件结构与强调色令牌，保持一致。
要求：
- 热区 1.5 倍按钮大小，偏移上限 12px，跟随 100ms 弹回 400ms
- 键盘焦点与触屏行为不受影响
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add a magnetic interaction to the project's primary CTA buttons.

Confirm button component structure and accent tokens first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Hotspot 1.5x button size; offset capped at 12px; 100ms follow, 400ms spring
- Keyboard focus and touch behavior unaffected
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 一条内容带在水平方向匀速循环滚动，首尾无缝衔接。 用于 logo 墙、合作方名单、公告与促销横幅——用"连续流动"表达数量多与不间断， 而不是引导用户逐条读完。
description.en: A horizontal strip of content scrolling continuously and looping seamlessly. Used for logo walls, partner lists, announcements and promo banners — the endless flow signals abundance; it never asks users to read every item.

use_when.zh: 合作方/logo 墙，展示"很多谁在用我们"
use_when.en: Logo walls showing who else trusts the product

use_when.zh: 公告条、促销横幅的循环展示
use_when.en: Announcement bars and looping promo banners

use_when.zh: 内容远超容器宽度且无需逐条阅读
use_when.en: Content far wider than the container that nobody must read in full

avoid_when.zh: 用户必须读完的关键信息（读不完就焦虑）
avoid_when.en: Critical copy users must finish reading

avoid_when.zh: 需要停顿细看、可交互的条目
avoid_when.en: Items users need to pause on and click

avoid_when.zh: 移动端窄屏塞长条带（速度感知更快更晕）
avoid_when.en: Long strips on narrow mobile screens — perceived speed worsens

note.zh: 内容复制两份位移 -50% 循环，首尾无接缝
note.en: Duplicate the content, translate -50% — no visible seam

note.zh: hover 时 animation-play-state: paused 方便查看
note.en: Pauses via animation-play-state so items can be read

note.zh: 两条反向滚动，制造张力，编辑感首屏常用
note.en: Two strips scrolling opposite ways — editorial hero energy

notes.zh: 把内容复制两份放进 flex 容器，animation: marquee Xs linear infinite，keyframes 到 translateX(-50%)， 两份内容宽度一致才无缝。时长 15～40s 视内容量而定，匀速不缓动。 hover 暂停用 animation-play-state；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 改为静态可横向滚动。
notes.en: Duplicate the content inside a flex container and run animation marquee Xs linear infinite, keyframes to translateX(-50%); both copies must be identical in width for a seamless loop. Duration 15–40s depending on volume, linear, never eased. Pause on hover with animation-play-state; under prefers-reduced-motion fall back to a static horizontally scrollable strip.

basic.zh: 添加一个跑马灯：合作方 logo 横向匀速循环滚动。
basic.en: Add a marquee — partner logos scrolling horizontally in a seamless loop.

design.zh: 合作方条带以 30s 匀速循环滚动，内容复制两份无缝衔接，悬停暂停；灰度 logo、间距一致；不作为信息主通道。
design.en: A partner strip loops at 30s linear with the content duplicated for a seamless seam, pausing on hover; greyscale logos, even spacing; never a primary information channel.

implementation.zh: 纯 CSS：外层 overflow:hidden，内层 flex 内放两份相同内容，animation: marquee 30s linear infinite，@keyframes marquee 到 translateX(-50%)。hover 暂停：animation-play-state: paused。加 prefers-reduced-motion 降级为静态滚动。
implementation.en: CSS-only: outer overflow:hidden, inner flex holding two identical copies, animation marquee 30s linear infinite, keyframes to translateX(-50%). Hover pause via animation-play-state: paused. Degrade to a static scrollable strip under prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目落地页添加合作方 logo 跑马灯。

先检查现有 logo 资源与间距令牌。
要求：
- 内容复制两份实现无缝循环，匀速不缓动
- 悬停暂停；聚焦时也暂停（可访问性）
- 装饰属性：aria-hidden，不进入无障碍阅读流
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add a partner-logo marquee to the project's landing page.

Check existing logo assets and spacing tokens first.
Requirements:
- Duplicate content for a seamless loop, linear motion only
- Pause on hover and on focus (accessibility)
- Decorative: aria-hidden, outside the accessibility reading flow
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 一个图标在两种状态间平滑变形，而不是替换—— 最经典是汉堡三横变关闭叉。 用同一组线条的旋转、位移与透明度组合完成， 传达"同一个控件换了状态"。
description.en: One icon smoothly morphs between two states instead of being swapped — classically the hamburger turning into a close X. Built from the same strokes rotating, translating and fading, it says "same control, new state".

use_when.zh: 汉堡菜单 ↔ 关闭、播放 ↔ 暂停等成对状态
use_when.en: Paired states — menu/close, play/pause

use_when.zh: 同一位置的切换型图标按钮
use_when.en: Toggle-type icon buttons in a fixed spot

use_when.zh: 需要强调"状态变了"而空间不变
use_when.en: Emphasising a state change without moving layout

avoid_when.zh: 两个语义无关的图标（变形反而误导）
avoid_when.en: Semantically unrelated icons — morphing misleads

avoid_when.zh: 变形前后形状差异过大（中间帧生硬）
avoid_when.en: Shapes too different — the in-between looks broken

avoid_when.zh: 图标极小（小于 16px 变形细节看不清）
avoid_when.en: Tiny icons under 16px — the morph is illegible

note.zh: 中线上移淡出、上下线旋转交叉
note.en: Middle line fades out, outer lines rotate to cross

note.zh: 整体旋转 45°，最简单的变形
note.en: A 45° rotation of the whole icon — the easiest morph

note.zh: 三角与双竖条互相变形
note.en: Triangle and double bars morph into each other

notes.zh: 用三条 span（或 SVG line）加 transition transform 300ms。 汉堡变叉：上线 translateY(6px) rotate(45°)，下线 translateY(-6px) rotate(-45°)， 中线 opacity 0。 aria-label 必须随状态切换； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 改为直接切换图形。
notes.en: Three spans (or SVG lines) with transition transform 300ms. Hamburger to X — top line translateY(6px) rotate(45°), bottom translateY(-6px) rotate(-45°), middle opacity 0. The aria-label must switch with the state; respect prefers-reduced-motion by swapping the glyph directly.

basic.zh: 给导航按钮添加汉堡变叉的图标变形动画。
basic.en: Add a hamburger-to-X morph to the nav toggle button.

design.zh: 菜单开合时汉堡三横在 300ms 内变形为关闭叉：上下线旋转交叉、中线淡出；图标占位不变，aria-label 同步切换。
design.en: On menu toggle, the three bars morph into a close X within 300ms — outer lines rotate to cross, the middle fades out; the icon footprint never moves and the aria-label switches in sync.

implementation.zh: 三条绝对定位 span，open 状态：上线 translateY(6px) rotate(45deg)，下线 translateY(-6px) rotate(-45deg)，中线 opacity 0；transition transform+opacity 300ms。按钮加 aria-label={open ? 关闭 : 菜单}。reduced-motion 关闭过渡。
implementation.en: Three absolutely positioned spans; when open — top translateY(6px) rotate(45deg), bottom translateY(-6px) rotate(-45deg), middle opacity 0; transition transform+opacity 300ms. Set aria-label={open ? Close : Menu}. Disable the transition under reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目导航按钮实现汉堡变叉图标变形。

先检查现有图标体系（SVG 或 iconfont），选择可行的实现层。
要求：
- 同一组线条的 rotate/translate/opacity 过渡，300ms
- aria-label 随状态切换，键盘可触发
- 图标占位尺寸不变，无布局位移
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a hamburger-to-X morph for the project's nav toggle.

Check the existing icon system (SVG or iconfont) first and pick a feasible layer.
Requirements:
- rotate/translate/opacity transitions on the same strokes, 300ms
- aria-label switches with state; keyboard operable
- Fixed icon footprint, no layout shift
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 数字从 0（或旧值）滚动增长到目标值，让计数过程本身表达"数据在增长"。 常用于数据看板大数字、统计区与里程碑（"10 万用户"）。 数字成为动效的主角，比静态数值更有说服力。
description.en: Animates a number from zero (or a previous value) up to its target, so the counting itself tells the story of growth. Common on dashboard KPIs, stats sections and milestones ("100k users") — the digit becomes the animation, far more persuasive than a static figure.

use_when.zh: 首屏或统计区的大数字（KPI、用户数、下载量）
use_when.en: Big numbers on heroes and stats — KPIs, users, downloads

use_when.zh: 数字进入视口时触发一次，强调里程碑
use_when.en: One-shot count-up when the figure scrolls into view

use_when.zh: 数值更新时从旧值过渡到新值，保持连续感
use_when.en: Transitioning from an old value to a new one

avoid_when.zh: 高频刷新的实时数值（一直在滚，读不了）
avoid_when.en: Rapidly updating live values — perpetual rolling is unreadable

avoid_when.zh: 需要精确抄录的数字（金额、账号、验证码）
avoid_when.en: Figures users must transcribe exactly — amounts, IDs

avoid_when.zh: 表格内的密集小数字（噪音大于价值）
avoid_when.en: Dense small numbers inside tables — noise over value

note.zh: 起步快后段减速，最自然的落定
note.en: Fast start, eased landing — the natural default

note.zh: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums 防宽度抖动
note.en: tabular-nums prevents width jitter

note.zh: 千分位、单位、小数同步插值
note.en: Thousands separators, units and decimals interpolate in sync

notes.zh: CSS 无法直接给文本计数，实用做法是 requestAnimationFrame 插值 + ease-out 曲线， 时长 1～2s。必须加 font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums 防止数字宽度抖动； 千分位与单位在每帧一起格式化。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion——直接显示终值。
notes.en: CSS cannot count text; the practical recipe is requestAnimationFrame interpolation with an ease-out curve over 1–2s. Always add font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to stop width jitter, and format separators/units every frame. Respect prefers-reduced-motion by showing the final value directly.

basic.zh: 给统计区的大数字添加从 0 滚动到目标值的计数动画。
basic.en: Add a count-up animation to the stats — numbers roll from 0 to their target.

design.zh: 统计数字进入视口后 1.6s 内从 0 计数到目标值，ease-out 减速落定，等宽数字防抖动，千分位同步格式化；仅触发一次。
design.en: When stats enter the viewport, count from 0 to target over 1.6s with an ease-out landing, tabular digits to prevent jitter, thousands separators formatted per frame; trigger once only.

implementation.zh: 用 requestAnimationFrame 插值，progress 经 easeOutCubic(t) 变换，值为 Math.round(target * p)，toLocaleString 格式化。容器加 tabular-nums。IntersectionObserver 触发一次；prefers-reduced-motion 直接渲染终值。
implementation.en: Interpolate with requestAnimationFrame, ease via easeOutCubic(t), value = Math.round(target * p), formatted with toLocaleString. Apply tabular-nums to the container. Trigger once via IntersectionObserver; render the final value under prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目统计区的大数字添加计数动画。

先检查现有数字展示组件，避免与实时刷新逻辑冲突。
要求：
- rAF + ease-out 插值，1～2s，进入视口触发一次
- tabular-nums 防宽度抖动，千分位格式化
- reduced-motion 或 JS 失效时直接显示终值
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add a count-up animation to the project's stat numbers.

Check existing number display components first; avoid conflicts with live refresh logic.
Requirements:
- rAF + ease-out interpolation, 1–2s, triggered once in view
- tabular-nums to prevent jitter, thousands formatting
- Show the final value directly under reduced-motion or without JS
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 页面之间切换时，旧页面滑出或淡出、新页面滑入或淡入，让路由跳转 从"硬切"变成一段 200～400ms 的连续运动。方向应与信息层级一致： 进入下级页面向左推入，返回时向右退出，帮助用户建立空间心智模型。
description.en: When navigating, the outgoing page slides or fades away while the incoming one arrives — turning a hard cut into 200–400ms of continuous motion. Direction should mirror hierarchy: pushing left to go deeper, exiting right to go back, building a spatial mental model.

use_when.zh: SPA 路由切换、分步向导、tab 式页面流
use_when.en: SPA route changes, step wizards, tab-like flows

use_when.zh: 需要表达页面间父子层级关系
use_when.en: When parent-child hierarchy between pages matters

use_when.zh: 原生 App 风格的 Web 产品调性
use_when.en: Web products aiming for a native-app feel

avoid_when.zh: 每次 300ms 以上的长过渡（拖慢浏览节奏）
avoid_when.en: Transitions beyond 300ms — they drag the browsing rhythm

avoid_when.zh: 用户频繁快速切换（动画跟不上点击）
avoid_when.en: Rapid back-and-forth navigation — animation lags the clicks

avoid_when.zh: 传统多页站点整页刷新（没有过渡载体）
avoid_when.en: Traditional MPAs with full reloads — nothing to animate between

note.zh: 新页从右推入、旧页左移，表达层级
note.en: New page pushes in from the right — expresses depth

note.zh: 两页交叉淡化，中性无方向
note.en: Both pages cross-fade — neutral, directionless

note.zh: Material 规范，进入与退出配对同轴运动
note.en: Material's paired same-axis enter/exit

notes.zh: 最简做法：路由容器在切换时给旧页 class "exit"（translateX(-30%) + opacity:0）、 新页 "enter"（从 translateX(30%) 到 0），时长 250～300ms ease-out。 现代方案用 View Transitions API：document.startViewTransition 包裹路由更新， 一行代码获得交叉淡入淡出并可用 CSS 定制方向。注意尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Minimal recipe: on navigation give the outgoing page an "exit" class (translateX(-30%) + opacity:0) and animate the incoming one from translateX(30%) to 0 over 250–300ms ease-out. The modern route is the View Transitions API — wrap the router update in document.startViewTransition for a cross-fade you can restyle per direction in CSS. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 给站点路由切换添加过渡动画：新页面淡入，旧页面淡出。
basic.en: Add a transition between route changes — the new page fades in as the old one fades out.

design.zh: 页面切换采用共享轴过渡：前进时新页从右侧 30% 处滑入、旧页左移淡出， 返回时方向相反；时长 280ms ease-out，动画期间禁止重复触发。
design.en: Use a shared-axis transition: forward navigations slide the new page in from +30% while the old one fades left; backward reverses it. 280ms ease-out; ignore re-triggers while animating.

implementation.zh: React Router 场景：切换时对路由容器施加 key 触发的 CSS 动画类 （slide-in-left/right 250ms ease-out both）。或用 document.startViewTransition(() => flushSync(update))，配合 ::view-transition-old/new 自定义方向。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion （退化为 120ms 交叉淡化或直接切换）。
implementation.en: React Router: apply a key-driven CSS animation class to the route container (slide-in-left/right, 250ms ease-out both). Or use document.startViewTransition(() => flushSync(update)) and steer direction via ::view-transition-old/new. Respect prefers-reduced-motion (fall back to a 120ms cross-fade or an instant swap).

agent.zh:
为当前 SPA 的路由切换添加页面过渡。

先确认路由方案与页面容器结构。
要求：
- 前进/返回方向相反的滑入淡出，280ms ease-out
- 快速连续切换时不叠加错乱动画
- 首次加载不播放过渡
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add page transitions to the current SPA's route changes.

Confirm the routing setup and page container structure first.
Requirements:
- Opposing slide-and-fade directions for forward/back, 280ms ease-out
- No glitchy overlap during rapid successive navigations
- No transition on first load
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 滚动时不同图层以不同速度移动——背景慢、前景快—— 用速度差制造纵深。 是"2D 里伪造 3D"最便宜的手段， 常见于首屏大图与滚动叙事页面。
description.en: On scroll, layers move at different speeds — background slower, foreground faster — and the velocity gap reads as depth. The cheapest way to fake 3D in 2D; a staple of hero sections and scrollytelling.

use_when.zh: 首屏大图或插画需要纵深与电影感
use_when.en: Hero imagery that needs depth and a cinematic feel

use_when.zh: 滚动叙事页面，图层分段讲述
use_when.en: Scrollytelling where layers stage the story

use_when.zh: 装饰性背景纹理缓慢移动
use_when.en: Decorative background textures drifting slowly

avoid_when.zh: 长文阅读页面（滚动与文字错位致晕）
avoid_when.en: Long-form reading — offset motion causes nausea

avoid_when.zh: 移动端大规模视差（性能差且眩晕）
avoid_when.en: Heavy parallax on mobile — jank and motion sickness

avoid_when.zh: 视差影响可读性或遮挡操作目标
avoid_when.en: When it harms legibility or blocks targets

note.zh: 背景以 0.3～0.5 倍速滚动，最常用
note.en: Background scrolls at 0.3–0.5x — the default

note.zh: 三层以上不同速率，纵深更强
note.en: Three-plus layers at different rates — deeper feel

note.zh: animation-timeline: scroll() 绑定滚动进度
note.en: animation-timeline scroll() binds to scroll progress

notes.zh: 传统法监听 scroll，在 rAF 里对每层执行 translateY(scrollTop * factor)， factor 小于 1 为慢层（背景 0.3、前景 1.2）； 现代法用 CSS scroll-driven animations（animation-timeline: scroll()）。 只动 transform 走合成层； 移动端与 prefers-reduced-motion 默认关闭。
notes.en: The classic way — listen to scroll and, inside rAF, apply translateY(scrollTop * factor) per layer, factor < 1 for slow layers (background 0.3, foreground 1.2); the modern way is CSS scroll-driven animations (animation-timeline: scroll()). Transform-only changes stay on the compositor; default off on mobile and under prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 给首屏添加视差滚动：背景图比前景慢速移动。
basic.en: Add parallax to the hero — the background image moves slower than the foreground.

design.zh: 首屏分三层：远景 0.3 倍速、中景 0.6 倍速、前景 1 倍速，滚动时速度差制造纵深；装饰层不影响可读性。
design.en: Split the hero into three layers — far 0.3x, mid 0.6x, near 1x — so the velocity gap creates depth while scrolling; decorative layers never harm legibility.

implementation.zh: 监听 scroll 容器，rAF 内对每层 style.transform = translateY(scrollTop * factor)；背景层加 will-change: transform。或用 CSS：animation-timeline: scroll() + keyframes 位移。reduced-motion 与触屏默认静态。
implementation.en: Listen to the scroll container, set style.transform = translateY(scrollTop * factor) per layer inside rAF; add will-change: transform to background layers. Or CSS: animation-timeline: scroll() + keyframed offsets. Static by default under reduced-motion and on touch.

agent.zh:
为项目首屏添加视差滚动效果。

先检查首屏结构与滚动容器，确认性能预算。
要求：
- 分层不同速率，只动 transform（合成层）
- rAF 节流或 CSS scroll-timeline 实现
- 不影响可读性与滚动性能（避免 scroll 监听重排）
- 移动端与 reduced-motion 默认关闭
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add parallax scrolling to the project's hero section.

Inspect the hero structure and scroll container first; confirm the performance budget.
Requirements:
- Layered speeds, transform-only (compositor)
- rAF throttling or CSS scroll-timeline
- No readability or scroll-performance regressions (no layout thrash)
- Off by default on mobile and under reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 用户按下按钮、卡片等可点击元素时，元素轻微缩小（通常 0.95～0.98）， 松开后弹回。一个几十毫秒的细节，让界面"手感"立刻从网页变成实体按键。
description.en: When users press a clickable element it scales down slightly (typically 0.95–0.98) and springs back on release. A few tens of milliseconds that make a UI feel like physical buttons instead of flat web pages.

use_when.zh: 所有可点击元素：按钮、卡片、图标按钮
use_when.en: All tappable elements — buttons, cards, icon buttons

use_when.zh: 移动端与触屏界面（按压是最主要操作）
use_when.en: Touch-first interfaces where pressing is the primary gesture

use_when.zh: 需要"实体感"的产品调性
use_when.en: Products aiming for a tactile feel

avoid_when.zh: 大面积区域点击（整卡缩放会带动文字晃动）
avoid_when.en: Very large tap areas — scaling the whole card makes text wobble

avoid_when.zh: 列表行内小操作，避免整行抖动
avoid_when.en: Small inline actions inside rows — avoid whole-row jitter

avoid_when.zh: 已有其他强反馈（如下压阴影 + 填充动画）叠加过度
avoid_when.en: When stronger feedback already exists — avoid stacking effects

note.zh: 最常用，scale(0.96)
note.en: Most common, scale(0.96)

note.zh: 同时收小阴影，模拟"按下去"
note.en: Tighten shadow simultaneously to simulate pressing

note.zh: 不缩放，降低亮度，适合桌面
note.en: No scaling; dim instead — suits desktop

notes.zh: 用 :active 伪类配合 transition: transform 80ms；缩放原点默认中心。 松开的回弹可稍微放缓 transition（150ms）模拟弹簧。纯 CSS 即可实现，无需 JS。 移动端注意 :active 需要 touchstart 监听或 -webkit-tap-highlight 处理才能稳定触发。
notes.en: Use the :active pseudo-class with `transition: transform 80ms`; relax to ~150ms on release for a spring feel. Pure CSS suffices. On touch devices, :active can be flaky — add a touchstart listener or handle -webkit-tap-highlight.

basic.zh: 给按钮添加按压反馈：按下时轻微缩小，松开弹回。
basic.en: Add press feedback to buttons — a slight scale-down on press, springing back on release.

design.zh: 按钮按下时缩放到 0.96 并轻微收紧阴影，80ms 缩下、150ms 回弹，手感接近实体按键；触屏设备同样生效。
design.en: On press, scale the button to 0.96 and tighten its shadow; 80ms down, 150ms spring back — a tactile key feel that also works on touch devices.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 实现：active:scale-[0.96] + transition-transform duration-75（下压）与恢复 150ms；阴影用 active:shadow-sm。确保触屏上 :active 生效（添加 touchstart 监听或 ontouchstart 属性 hack）。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: CSS-only: `active:scale-[0.96]` with `transition-transform duration-75` down and ~150ms back; `active:shadow-sm`. Make :active reliable on touch (touchstart listener or the ontouchstart hack). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中为所有可点击元素统一添加按压反馈。

先检查是否已有全局按钮样式或交互规范，保持一致。
要求：
- 按下 scale(0.96) + 阴影收紧，80ms 缩下 150ms 回弹
- 覆盖 Button 组件与可点击卡片
- 触屏设备可靠触发
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add unified press feedback to all clickable elements in the current project.

Check for existing global button styles first and stay consistent.
Requirements:
- scale(0.96) + tightened shadow on press; 80ms down, 150ms back
- Cover the Button component and clickable cards
- Reliable on touch devices
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 点击位置向外扩散一圈半透明圆形波纹后消散，把"点中了哪里"可视化。 Material Design 的标志性按压反馈， 让无生命的点击立刻获得物理感——像石头落进水面。
description.en: A translucent circle expands from the exact tap point and fades out, visualising where the press landed. Material Design's signature press feedback — it gives clicks a physical sense, like a stone dropped on water.

use_when.zh: 按钮、列表项、卡片等大面积可点击元素
use_when.en: Buttons, list items, cards — larger tappable surfaces

use_when.zh: 触屏为主的界面（按压即触发，不依赖 hover）
use_when.en: Touch-first interfaces — fires on press, no hover needed

use_when.zh: 密集列表中需要明确"点在了哪里"
use_when.en: Dense lists where the hit point matters

avoid_when.zh: 极小图标按钮（波纹大于按钮，显得溢出）
avoid_when.en: Tiny icon buttons — the ripple overflows the target

avoid_when.zh: 高频连续点击的工具栏（波纹糊成一片）
avoid_when.en: Rapid-fire toolbars — ripples smear together

avoid_when.zh: 已有强按压反馈（scale/阴影）的组件，叠加冗余
avoid_when.en: Components with strong press scale/shadow already

note.zh: 从元素中心扩散，纯 CSS 可实现，最简
note.en: Expands from center, CSS-only — simplest

note.zh: 从真实点击坐标扩散，Material 标准
note.en: Expands from the real tap coordinates — Material standard

note.zh: 波纹是否被圆角裁剪（按钮有界、页面无界）
note.en: Whether the ripple clips to rounded bounds

notes.zh: 点击时在按点插入一个圆形 span，从 scale(0) 放大到覆盖元素并渐隐，300～500ms 后移除； 父元素 position:relative + overflow:hidden。 触点版需要监听 offsetX/Y，纯 CSS 只能做居中版。 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 退化为简单背景加深。
notes.en: On press, insert a circular span at the tap point, scale it from 0 until it covers the element while fading out, remove after 300–500ms; the parent needs position:relative plus overflow:hidden. The pointer variant requires listening to offsetX/Y — pure CSS only does the centered version. Respect prefers-reduced-motion by falling back to a simple background darken.

basic.zh: 给按钮添加点击涟漪效果：按下时从点击位置扩散水波纹。
basic.en: Add a ripple to buttons — a wave expanding from the tap point on press.

design.zh: 按钮按下时从触点扩散半透明圆形波纹，400ms 内放大并渐隐，波纹被圆角裁剪；不改变按钮尺寸与布局。
design.en: On press, a translucent circular ripple expands from the tap point, scaling and fading within 400ms, clipped to the button's rounded bounds; size and layout stay unchanged.

implementation.zh: 监听 pointerdown 取 offsetX/Y，向按钮插入 span（定位到触点，直径取对角线），触发 scale 0→1 + opacity 渐隐动画，animationend 移除。按钮加 overflow:hidden 与 position:relative。reduced-motion 降级为背景加深。
implementation.en: Listen to pointerdown for offsetX/Y, insert a span (positioned at the tap point, diameter = the diagonal), animate scale 0→1 with an opacity fade, remove on animationend. Give the button overflow:hidden and position:relative. Fall back to background darken under reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目按钮与列表项添加点击涟漪反馈。

先检查现有按钮组件与按压反馈，避免双重反馈冲突。
要求：
- 从真实触点扩散，波纹被圆角裁剪
- 400ms 内完成，动画节点及时清理防内存泄漏
- 不影响布局（transform + opacity）
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add ripple feedback to the project's buttons and list items.

Check existing button components and press feedback first; avoid double feedback.
Requirements:
- Expand from the real tap point, clipped to rounded bounds
- Complete within 400ms, clean up animated nodes to avoid leaks
- No layout impact (transform + opacity only)
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 动画进度绑定滚动位置而非时间：滚到哪、动到哪，可来回擦洗。能做滚动进度条、随滚动展开的叙事与视差层。与滚动显现不同，它不是触发后播完，而是由滚动位置精确擦洗进度。
description.en: Animation progress is tied to scroll position rather than time: scrub to where you want, even backwards. It powers scroll-linked progress bars, scroll-unfurled storytelling and parallax layers. Unlike scroll reveal it does not play once after a trigger — scroll position scrubs the timeline.

use_when.zh: 叙事随滚动展开，进度要与阅读位置同步
use_when.en: Narrative unfurls with reading and must stay in sync with scroll

use_when.zh: 需要滚动进度指示或阅读深度反馈
use_when.en: Scroll progress or reading-depth feedback is needed

use_when.zh: 视差层、粘性章节等空间层次表达
use_when.en: Spatial layering — parallax planes, sticky chapters

avoid_when.zh: 用户一滚到底找信息，动画反而拖慢到达
avoid_when.en: Users scroll straight to content — animation slows arrival

avoid_when.zh: 滚动容器嵌套复杂，进度归属不清
avoid_when.en: Nested scrollers where progress ownership is ambiguous

avoid_when.zh: 只需一次性入场，用滚动显现更简单
avoid_when.en: A single entrance is enough — plain scroll reveal is simpler

note.zh: 进度直接映射滚动位置，可逆向擦洗
note.en: Progress maps straight to scroll — scrubbable both ways

note.zh: 越过阈值后按时间播完，不再随滚动
note.en: Fires past a threshold then plays on a clock, not on scroll

note.zh: 多层不同速率移动，制造纵深
note.en: Layers move at different rates to fake depth

notes.zh: 首选 CSS：animation-timeline: scroll() + animation-range 把关键帧绑到滚动进度；不支持时用 JS 滚动监听写 CSS 变量（如 --scroll），再由 calc 驱动 transform/opacity。触发式部分的定时 动画仍需 calc(<时长> * var(--demo-speed, 1))。滚动监听要 passive + rAF 节流。 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，直接落到终态。
notes.en: Prefer CSS: animation-timeline: scroll() with animation-range binds keyframes to scroll progress; where unsupported, a JS scroll listener writes a CSS variable (e.g. --scroll) that calc drives transform/opacity. Any timed portion of a triggered animation must still use calc(<duration> * var(--demo-speed, 1)). Make scroll listeners passive and rAF-throttled. Respect prefers-reduced-motion by landing on the final state.

basic.zh: 给长页面添加滚动驱动动画：进度条随滚动增长，章节随滚动展开。
basic.en: Add scroll-driven animation to a long page: a progress bar grows with scroll and sections unfurl.

design.zh: 顶部细进度条随滚动位置从 0% 到 100%；章节卡片在滚动擦洗下上移并淡入，可反向回退；视差背景层以约 0.5 倍速移动。
design.en: A thin top progress bar runs 0% to 100% with scroll position; section cards rise and fade under scrub and reverse on the way back; a parallax backdrop moves at about half speed.

implementation.zh: 优先 animation-timeline: scroll()；回退用 passive scroll 监听 + rAF 把进度写入 CSS 变量。 受驱动元素用 calc(var(--scroll) * …) 做 transform/opacity。触发式定时动画时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: Prefer animation-timeline: scroll(); fall back to a passive scroll listener plus rAF writing a CSS variable. Drive transforms/opacity via calc(var(--scroll) * …). Multiply timed animation durations by var(--demo-speed, 1). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现滚动驱动动画。

先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
要求：
- 动画进度绑定滚动位置，可反向擦洗
- 优先使用 animation-timeline: scroll()，并提供 JS 兜底
- 定时动画时长写 calc(<时长> * var(--demo-speed, 1))
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement scroll-driven animation in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing components.
Keep the project's visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Requirements:
- Progress bound to scroll position and reversible
- Prefer animation-timeline: scroll() with a JS fallback
- Timed animation durations written calc(<duration> * var(--demo-speed, 1))
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 元素滚动进入视口时才播放淡入、上浮或滑入动画，之前保持隐藏或占位。 把"一次性呈现全部内容"变成"随阅读节奏逐段揭示"，让长页面的信息 更有秩序感。通常由 IntersectionObserver 触发，只播一次。
description.en: Elements stay hidden until they enter the viewport, then play a fade, rise or slide-in — once. It replaces "dump everything at once" with content revealed at the pace of reading, giving long pages a sense of order. Usually triggered by IntersectionObserver.

use_when.zh: 长落地页的分区内容逐段呈现
use_when.en: Long landing pages revealing sections one by one

use_when.zh: 文章、案例展示等线性阅读内容
use_when.en: Linear reading — articles, case studies, showcases

use_when.zh: 需要引导视线自上而下移动
use_when.en: When the eye should be led top-to-bottom

avoid_when.zh: 用户要找的东西被藏进动画（迟到即伤害）
avoid_when.en: Content users came for — late reveal hurts

avoid_when.zh: 表单、价格等决策关键信息
avoid_when.en: Decision-critical info — forms, pricing

avoid_when.zh: 整页元素全部滚动显现（等待感堆积）
avoid_when.en: Revealing everything on the page — waiting fatigue

note.zh: opacity 0→1 + translateY(24px→0)，最常用
note.en: opacity 0→1 + translateY(24px→0) — the default

note.zh: 从左右滑入，适合图文交错布局
note.en: Enter from a side — suits alternating image/text layouts

note.zh: 从 0.92 放大到 1，卡片与图片适用
note.en: 0.92→1 scale — good for cards and images

notes.zh: IntersectionObserver 观察目标元素，进入视口（threshold 0.15～0.25）时 加 .revealed 类触发 transition：opacity 0→1、translateY(24px)→0， 600ms ease-out，只触发一次后 unobserve。动画时长乘以一个可调速度变量。 初始隐藏状态会导致无 JS 时不显示，务必提供 no-js 回退； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion（直接显示）。
notes.en: Observe targets with IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.15–0.25); on entry add a .revealed class driving `transition: opacity 0→1, translateY(24px)→0` over 600ms ease-out, then unobserve. Scale durations by a speed variable. The hidden initial state breaks no-JS rendering — always ship a fallback; respect prefers-reduced-motion (show immediately).

basic.zh: 给页面的各个区块添加滚动显现：进入视口时淡入上浮。
basic.en: Add scroll reveal to page sections — fade up as they enter the viewport.

design.zh: 区块进入视口下沿 80% 高度时淡入并上浮 24px，600ms ease-out，只播一次； 同屏多个元素按 80ms 间隔错峰出现。
design.en: Sections fade up 24px when crossing 80% of viewport height, 600ms ease-out, once only; siblings on screen stagger 80ms apart.

implementation.zh: IntersectionObserver（rootMargin: '0px 0px -15% 0px'）进入即加 .revealed 并 unobserve；CSS：.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)} .revealed{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:all .6s ease-out}。 无 JS 回退：<noscript> 或默认显示。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: IntersectionObserver (rootMargin: '0px 0px -15% 0px') adds .revealed and unobserves; CSS: `.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)}` `.revealed{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:all .6s ease-out}`. Ship a no-JS fallback (noscript or visible-by-default). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目落地页的分区内容添加滚动显现动画。

先检查是否已有 reveal/observer 工具，复用而非新写。
要求：
- 进入视口淡入上浮 24px，600ms，只播一次
- 同屏元素 80ms 错峰
- 无 JS 或 SSR 首屏内容不被隐藏
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add scroll-reveal animations to the landing page's sections.

Check for an existing reveal/observer utility first; reuse it.
Requirements:
- Fade up 24px on viewport entry, 600ms, once only
- 80ms stagger for on-screen siblings
- No-JS and SSR above-the-fold content never hidden
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 列表里的缩略图或卡片在打开详情时"飞"成详情页主图—— 同一个元素跨两个视图连续运动， 而不是各自出现。 元素身份在转场中保持连续， 是最强的上下文延续。
description.en: A thumbnail in a list "flies" into the hero of the detail view — the same element moving continuously across two states instead of both views fading. Identity stays continuous through the transition: the strongest form of context preservation.

use_when.zh: 列表 → 详情（图片、卡片、商品）
use_when.en: List to detail — photos, cards, products

use_when.zh: 需要强调"还是那件东西"的选中场景
use_when.en: Selection flows where "it's the same item" matters

use_when.zh: 媒体浏览、相册、文件预览
use_when.en: Media browsing — galleries, files, previews

avoid_when.zh: 两视图布局差异过大（飞行轨迹扭曲难看）
avoid_when.en: Very different layouts — the flight path distorts

avoid_when.zh: 低端设备上的大图跨页动画（掉帧破坏错觉）
avoid_when.en: Large media transitions on weak devices — jank breaks the illusion

avoid_when.zh: 转场时间超过 400ms（用户开始等）
avoid_when.en: Durations past 400ms — users start waiting

note.zh: 卡片整体放大为详情容器，Material 3 标准
note.en: The card grows into the detail container — Material 3 standard

note.zh: 只有图片飞行，其余内容淡入
note.en: Only the image flies; the rest fades in

note.zh: 不支持时退化为淡入淡出
note.en: Falls back to a crossfade when unsupported

notes.zh: FLIP 技术——先记录元素起始 getBoundingClientRect，视图切换后再测终点， 反向 transform 摆回起点， 再过渡到 0。 Web 现代法可用 View Transitions API（document.startViewTransition + view-transition-name）。 时长 250～400ms； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 退化为直接切换。
notes.en: FLIP — record the element's first getBoundingClientRect, switch views, measure the last rect, invert the transform back to the start, then play to zero. Modern web option — the View Transitions API (document.startViewTransition + view-transition-name). Keep it to 250–400ms; with prefers-reduced-motion switch instantly.

basic.zh: 给图片列表添加共享元素转场：点缩略图飞入放大为详情主图。
basic.en: Add a shared element transition to the gallery — a thumbnail flies into the enlarged detail hero.

design.zh: 点击卡片后，卡片连续放大为详情容器（350ms），其余详情内容随后淡入；关闭时反向缩回原位；转场期间背景列表淡化。
design.en: On tap, the card grows continuously into the detail container (350ms) while the remaining detail content fades in after; closing reverses the flight back to the original spot; the list dims behind the transition.

implementation.zh: FLIP：点击时记录卡片 rect → 渲染详情层 → useLayoutEffect 测详情 rect → 计算 dx/dy/scale 反向 transform → 强制 reflow → 过渡到 none（350ms）。关闭反向。或用 View Transitions API 给元素加 view-transition-name。reduced-motion 直接切换。
implementation.en: FLIP — capture the card rect on tap, render the detail layer, measure the detail rect in useLayoutEffect, compute dx/dy/scale as an inverted transform, force a reflow, then transition to none (350ms). Reverse on close. Alternatively use the View Transitions API with view-transition-name. Switch instantly under reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目列表到详情添加共享元素转场。

先检查路由/视图切换方式与现有转场实现，选择 FLIP 或 View Transitions。
要求：
- 元素连续运动，250～400ms，只动 transform/opacity
- 关闭时原路返回；不支持时退化为淡切
- 不破坏滚动位置与焦点管理
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add a shared element transition from list to detail in the project.

Check the routing/view switching and existing transitions first; pick FLIP or View Transitions.
Requirements:
- Continuous element motion, 250–400ms, transform/opacity only
- Return via the same path on close; crossfade fallback when unsupported
- Preserve scroll position and focus management
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 用弹簧物理（刚度、阻尼）驱动的运动：可冲过终点再回落稳定，也可临界阻尼稳稳停住。比固定缓动更有质量感与连续性，适合拖拽落位、开关拨动与强调出现。过冲幅度需克制，避免失控感。
description.en: Motion driven by spring physics (stiffness, damping): it may overshoot and settle, or stop dead at critical damping. Compared with fixed easing it carries mass and continuity — good for drag snap-into-place, switch throws and emphatic entrances. Keep overshoot modest or it reads as broken.

use_when.zh: 拖拽松手、开关拨动等需要"落位感"的时刻
use_when.en: Snap-into-place moments — drag release, switch throws

use_when.zh: 界面要表达质量、惯性与连续物理
use_when.en: The UI should express mass, inertia and physical continuity

use_when.zh: 强调出现或共享元素归位
use_when.en: Emphatic entrances or shared elements snapping home

avoid_when.zh: 高频微操作每次弹跳，很快变吵
avoid_when.en: High-frequency micro actions — the bounce becomes noise

avoid_when.zh: 严肃流程（支付、医疗）需要克制而非活泼
avoid_when.en: Serious flows — payments, healthcare — needing restraint

avoid_when.zh: 只需一次性淡入淡出，弹簧是多余复杂度
avoid_when.en: A plain fade suffices — springs add needless complexity

note.zh: 冲过终点再回落，最有弹性
note.en: Passes the target then settles — the springiest

note.zh: 最快稳定且不过冲，最稳重
note.en: Fastest settle with zero overshoot — the steadiest

note.zh: 多次衰减振荡，俏皮但易过量
note.en: Several decaying oscillations — playful, easy to overdo

notes.zh: CSS 近似弹簧用带回弹的 cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 或 keyframes 显式写振荡序列； 精确弹簧可用 linear() 采样或 JS 按 stiffness/damping 积分后写 transform。所有时长写 calc(<时长> * var(--demo-speed, 1))。过冲幅度 ≤ 元素尺寸 10%，transform-origin 居中。 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，直接落到终态。
notes.en: Approximate a spring in CSS with a rebounding cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) or explicit oscillating keyframes; for exact physics use linear() sampling or JS integrating stiffness/damping into transforms. Write every duration as calc(<duration> * var(--demo-speed, 1)). Keep overshoot within 10% of element size with a centered transform-origin. Respect prefers-reduced-motion by landing on the final state.

basic.zh: 给元素落位添加弹簧动画：运动到位时冲过再回落。
basic.en: Add a spring animation to element settlement — overshoot the target and ease back.

design.zh: 点击触发后方块以约 450ms 弹到目标位，过冲约 8% 再回落稳定；临界阻尼变体不过冲，弹跳变体振荡两三次后停住。
design.en: On trigger the box springs to its target over ~450ms, overshooting about 8% before settling; the critically damped variant never overshoots; the bouncy variant oscillates two or three times.

implementation.zh: CSS 用 cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 或 @keyframes 振荡序列；时长一律 calc(<时长> * var(--demo-speed, 1))。transform-origin 居中，过冲 ≤ 10%。 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: Use cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) or oscillating @keyframes in CSS; write durations as calc(<duration> * var(--demo-speed, 1)). Keep transform-origin centered and overshoot ≤ 10%. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中为落位与强调时刻实现弹簧动画。

先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
要求：
- 用弹簧式缓动或振荡关键帧表达过冲与稳定
- 过冲幅度克制，所有时长写 calc(<时长> * var(--demo-speed, 1))
- 只用于低频关键时刻，不挂在高频控件上
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement spring animation for settle and emphasis moments in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing components.
Keep the project's visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Requirements:
- Express overshoot and settle with spring easing or oscillating keyframes
- Keep overshoot modest; write durations as calc(<duration> * var(--demo-speed, 1))
- Reserve for low-frequency key moments, never on high-frequency controls
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 一组元素不一起出现，而是按固定间隔依次淡入或上浮，像点名一样逐个到位。 间隔 40～120ms 即可让列表"有秩序地醒来"， 比整块淡入更有生命感，也比真实逐项加载等待感更低。
description.en: Instead of appearing at once, a group of items enters one after another at a fixed interval — like roll call. A 40–120ms gap lets a list wake up in order: livelier than a single fade, less impatient than true sequential loading.

use_when.zh: 列表、卡片网格、导航项首次进入视口
use_when.en: Lists, card grids and nav items entering the viewport

use_when.zh: 弹层内的成组内容（菜单项、通知列表）
use_when.en: Grouped content inside overlays — menus, notification lists

use_when.zh: 强调"一批结果"的整体感与顺序
use_when.en: Emphasising order across a batch of results

avoid_when.zh: 项数很多（超过 15 项，最后一项等到不耐烦）
avoid_when.en: Long lists — past ~15 items the tail waits too long

avoid_when.zh: 高频操作界面（延迟即成本）
avoid_when.en: High-frequency workflows where every delay is a cost

avoid_when.zh: 间隔过大（超过 150ms 显得拖沓做作）
avoid_when.en: Over-long gaps — beyond 150ms it turns theatrical

note.zh: 每项 translateY + opacity，最通用
note.en: translateY + opacity per item — the universal default

note.zh: 从 0.96 放大到 1，卡片感更强
note.en: Grows from 0.96 to 1 — extra card presence

note.zh: 从一侧依次滑入，导航菜单常用
note.en: Slides in from one side — menu favourite

notes.zh: 所有项共用同一组 keyframes，仅 animation-delay 按 index 递增（index * 40～120ms）， 必须配 animation-fill-mode: both 让首项在延迟期保持隐藏。 延迟与时长都要乘速度系数。 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 时全部直接显示。
notes.en: Share one set of keyframes across items and only stagger animation-delay by index (index × 40–120ms), always with animation-fill-mode: both so items stay hidden during their delay. Multiply both delay and duration by the speed factor. With prefers-reduced-motion show everything at once.

basic.zh: 给卡片列表添加逐项浮现效果：进入视口时依次淡入上浮。
basic.en: Add a stagger reveal to the card list — items fade up one after another in view.

design.zh: 列表进入视口时，卡片依次淡入上浮，单项 400ms，项间延迟 70ms；整组在 1s 内完成；顺序与阅读顺序一致。
design.en: As the list enters the viewport, cards fade up sequentially — 400ms per item with a 70ms stagger, the whole group done within 1s, matching reading order.

implementation.zh: 统一 keyframes（translateY(16px)+opacity 0 → 正常），每项 style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 0.07}s` }}，animation-fill-mode: both。用 IntersectionObserver 触发一次。reduced-motion 直接显示。
implementation.en: One shared keyframe (translateY(16px) + opacity 0 → normal), per item style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 0.07}s` }}, fill-mode both. Trigger once with IntersectionObserver. Show immediately under reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目列表页添加逐项浮现入场。

先检查现有入场动画与滚动触发逻辑，保持一致。
要求：
- 统一 keyframes，仅用 animation-delay 交错（40～120ms）
- fill-mode both，避免延迟期闪现
- 进入视口触发一次，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add a staggered entrance to the project's list pages.

Check existing entrance animations and scroll-trigger logic first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Shared keyframes, stagger via animation-delay only (40–120ms)
- fill-mode both to prevent flashes during delays
- Trigger once in view; respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 把标题或段落按行、按词逐个显现，而不是整块淡入。文字"被说出来"的节奏感让信息有先后与分量， 常用于落地页首屏大标题、章节开场与滚动叙事， 通常进入视口时触发一次。
description.en: Reveals a headline line by line or word by word instead of fading the whole block in. The spoken-rhythm staggering gives copy order and weight — a staple of landing-page hero titles, section intros and scrollytelling, usually triggered once on entering the viewport.

use_when.zh: 落地页首屏大标题、品牌口号需要登场感
use_when.en: Hero headlines and taglines that need an entrance

use_when.zh: 滚动到视口时逐段显现，引导阅读顺序
use_when.en: Scroll-triggered sections that guide reading order

use_when.zh: 编辑排版类页面，文字本身是主角
use_when.en: Editorial layouts where type is the protagonist

avoid_when.zh: 正文段落逐词动画（阅读被拖慢，用户会烦）
avoid_when.en: Animating body copy word by word — it delays reading

avoid_when.zh: 需要快速扫读的界面（后台、表格、文档）
avoid_when.en: Interfaces built for scanning — dashboards, tables, docs

avoid_when.zh: 一屏多组文字同时做入场动画（互相打架）
avoid_when.en: Multiple competing text entrances in one viewport

note.zh: 文字从遮挡条下方向上滑出，电影字幕感
note.en: Lines slide up from behind a mask — cinematic captions

note.zh: 单词逐个上浮淡入，节奏更快
note.en: Words fade in one by one — quicker tempo

note.zh: 逐字出现加闪烁光标，终端与对话感
note.en: Types characters with a blinking caret — terminal feel

notes.zh: 行遮罩法：每行外层 overflow:hidden，内层从 translateY(100%) 过渡到 0，animation-delay 逐行递增 80～120ms， 比打字机更快读完。无动画时文字必须直接可见——初始 opacity:0 只能写在 keyframes 里； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 直接显示全文。
notes.en: Line-mask recipe — wrap each line in overflow:hidden and animate the inner span from translateY(100%) to 0, stepping animation-delay 80–120ms per line. Faster to read than a typewriter. Text must be visible without animation — keep the initial opacity:0 inside the keyframes; with prefers-reduced-motion show everything at once.

basic.zh: 给首屏大标题添加文字显现效果：按行依次上浮出现。
basic.en: Add a text reveal to the hero headline — lines float up one after another.

design.zh: 首屏标题分三行，每行从遮罩下方向上滑入，600ms ease-out，行间延迟 100ms；动画只触发一次；无动画时文字直接可见。
design.en: Split the hero title into three lines, each sliding up from a mask, 600ms ease-out with a 100ms per-line delay; the animation plays once; text stays visible without animation.

implementation.zh: 纯 CSS：外层 overflow:hidden，内层 @keyframes 从 translateY(100%) 到 0，animation-delay: calc(index * 100ms)。动画结束保持终态（forwards）。加 @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) 直接显示。
implementation.en: CSS-only: outer overflow:hidden, inner keyframes translateY(100%) → 0, animation-delay calc(index * 100ms), fill-mode forwards. Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to show text immediately.

agent.zh:
为当前项目落地页的首屏标题添加逐行文字显现。

先检查现有入场动画与令牌，保持节奏一致。
要求：
- 行遮罩上滑，行间延迟 80～120ms，600ms 内完成
- 只在进入视口后触发一次
- 无 JS 时文字可直接可见（渐进增强）
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add a line-by-line text reveal to the project's hero headline.

Check existing entrance animations and tokens first; keep the rhythm consistent.
Requirements:
- Line mask slide-up, 80–120ms stagger, under 600ms total
- Triggered once when entering the viewport
- Text visible without JS (progressive enhancement)
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 操作结果以一条短提示从屏幕边缘滑入（常为底部或右上角）， 停留数秒后自动滑出。 动效分三段：滑入—停留—滑出， 方向与来源一致——从边缘来，回边缘去。
description.en: A short notice slides in from a screen edge — bottom or top-right — lingers a few seconds, then slides back out. Three phases: enter, hold, exit; it always returns toward the edge it came from.

use_when.zh: 操作成功、失败、已撤销等轻量结果反馈
use_when.en: Lightweight results — saved, failed, undone

use_when.zh: 不打断当前任务的异步完成通知
use_when.en: Async completions that must not interrupt

use_when.zh: 配合撤销操作的短时窗口提示
use_when.en: Undo windows ("Message archived — Undo")

avoid_when.zh: 必须处理的信息（改用 alert 或 modal）
avoid_when.en: Must-act information — use an alert or modal

avoid_when.zh: 同屏堆叠多条长文本（读不完即消失）
avoid_when.en: Several long toasts stacked — they expire before reading

avoid_when.zh: 关键错误（toast 易被错过，需可恢复方案）
avoid_when.en: Critical errors — toasts get missed; make them recoverable

note.zh: 移动端标准，translateY 滑入
note.en: The mobile standard — slides up via translateY

note.zh: 桌面端通知常见，translateX 滑入
note.en: Desktop notification favourite — slides in via translateX

note.zh: 停留 3～5s 后反向滑出
note.en: Holds 3–5s then exits in reverse

notes.zh: 入场 transform 从 translateY(16px)（或 X 24px）+ opacity 0 到可见，200～250ms ease-out； 停留 3～5s 后反向滑出 150～200ms。 容器加 aria-live="polite" 播报内容； 悬停时暂停倒计时；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 改为纯淡入淡出。
notes.en: Enter with transform from translateY(16px) (or X 24px) plus opacity 0 to visible over 200–250ms ease-out; hold 3–5s, then exit in reverse over 150–200ms. Give the container aria-live="polite", pause the timer on hover, and respect prefers-reduced-motion with a pure crossfade.

basic.zh: 给保存操作添加 toast 提示：操作成功后从底部滑入，3 秒后自动消失。
basic.en: Add a toast for saves — it slides up from the bottom on success and auto-dismisses after 3 seconds.

design.zh: 保存成功提示从底部上滑入场 220ms ease-out，停留 3s 后下滑退出；单行文案 + 可选撤销按钮；同时最多一条。
design.en: The success toast slides up from the bottom over 220ms ease-out, holds 3s, then slides back down; single-line copy with an optional undo action; at most one toast at a time.

implementation.zh: 入场 transition transform+opacity 220ms ease-out（translateY(16px)→0），用 setTimeout 3s 触发出场（反向 180ms）。容器 position:fixed + aria-live="polite"；hover 时清除计时器，离开时重启；reduced-motion 改 opacity 过渡。
implementation.en: Enter with transform+opacity transition 220ms ease-out (translateY(16px)→0), a 3s setTimeout triggers the reverse exit (180ms). Fixed-position container with aria-live="polite"; clear the timer on hover and restart on leave; use an opacity-only transition under reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目操作结果添加 toast 滑入反馈。

先检查现有 toast/通知组件，复用其队列与计时逻辑。
要求：
- 入场 200～250ms ease-out，出场反向 150～200ms
- 停留 3～5s 自动消失，hover 暂停倒计时
- aria-live 播报，reduced-motion 降级为淡入淡出
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add slide-in toast feedback for operation results.

Check existing toast/notification components first; reuse their queue and timer logic.
Requirements:
- Enter 200–250ms ease-out, exit in reverse 150–200ms
- Auto-dismiss after 3–5s; pause the countdown on hover
- aria-live announcements; crossfade fallback under reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 用浏览器原生 View Transitions API 在页面状态切换时做平滑过渡：旧视图淡出、新视图淡入，关键元素可共享形变。它把状态跳变藏进连续的空间叙事，让"换了一屏"读起来像"移了一步"，而不是硬切。
description.en: A browser-native transition between page states via the View Transitions API: the old view fades out, the new one fades in, and key elements can morph as shared targets. It hides the jump inside continuous spatial narrative so "a new screen" reads as "one step over" rather than a hard cut.

use_when.zh: 同文档内状态或路由切换需要连续感（列表↔详情）
use_when.en: In-document state or route changes needing continuity — list to detail

use_when.zh: 存在应保持视觉连续的关键元素（标题、图片、按钮）
use_when.en: Key elements that should persist visually — titles, images, buttons

use_when.zh: 目标浏览器已支持 View Transitions API
use_when.en: Target browsers already support the View Transitions API

avoid_when.zh: 每次切换都播长动画，高频导航会被拖慢
avoid_when.en: Long animations on every hop — frequent navigation bogs down

avoid_when.zh: 旧新视图结构差异过大，形变会扭曲内容
avoid_when.en: Old and new views differ wildly — morphing distorts content

avoid_when.zh: 需要兼容无 API 环境且不愿做回退分支
avoid_when.en: Must support no-API environments without a fallback path

note.zh: 旧淡出新淡入，最稳妥的默认
note.en: Old fades out, new fades in — the safe default

note.zh: 沿导航方向推入推出，前进后退语义清晰
note.en: Push in/out along the navigation axis — clear forward/back semantics

note.zh: 共同元素原地形变，其余沿轴移动
note.en: Shared elements morph in place; the rest moves along an axis

sources.name: W3C — CSS View Transitions Module Level 1

notes.zh: 原生路径用 document.startViewTransition(() => updateDOM())，为需形变的元素指定 view-transition-name。无 API 时用 CSS animation 兜底：旧视图 fade/slide 出、新视图入， 时长一律 calc(<时长> * var(--demo-speed, 1))。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，退化为瞬时切换。
notes.en: The native path calls document.startViewTransition(() => updateDOM()) and assigns view-transition-name to elements that should morph. Without the API fall back to CSS animation: the old view fades or slides out as the new one enters, all durations written calc(<duration> * var(--demo-speed, 1)). Respect prefers-reduced-motion by cutting instantly.

basic.zh: 给列表与详情之间的切换添加视图过渡动画。
basic.en: Add a view transition between list and detail states.

design.zh: 列表卡片点开时，标题与图片保持视觉连续地形变为详情页对应元素，其余内容交叉淡入，约 300ms；返回时反向播放。
design.en: Opening a card morphs its title and image into the detail counterparts while the rest cross-fades over ~300ms; going back reverses the move.

implementation.zh: 优先用 document.startViewTransition + view-transition-name；无 API 时用 @keyframes 兜底， 旧新视图绝对定位叠放做交叉淡入或滑动。所有时长写 calc(<时长> * var(--demo-speed, 1))。 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: Prefer document.startViewTransition with view-transition-name; fall back to @keyframes with stacked absolute views cross-fading or sliding. Write every duration as calc(<duration> * var(--demo-speed, 1)). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现视图过渡。

先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
要求：
- 状态或路由切换有连续过渡，关键元素保持视觉连续
- 无 View Transitions API 时有 CSS 兜底
- 所有动画时长写 calc(<时长> * var(--demo-speed, 1))
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement view transitions in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing components.
Keep the project's visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Requirements:
- State or route changes transition continuously, with key elements staying visually continuous
- CSS fallback when the View Transitions API is missing
- All animation durations written calc(<duration> * var(--demo-speed, 1))
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

description.zh: 向访客解释「我们是谁、为什么做这件事」的品牌页面：开头用一句使命宣言定调，中段以创始故事、发展历程或团队照片建立信任，再用价值观与关键数据支撑，结尾导向联系、招聘或产品。
description.en: A brand page explaining who you are: a mission statement sets the tone, then story and milestones build trust, and the end points to contact or careers.

use_when.zh: 访客在决策前想了解团队与背景
use_when.en: Visitors want to know the team and background before deciding

use_when.zh: 品牌需要传达使命与价值观
use_when.en: The brand needs to communicate mission and values

use_when.zh: 招聘、融资或合作需要可信的自我介绍
use_when.en: Hiring, funding or partnerships need a credible introduction

avoid_when.zh: 用户只关心功能与价格（用落地页或定价页更合适）
avoid_when.en: Users only care about features and price — use a landing or pricing page

avoid_when.zh: 团队或公司信息尚未确定
avoid_when.en: Team or company details are not settled yet

avoid_when.zh: 需要承载复杂操作流程
avoid_when.en: The page must carry complex task flows

note.zh: 以创始人叙事为主线，情绪与图片占主导
note.en: A founder-led narrative where emotion and imagery lead

note.zh: 头像网格 + 职位与简介，强调人
note.en: Avatar grid with roles and short bios, putting people first

note.zh: 以时间线串起里程碑与关键数据
note.en: A timeline strings milestones and key numbers together

note.zh: 站点导航与主 CTA，与全站保持一致。
note.en: Site nav and primary CTA, consistent with the rest of the site.

note.zh: 一句加大的主张配一张品牌照片，先回答「我们为何存在」。
note.en: One oversized statement beside a brand image answers why you exist.

note.zh: 创始故事或时间线，用具体事件与年份建立可信度。
note.en: The origin story or timeline builds credibility with concrete events and years.

note.zh: 头像、姓名与职位网格，规模小则给每人一句简介。
note.en: A grid of avatars, names and roles, with one line each for small teams.

note.zh: 三到四条原则，每条一句解释，避免空泛口号。
note.en: Three or four principles, each with one line of explanation, not slogans.

note.zh: 导向联系、招聘或产品体验，给读者下一步。
note.en: Points to contact, careers or the product, giving readers a next step.

notes.zh: 分区纵向堆叠，团队与价值观用 auto-fit 网格；头像统一正方形并 object-fit: cover，避免拉伸。长页在分区进入时做轻微淡入，需尊重 prefers-reduced-motion；文字与图片的对比度要达 WCAG AA。
notes.en: Stack sections vertically; lay the team and values out with an auto-fit grid; keep avatars square and object-fit: cover so they never stretch. Fade sections in as they enter, respecting prefers-reduced-motion, and keep text-on-image contrast at WCAG AA.

basic.zh: 创建一个关于页，包含使命宣言、团队介绍和价值观。
basic.en: Create an about page with a mission statement, team section and values.

design.zh: 设计品牌关于页：顶部大标题使命宣言 + 品牌图；中段时间线串起里程碑；团队区四列头像卡，每张含姓名与职位；价值观三列图标 + 短句；结尾 CTA 横幅指向联系我们与加入我们。深浅色一致，进场轻微淡入。
design.en: Design a brand about page: a large mission headline with a brand image; a timeline of milestones; a four-column team grid with name and role cards; a three-column values row with short lines; a closing CTA banner to contact and careers. Theme-consistent with subtle fade-ins.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现关于页：语义化 section，团队与价值观用 grid auto-fit；头像固定比例并 object-fit: cover；时间线用有序列表表达先后；进场动画用 IntersectionObserver 并尊重 prefers-reduced-motion；不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind about page: semantic sections; team and values on an auto-fit grid; avatars with a fixed ratio and object-fit: cover; the timeline as an ordered list; entry animation via IntersectionObserver respecting prefers-reduced-motion; no new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现关于页。

先检查现有布局壳、卡片与头像组件，优先复用。
要求：
- 使命宣言 + 故事/时间线 + 团队 + 价值观 + CTA
- 团队与价值观用自适应网格，头像不变形
- 时间线语义化为有序列表
- 图片有 alt，文字对比度达 AA
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the about page in the current project.

Inspect the existing layout shell, card and avatar components first; reuse them.
Requirements:
- Mission + story/timeline + team + values + CTA
- Team and values on an adaptive grid; avatars never distort
- Timeline marked up as an ordered list
- Images carry alt text; text meets AA contrast
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

description.zh: 按时间或主题聚合文章的内容索引页：顶部先给一条编辑推荐的头条，再用卡片流或列表铺开全部文章，每项含题图、标题、摘要、分类与日期；分类导航与搜索负责收窄范围，分页或无限滚动负责继续加载。
description.en: An index of posts by date or topic: a featured story leads, then cards show thumbnail, title, excerpt and date, with category nav and pagination.

use_when.zh: 站点有持续更新的文章或资讯
use_when.en: The site publishes a steady stream of articles

use_when.zh: 用户需要按主题、标签或时间浏览
use_when.en: Users browse by topic, tag or time

use_when.zh: 希望突出少数重点文章
use_when.en: You want to spotlight a few key posts

avoid_when.zh: 只有零星几条静态内容
avoid_when.en: There are only a handful of static items

avoid_when.zh: 内容需要强检索而非浏览（用搜索结果页更合适）
avoid_when.en: Content needs heavy retrieval, not browsing — a search page fits better

avoid_when.zh: 单篇文章本身就是完整产品页
avoid_when.en: A single article already is the whole product page

note.zh: 图文卡片等高排列，题图统一比例，适合视觉型内容
note.en: Equal-height visual cards with a unified thumbnail ratio

note.zh: 只留标题、摘要与日期，一屏信息量最大
note.en: Title, excerpt and date only — maximum information per screen

note.zh: 顶部大图推荐一篇，下方退回常规列表
note.en: A large visual promotes one post, with a normal list below

note.zh: 站点导航、搜索入口与订阅按钮，保持全站一致。
note.en: Site nav, search entry and subscribe button, consistent sitewide.

note.zh: 一条大图或加大标题的置顶文章，占首屏最强视觉权重。
note.en: One pinned post with a large image or headline, the strongest first-screen weight.

note.zh: 横向标签或分类链接，切换后列表即时过滤。
note.en: Horizontal tags or category links that filter the list on switch.

note.zh: 卡片或列表项重复排列，每项包含题图、标题、摘要与元信息。
